#include "world_units.h"
#include "aimbot.h"
#include "entity_health.h"
#include "aim_model.h"
#include "native_joint_demand.h" // ACE_NATIVE_JOINT_INTEGRATION_V1
#include "lead.h"
#include "input.h"
#include "profile_scope.h"
#include <windows.h>
namespace aim{
std::string wait_reason="Waiting for activation";
float flight_seconds=0;std::string prediction_status="Prediction has not acquired a target";
bool active=false;int target_idx=-1;Vec2 target_screen{-99999,-99999};u64 override_target=0;
struct State{u64 base=0,since=0,engage_at=0,last_tick=0;u64 pending_base=0,pending_at=0;int bone=-1;unsigned stamp=0;aim_model::Movement movement;};
static State state;static bool toggle=false,last_key=false,was_engaged=false;static unsigned session=1;static u64 activation_started=0;
static void reset(){hw::cancel(hw::Origin::Aim);state={};active=false;target_idx=-1;target_screen={-99999,-99999};}
static profile_scope::Context previous_context;
void tick(u64 sw,u64 sh){
    native_joint_demand::Tick native_demand(native_joint_demand::Consumer::Aim);
    decision_frame::Scope decision(true,!decision_frame::managed()||native_target::supports_entity(EClass::NPC));
    auto& frame=decision.get();const Entity& local=frame.local;auto& enemies=frame.targets;
    const auto context=profile_scope::for_entity(local);
    Settings::Scope active_settings(context.key,context.parents);
    if(context!=previous_context){reset();previous_context=context;}
    enemies.erase(std::remove_if(enemies.begin(),enemies.end(),[](const Entity& e){
        if(e.cls==EClass::Player)return !cfg.B("aim.target_players");
        bool neutral=e.type_name.find("Neutral")!=std::string::npos||e.type_name.find("Boss")!=std::string::npos;
        return e.cls!=EClass::NPC||!cfg.B(neutral?"aim.target_neutrals":"aim.target_minions");
    }),enemies.end());
    active=false;target_idx=-1;target_screen={-99999,-99999};wait_reason="No eligible visible aim region";
    bool key=game_key_down(cfg.I("aim.key"));
    if(cfg.I("aim.mode")==1&&key&&!last_key)toggle=!toggle;last_key=key;
    int mode=cfg.I("aim.mode");bool enabled=mode==2||(mode==1?toggle:key);
    if(enabled&&!was_engaged){session=(unsigned)(rnd()*4294967295.0);activation_started=now_ms();}if(!enabled)activation_started=0;was_engaged=enabled;
    const bool output_permitted=game_data_permits_output();
    const bool visibility_check=cfg.B("aim.visible_check");
    unsigned eligible=0,native_points=0,screen_points=0,known_points=0,clear_points=0;bool visibility_delay=false;
    if(!output_permitted||(decision_frame::managed()&&(!local.weapon_valid||local.disarmed||local.reloading))||!enabled||!cfg.B("aim.enabled")||inp.panic||!local.base){reset();
        wait_reason=!cfg.B("aim.enabled")?"Aim disabled":(inp.panic?"Panic enabled":(!enabled?"Waiting for activation":(!output_permitted?game_output_reason():(!local.weapon_valid?"Weapon data unavailable":(local.disarmed?"Disarmed":(local.reloading?"Reloading":"Local player unavailable"))))));hw::cancel(hw::Origin::Aim);return;}
    if(activation_started&&now_ms()-activation_started<(u64)cfg.F("aim.start_delay_ms")){wait_reason="Aim start delay";state.movement={};hw::cancel(hw::Origin::Aim);return;}
    if(decision_frame::managed()&&!cfg.B("aim.target_players")){reset();wait_reason="Player targets disabled";hw::cancel(hw::Origin::Aim);return;}
    if(decision_frame::managed()&&!native_joint_demand::selected_regions()){reset();wait_reason="Select Head or Neck in target point priority";hw::cancel(hw::Origin::Aim);return;}
    if(cfg.B("aim.target_players"))native_demand.request(native_joint_demand::selected_regions(),world_units::units(cfg.F("aim.max_dist")));
    Vec2 center{sw*.5f,sh*.5f};float radius=aim_model::fov_radius((float)sw,cfg.F("aim.fov"));
    auto viable=[&](const Entity& e){return (!visibility_check||!decision_frame::managed()||(e.visible_since&&now_ms()-e.visible_since>=(u64)cfg.F("aim.visible_ms")))&&e.base&&e.alive&&(!cfg.B("target.team_check")||e.team!=local.team)&&local.pos.dist(e.pos)<=world_units::units(cfg.F("aim.max_dist"))&&(!cfg.B("aim.skip_fast")||e.vel.len()<=cfg.F("aim.max_speed"));};
    int current=-1,best=-1;aim_model::Point locked,best_point;float best_score=1e30f;
    for(size_t i=0;i<enemies.size();i++){
        auto& e=enemies[i];
        if(!e.base||!e.alive||(cfg.B("target.team_check")&&e.team==local.team)||local.pos.dist(e.pos)>world_units::units(cfg.F("aim.max_dist"))||(cfg.B("aim.skip_fast")&&e.vel.len()>cfg.F("aim.max_speed")))continue;
        ++eligible;
        for(int region=0;region<aim_model::bone_count;++region)if(cfg.I(aim_model::key(region).c_str())>=0){
            Vec3 point;if(!aim_model::region_world(e,region,point))continue;++native_points;
            if(!aim_model::on_screen(world_to_screen(point,sw,sh),(float)sw,(float)sh))continue;++screen_points;
            if(e.bone_visibility_known[region])++known_points;if(e.bone_visible[region])++clear_points;
        }
        if(!viable(e)){visibility_delay|=visibility_check;continue;}
        if(decision_frame::managed()&&cfg.I("aim.priority")==2&&!entity_health::current(e))continue;unsigned stamp=aim_model::bone_stamp();
        int preferred=e.base==state.base&&stamp==state.stamp?state.bone:-1;
        auto p=aim_model::weighted_select(e,sw,sh,aim_model::acquisition_roll(e.base,session),(e.base==state.base&&cfg.B("aim.hard_lock"))?1e30f:radius,preferred,visibility_check);if(!p.valid())continue;
        if(e.base==state.base){current=(int)i;locked=p;}
        if(p.distance>radius)continue;
        float score=cfg.I("aim.priority")==1?local.pos.dist(e.pos):(cfg.I("aim.priority")==2?e.hp:p.distance);
        if(e.base==override_target)score=-1;
        if(score<best_score){best_score=score;best=(int)i;best_point=p;}
    }
    u64 now=now_ms();
    if(current>=0&&cfg.B("aim.hard_lock")){best=current;best_point=locked;}
    if(best<0){
        wait_reason=!eligible?"No players pass target filters":!native_points?"Selected native joints unavailable (see joint log)":!screen_points?"Native joints outside the screen":visibility_check&&decision_frame::managed()&&!known_points?"Visibility unknown: map or joint clearance unavailable":visibility_check&&decision_frame::managed()&&!clear_points?"Selected joints obstructed":visibility_delay?"Waiting for minimum time in view":"No point passes FOV or target-state checks";
        state.movement={};state.pending_base=0;hw::cancel(hw::Origin::Aim);return;
    }
    if(state.base&&enemies[best].base!=state.base){
        if(state.pending_base!=enemies[best].base){state.pending_base=enemies[best].base;state.pending_at=now;}
        if(now-state.pending_at<(u64)cfg.F("aim.retarget_ms")){if(current>=0){best=current;best_point=locked;}else{state.movement={};hw::cancel(hw::Origin::Aim);return;}}
    }else state.pending_base=0;
    if(state.base!=enemies[best].base){hw::cancel(hw::Origin::Aim);state={};state.base=enemies[best].base;state.since=now;
        state.engage_at=now+aim_model::sample_delay(cfg.F("aim.act_delay_min"),cfg.F("aim.act_delay_max"));state.last_tick=now;}
    if(now<state.engage_at){wait_reason="Reaction delay";state.last_tick=now;hw::cancel(hw::Origin::Aim);return;}
    if(state.bone!=best_point.bone){state.bone=best_point.bone;state.movement={};state.stamp=aim_model::bone_stamp();}
    state.stamp=aim_model::bone_stamp();
    float dt=state.last_tick?(now-state.last_tick)/1000.f:1.f/60;state.last_tick=now;
    flight_seconds=0;if(cfg.B("aim.prediction")&&decision_frame::managed()){auto predicted=lead::point(local.current_shot,enemies[best],best_point.bone,sw,sh,visibility_check);prediction_status=predicted.reason;if(!predicted.valid){wait_reason=prediction_status;state.movement={};hw::cancel(hw::Origin::Aim);return;}best_point.screen=predicted.screen;flight_seconds=predicted.solution.flight;prediction_status=local.current_shot.name+": estimated flight "+std::to_string((int)(flight_seconds*1000))+" ms";}else prediction_status="Projectile lead is off";
    // Handoff is measured against the SAME final point used for movement.
    // Prediction-unavailable returns above; an unverified intercept is never used.
    target_idx=best;target_screen=best_point.screen;
    const float deadzone=aim_model::deadzone_radius_pixels((float)sw,aim_model::capped_deadzone_fov(cfg.F("aim.deadzone_fov"),cfg.F("aim.fov")));
    if(aim_model::inside_deadzone(best_point.screen,center,deadzone)){wait_reason="Manual aim inside dead zone";state.movement={};hw::cancel(hw::Origin::Aim);return;}
    Vec2 delta=best_point.screen-center;
    if(delta.len()<.001f||cfg.F("aim.strength")<=0){wait_reason=cfg.F("aim.strength")<=0?"Aim strength is zero":"Manual aim inside dead zone";state.movement={};hw::cancel(hw::Origin::Aim);return;}
    wait_reason="Applying smooth aim";active=true;hw::set_activity(hw::Origin::Aim,true);
    Vec2 step=hw::guided_move(delta,state.movement,sw,sh,dt,false)+state.movement.remainder;int x=(int)step.x,y=(int)step.y;state.movement.remainder={step.x-x,step.y-y};
    if(x||y)hw::mouse_move(x,y,hw::Origin::Aim);
}
}

#include "world_units.h"
#include "triggerbot.h"
#include "aim_model.h"
#include "native_joint_demand.h" // ACE_NATIVE_JOINT_INTEGRATION_V1

namespace trig{
struct State{u64 last_shot=0,ready_at=0,last_tick=0,magnet_target=0;int magnet_bone=-1;bool armed=false;aim_model::Movement magnet;};
static State state;static bool toggled=false,last_key=false;static unsigned session=1;static profile_scope::Context previous_context;
bool is_armed(){return state.armed;}
u64 remaining_delay_ms(){u64 now=now_ms();return state.armed&&state.ready_at>now?state.ready_at-now:0;}
static void disarm(){hw::cancel(hw::Origin::Trigger);state={};}
void tick(u64 sw,u64 sh){
    native_joint_demand::Tick native_demand(native_joint_demand::Consumer::Trigger);
    native_joint_demand::Tick native_magnet_demand(native_joint_demand::Consumer::Magnet);
    decision_frame::Scope decision(!cfg.B("target.team_check"));
    auto& frame=decision.get();const Entity& local=frame.local;auto& enemies=frame.targets;
    const auto context=profile_scope::for_entity(local);Settings::Scope active_settings(context.key,context.parents);
    bool key=game_key_down(cfg.I("trigger.key"));
    if(previous_context!=context){previous_context=context;toggled=false;disarm();}
    if(cfg.I("trigger.activation")==1&&key&&!last_key)toggled=!toggled;last_key=key;
    if(!game_data_permits_output()||(decision_frame::managed()&&(!local.weapon_valid||local.disarmed||local.reloading))||!cfg.B("trigger.enabled")){toggled=false;disarm();return;}
    if(decision_frame::managed()&&(!local.primary_shot.source||(local.selected_ability&&local.current_shot.source!=local.primary_shot.source))){disarm();return;}
    if(!aim_model::armed(cfg.I("trigger.activation"),key,toggled)||!local.base||inp.panic){disarm();return;}
    native_demand.request(native_joint_demand::selected_regions(),native_joint_demand::trigger_range());
    if(cfg.B("trigger.magnet"))native_magnet_demand.request(native_joint_demand::selected_regions(),native_joint_demand::magnet_range());
    u64 now=now_ms();
    if(!state.armed){state.armed=true;state.ready_at=now+aim_model::sample_delay(cfg.F("trigger.first_shot_delay_min"),cfg.F("trigger.first_shot_delay_max"));session=(unsigned)(rnd()*4294967295.0);}
    hw::set_activity(hw::Origin::Trigger,true);
    aim_model::Point shot,magnet;int shot_index=-1,magnet_index=-1;
    float magnet_radius=aim_model::fov_radius((float)sw,cfg.F("trigger.magnet_fov"));
    for(size_t i=0;i<enemies.size();i++){
        auto& e=enemies[i];if(!e.base||!e.alive||(cfg.B("target.team_check")&&e.team==local.team))continue;
        if(cfg.B("trigger.skip_fast")&&e.vel.len()>cfg.F("trigger.max_speed"))continue;
        const auto distance=local.pos.dist(e.pos);if(!std::isfinite(distance))continue;
        float roll=aim_model::acquisition_roll(e.base,session);
        aim_model::Point p;if(distance<=native_joint_demand::trigger_range())p=aim_model::weighted_select(e,sw,sh,roll,cfg.B("trigger.prediction")&&decision_frame::managed()?1e30f:8);if(p.valid()&&cfg.B("trigger.prediction")&&decision_frame::managed()){auto predicted=lead::point(local.primary_shot,e,p.bone,sw,sh);if(!predicted.valid)p={};else{p.screen=predicted.screen;p.distance=(p.screen-Vec2{sw*.5f,sh*.5f}).len();}}if(p.valid()&&p.distance<=8&&(!shot.valid()||p.distance<shot.distance)){shot=p;shot_index=(int)i;}
        int previous=e.base==state.magnet_target?state.magnet_bone:-1;
        p={};if(cfg.B("trigger.magnet")&&distance<=native_joint_demand::magnet_range())p=aim_model::weighted_select(e,sw,sh,roll,magnet_radius,previous);if(p.valid()&&cfg.B("trigger.magnet_prediction")&&decision_frame::managed()){auto predicted=lead::point(local.primary_shot,e,p.bone,sw,sh);if(!predicted.valid)p={};else{p.screen=predicted.screen;p.distance=(p.screen-Vec2{sw*.5f,sh*.5f}).len();}}if(p.valid()&&(!decision_frame::managed()||(e.visible_since&&now_ms()-e.visible_since>=(u64)cfg.F("trigger.magnet_visible_ms")))&&(!magnet.valid()||p.distance<magnet.distance)){magnet=p;magnet_index=(int)i;}
    }
    float dt=state.last_tick?(now-state.last_tick)/1000.f:1.f/60;state.last_tick=now;
    if(cfg.B("trigger.magnet")&&magnet_index>=0&&!aim::active){
        if(state.magnet_target!=enemies[magnet_index].base||state.magnet_bone!=magnet.bone){state.magnet={};state.magnet_target=enemies[magnet_index].base;state.magnet_bone=magnet.bone;}
        Vec2 center{sw*.5f,sh*.5f};const float zone=aim_model::deadzone_radius_pixels((float)sw,aim_model::capped_deadzone_fov(cfg.F("trigger.magnet_deadzone_fov"),cfg.F("trigger.magnet_fov")));Vec2 delta=aim_model::inside_deadzone(magnet.screen,center,zone)?Vec2{}:magnet.screen-center;
        Vec2 step;if(delta.len()<.001f||cfg.F("trigger.magnet_strength")<=0)state.magnet={};else step=hw::guided_move(delta,state.magnet,sw,sh,dt,true);step=step+state.magnet.remainder;int x=(int)step.x,y=(int)step.y;state.magnet.remainder={step.x-x,step.y-y};
        if(x||y)hw::mouse_move(x,y,hw::Origin::Trigger);
    }else{state.magnet={};state.magnet_target=0;state.magnet_bone=-1;}
    if(shot_index<0||now<state.ready_at)return;
    auto& enemy=enemies[shot_index];float angle=rad2deg(std::atan2(shot.distance,(float)sw*.5f));
    float chance=aim_model::hitchance(angle,enemy.vel.len(),local.vel.len()/600,cfg.F(aim_model::key(shot.bone,"_chance").c_str()));
    if(chance<cfg.F("trigger.hitchance_min"))return;
    hw::mouse_click(0,20,hw::Origin::Trigger);
    state.last_shot=now;state.ready_at=now+aim_model::sample_delay(cfg.F("trigger.followup_delay_min"),cfg.F("trigger.followup_delay_max"));
}
}

namespace {
std::string diagnostic_value(u64 value,bool hex=false){
    if(value==std::numeric_limits<u64>::max())return "unavailable";
    if(!hex)return std::to_string(value);
    std::ostringstream text;text<<"0x"<<std::hex<<value;return text.str();
}
}
std::string Reader::diagnostics() const{
    const auto pid=target_pid_.load();
    return std::string("Memory ")+(ready_.load()?(via_vmm_.load()?"DMA connected":"local connected"):"disconnected")+
        " | Process PID: "+(pid?std::to_string(pid):std::string("not found"))+
        " | Bytes read: "+std::to_string(total_read_bytes.load())+
        " | Read failures (total): "+std::to_string(read_errors.load())+" | Scalar calls: "+std::to_string(scalar_read_calls.load())+" | Scatter calls/requests: "+std::to_string(scatter_calls.load())+"/"+std::to_string(scatter_requests.load())+
        " | PCIe device ID: "+diagnostic_value(fpga_device_id_.load(),true)+
        " | FPGA ID: "+diagnostic_value(fpga_id_.load(),true)+
        " | FPGA firmware: "+(fpga_major_.load()==unavailable?std::string("unavailable"):diagnostic_value(fpga_major_.load())+"."+diagnostic_value(fpga_minor_.load()))+
        " | VMM version: "+(vmm_major_.load()==unavailable?std::string("unavailable"):diagnostic_value(vmm_major_.load())+"."+diagnostic_value(vmm_minor_.load())+"."+diagnostic_value(vmm_revision_.load()));
}
void Reader::disconnect(){
    invalidate_attachment_epoch(); // ACE_NATIVE_JOINT_INTEGRATION_V1
    // There must be no concurrent reader/attach/vendor calls at this point.
    plat_stage("dma","disconnecting");ready_=false;target_pid_=0;
    scatter_session_.close(); // Close scatter before its parent VMM handle.
    if(vmm_){using Close=void(*)(vmm_api::Handle);auto close=(Close)fn("VMMDLL_Close");if(close)close(vmm_);else plat_log("DMA disconnect: VMMDLL_Close export unavailable");vmm_=nullptr;}
    if(local_proc_){CloseHandle(local_proc_);local_proc_=nullptr;}
    via_vmm_=false;fpga_device_id_=unavailable;fpga_id_=unavailable;fpga_major_=unavailable;fpga_minor_=unavailable;
    vmm_major_=unavailable;vmm_minor_=unavailable;vmm_revision_=unavailable;
    total_read_bytes=0;read_errors=0;scalar_read_calls=0;scatter_calls=0;scatter_requests=0;requested_read_bytes=0;status.ok=false;status.text="disconnected";
    plat_log("DMA disconnected");plat_stage("dma","disconnected");
}
bool Reader::init_vmm(){
    if(ready())return true;
    using INIT=vmm_api::Initialize;
    struct ErrorInfo{DWORD version,bytes,future[16],user_request,chars;WCHAR text[1];};
    static_assert(offsetof(ErrorInfo,text)==80);
    using INITEX=vmm_api::Handle(*)(DWORD,LPCSTR[],ErrorInfo**);
    plat_stage("dma","loading VMM runtime");
    if(!vmm_dll_)vmm_dll_=LoadLibraryA("vmm.dll");
    if(!vmm_dll_){status.text="vmm.dll could not be loaded";plat_log("DMA: %s (Windows error %lu)",status.text.c_str(),GetLastError());plat_stage("dma",status.text);return false;}
    INIT initf=(INIT)fn("VMMDLL_Initialize");INITEX initex=(INITEX)fn("VMMDLL_InitializeEx");
    if(!initf&&!initex){status.text="vmm.dll has no initialization export";plat_log("DMA: %s",status.text.c_str());plat_stage("dma",status.text);return false;}
    HMODULE leech=GetModuleHandleA("leechcore.dll");if(!leech)leech=LoadLibraryA("leechcore.dll");
    auto release=(void(*)(void*)) (leech?GetProcAddress(leech,"LcMemFree"):nullptr);
    static u64 last_report=0;bool report=now_ms()-last_report>30000;
    std::string reason;
    auto attempt=[&](const char* mode,DWORD argc,const char* argv[]){
        ErrorInfo* error=nullptr;reason.clear();u64 started=now_ms();
        plat_stage("dma",std::string("initializing ")+mode);plat_log("DMA initialization started: %s",mode);
        vmm_=initex?initex(argc,argv,&error):initf(argc,argv);
        plat_log("DMA initialization returned: %s, result=%s, elapsed=%llu ms",mode,vmm_?"connected":"failed",(unsigned long long)(now_ms()-started));
        if(error){
            if(error->version==0xc0fe0002&&error->bytes>=offsetof(ErrorInfo,text)&&error->chars){
                size_t available=(error->bytes - offsetof(ErrorInfo,text))/sizeof(WCHAR);size_t count=std::min<size_t>(error->chars,available);
                std::wstring wide(error->text,count);while(!wide.empty()&&wide.back()==0)wide.pop_back();
                int bytes=WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8,0,wide.data(),(int)wide.size(),nullptr,0,nullptr,nullptr);
                if(bytes>0){std::string detail(bytes,'\0');WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8,0,wide.data(),(int)wide.size(),detail.data(),bytes,nullptr,nullptr);reason=detail;}
            }
            if(release)release(error);
        }
        if(vmm_){
            using GetConfig=BOOL(*)(vmm_api::Handle,ULONG64,PULONG64);auto getconfig=(GetConfig)fn("VMMDLL_ConfigGet");
            auto query=[&](const char* name,ULONG64 option,std::atomic<u64>& destination){
                destination=unavailable;if(!getconfig){plat_log("DMA metadata %s: unavailable (ConfigGet export missing)",name);return;}
                ULONG64 value=0;plat_stage("dma",std::string("reading metadata: ")+name);
                if(getconfig(vmm_,option,&value)){destination=value;plat_log("DMA metadata %s: %s",name,diagnostic_value(value,true).c_str());}
                else plat_log("DMA metadata %s: unsupported/unavailable",name);
            };
            // VMMDLL_ConfigGet accepts read-only LeechCore LC_OPT values.
            query("VMM major",0x2000000900000000ULL,vmm_major_);query("VMM minor",0x2000000A00000000ULL,vmm_minor_);query("VMM revision",0x2000000B00000000ULL,vmm_revision_);
            plat_log("VMM runtime version: %s.%s.%s",diagnostic_value(vmm_major_.load()).c_str(),diagnostic_value(vmm_minor_.load()).c_str(),diagnostic_value(vmm_revision_.load()).c_str());
            query("FPGA device ID",0x0300008000000000ULL,fpga_device_id_);query("FPGA ID",0x0300008100000000ULL,fpga_id_);
            query("FPGA version major",0x0300008200000000ULL,fpga_major_);query("FPGA version minor",0x0300008300000000ULL,fpga_minor_);
            for(const char* dll:{"vmm.dll","leechcore.dll","ftd3xx.dll"}){char path[2048]{};HMODULE module=GetModuleHandleA(dll);if(module&&GetModuleFileNameA(module,path,sizeof(path)))plat_log("Loaded runtime: %s",path);}
            target_pid_=0;total_read_bytes=0;read_errors=0;scalar_read_calls=0;scatter_calls=0;scatter_requests=0;requested_read_bytes=0;via_vmm_=true;ready_=true;status.ok=true;status.text=std::string("DMA connected (")+mode+")";
            plat_log("%s",status.text.c_str());plat_log("%s",diagnostics().c_str());plat_stage("dma","ready");return true;
        }
        plat_stage("dma",std::string("initialization failed: ")+mode);
        if(report)plat_log("DMA: %s initialization failed%s%s",mode,reason.empty()?"":": ",reason.empty()?"":reason.c_str());return false;
    };
    const char* plain[]={"","-device","fpga"};const char* verbose[]={"","-device","fpga","-printf","-v"};
    const char* algo1[]={"","-device","fpga://algo=1","-printf","-v"};const char* algo2[]={"","-device","fpga://algo=2","-printf","-v"};
    if(attempt("fpga",3,plain)||attempt("fpga verbose",5,verbose)||attempt("fpga algo=1",5,algo1)||attempt("fpga algo=2",5,algo2))return true;
    status.ok=false;status.text=reason.empty()?"ACE could not initialize FPGA (no VMM detail returned)":reason;plat_stage("dma","connection failed; awaiting retry");
    if(report){plat_log("DMA connection failed: %s",status.text.c_str());last_report=now_ms();}return false;
}
bool Reader::init_local(){
    invalidate_attachment_epoch();
    HANDLE snap=CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS,0);PROCESSENTRY32W pe{};pe.dwSize=sizeof(pe);DWORD pid=0;
    if(snap!=INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE){if(Process32FirstW(snap,&pe)){do{if(games::from_process(pe.szExeFile)){pid=pe.th32ProcessID;break;}}while(Process32NextW(snap,&pe));}CloseHandle(snap);}
    if(!pid){status.text="game not found (dev mode)";return false;}
    local_proc_=OpenProcess(PROCESS_VM_READ|PROCESS_VM_WRITE|PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION,FALSE,pid);
    if(!local_proc_){status.text="cannot open game (admin?)";plat_log("FAILED: cannot open game - run as admin");return false;}
    target_pid_=pid;via_vmm_=false;ready_=true;status.ok=true;status.text="local read mode (dev)";plat_log("Memory: local dev read mode");return true;
}
bool Reader::read_vmm(u64 addr,void* buf,u32 size){
    auto read=(vmm_api::Read)fn("VMMDLL_MemReadEx");DWORD pid=target_pid_.load();if(!read||!pid||!buf||!size)return false;
    DWORD got=0;if(!read(vmm_,pid,addr,(PBYTE)buf,size,&got,1)||got!=size){
        u32 failures=read_errors.fetch_add(1)+1;static std::atomic<u64> last_report{0};u64 now=now_ms();
        if(failures<=3||now-last_report.load()>5000){last_report=now;plat_log("VMM read failed: PID=%lu address=0x%llX requested=%u transferred=%lu total_failures=%u",(unsigned long)pid,(unsigned long long)addr,size,(unsigned long)got,failures);}return false;
    }
    total_read_bytes.fetch_add(got);return true;
}
bool Reader::read_local(u64 addr,void* buf,u32 size){
    SIZE_T got=0;if(!ReadProcessMemory(local_proc_,(LPCVOID)(uintptr_t)addr,buf,size,&got)||(u32)got!=size){read_errors.fetch_add(1);return false;}total_read_bytes.fetch_add(size);return true;
}
bool Reader::read(u64 a,void* b,u32 s){scalar_read_calls.fetch_add(1);if(!ready())return false;requested_read_bytes.fetch_add(s);return via_vmm_.load()?read_vmm(a,b,s):read_local(a,b,s);}
bool Reader::read_batch(u64 a,void* b,u32 s){return read(a,b,s);}
bool Reader::scatter(std::vector<DmaRead>& requests){
    for(auto& r:requests){r.valid=false;r.transferred=0;}
    if(!ready()||requests.empty()||requests.size()>8192)return false;
    const DWORD pid=target_pid_.load();if(!pid)return false;
    u64 total=0;for(const auto& r:requests){if(!r.data||!r.size||r.address<0x10000||r.address>0x00007fffffffffffULL-r.size||r.size>8u*1024*1024)return false;total+=r.size;if(total>32u*1024*1024)return false;}
    scatter_calls.fetch_add(1);scatter_requests.fetch_add(requests.size());requested_read_bytes.fetch_add(total);
    if(!via_vmm_.load()){for(auto& r:requests){r.valid=read_local(r.address,r.data,r.size);r.transferred=r.valid?r.size:0;}return true;}
    const dma_scatter::Api api{(dma_scatter::Start)fn("VMMDLL_Scatter_Initialize"),(dma_scatter::Prepare)fn("VMMDLL_Scatter_PrepareEx"),(dma_scatter::Execute)fn("VMMDLL_Scatter_ExecuteRead"),(dma_scatter::Clear)fn("VMMDLL_Scatter_Clear"),(dma_scatter::Close)fn("VMMDLL_Scatter_CloseHandle")};
    if(!api.available()){read_errors.fetch_add((u32)requests.size());return false;}
    const auto epoch=attachment_epoch();
    const bool executed=scatter_session_.read(api,vmm_,pid,epoch,requests);
    const bool current=dma_scatter::same_context(ready(),pid,target_pid_.load(),epoch,attachment_epoch());
    for(auto& r:requests){r.valid=current&&r.valid&&r.transferred==r.size;if(r.valid)total_read_bytes.fetch_add(r.size);else{r.transferred=0;read_errors.fetch_add(1);}}
    return executed;
}
bool Reader::write(u64 a,const void* b,u32 s){

    if(!via_vmm_.load()&&local_proc_){SIZE_T got=0;return WriteProcessMemory(local_proc_,(LPVOID)(uintptr_t)a,(LPCVOID)b,s,&got)&&(u32)got==s;}
    auto write=(vmm_api::Write)fn("VMMDLL_MemWrite");DWORD pid=target_pid_.load();return write&&pid&&write(vmm_,pid,a,(PBYTE)b,s);
}
bool Reader::read_hwid(std::string& out){
    HKEY k=nullptr;
    if(RegOpenKeyExA(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE,"SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Cryptography",0,KEY_READ|KEY_WOW64_64KEY,&k)==ERROR_SUCCESS){
        char buf[128]{};DWORD sz=sizeof(buf)-1;if(RegQueryValueExA(k,"MachineGuid",0,0,(BYTE*)buf,&sz)==ERROR_SUCCESS){RegCloseKey(k);out=buf;return true;}RegCloseKey(k);
    }
    out="unknown-hwid";return false;
}

bool Reader::find_process(const GameModule& game){
    invalidate_attachment_epoch();
    if(!ready())return false;if(!via_vmm_.load())return local_proc_&&target_pid_.load()!=0;
    auto lookup=(vmm_api::Pid)fn("VMMDLL_PidGetFromName");if(!lookup){target_pid_=0;plat_log("Process discovery unavailable: VMMDLL_PidGetFromName export missing");return false;}
    std::array<std::string,4> converted;std::array<const char*,4> aliases{};
    for(unsigned i=0;i<4&&game.exes[i];i++){char name[260]{};if(WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8,0,game.exes[i],-1,name,sizeof(name),nullptr,nullptr)>0){converted[i]=name;aliases[i]=converted[i].c_str();}}
    auto search=[&](){return vmm_api::first_pid(aliases.data(),aliases.size(),[&](const char* name,PDWORD pid){u64 started=now_ms();plat_stage("attach",std::string("PID lookup: ")+name);BOOL found=lookup(vmm_,name,pid);plat_log("PID lookup %s: %s, PID=%lu, elapsed=%llu ms",name,found&&*pid?"found":"not found",(unsigned long)*pid,(unsigned long long)(now_ms()-started));return found;});};
    DWORD selected=search();if(!selected&&refresh_process_list())selected=search();
    target_pid_=selected;if(selected)plat_log("Game process selected: %s, PID=%lu (main EXE module lookup is not required)",game.name,(unsigned long)selected);return selected!=0;
}
u64 Reader::module_base(const char* name){
    if(!ready()||!name||!*name)return 0;
    if(via_vmm_.load()){
        auto get_base=(vmm_api::Module)fn("VMMDLL_ProcessGetModuleBaseU");DWORD pid=target_pid_.load();
        if(!get_base||!pid){plat_log("Module lookup unavailable: %s (PID=%lu, export=%s)",name,(unsigned long)pid,get_base?"present":"missing");return 0;}
        u64 start=now_ms();plat_stage("attach",std::string("module lookup: ")+name);u64 base=get_base(vmm_,pid,name);plat_log("Module %s: PID=%lu base=0x%llX elapsed=%llu ms",name,(unsigned long)pid,(unsigned long long)base,(unsigned long long)(now_ms()-start));return base;
    }
    HMODULE mods[512];DWORD cb=0;
    if(local_proc_&&EnumProcessModules(local_proc_,mods,sizeof(mods),&cb))for(DWORD i=0;i<std::min<DWORD>(cb/sizeof(HMODULE),512);i++){char nm[64];if(GetModuleBaseNameA(local_proc_,mods[i],nm,64)&&_stricmp(nm,name)==0)return (u64)mods[i];}
    return 0;
}
u64 Reader::find_pattern(u64 start,u64 size,const char* pattern,const char* mask){
    if(!pattern||!mask||!*mask||size==0)return 0;const u32 PMAX=64;u32 plen=(u32)strlen(mask);if(plen>PMAX)plen=PMAX;std::vector<u8> window(0x10000);
    for(u64 off=0;off+plen<size;off+=0x9000){u32 chunk=(u32)(((off+0x10000)<size)?0x10000:(size-off));if(chunk<plen)break;if(!read(start+off,window.data(),chunk))continue;

    return 0;
}

static void draw_entity(ImDrawList* dl,const Entity& e,const esp_render::Local& me,u64 W,u64 H,const esp_render::Snapshot& frame){
    if(e.cls==EClass::Player&&e.alive_valid&&!e.alive)return;
    Settings::VisualScope side(e.cls==EClass::Player&&e.team==me.team);
    if(!(e.cls==EClass::Player?cfg.B("esp.enabled"):cfg.B("world.enabled")))return;
    float d=world_units::metres(me.pos.dist(e.pos));
    if(d>(float)cfg.I("esp.draw_distance")) return;
    Vec2 sp=esp_render::project(frame,e.pos,W,H);
    if(sp.x<-1000.f) return;
    Color base=e.cls==EClass::Player?(e.visible?cfg.C("esp.color_visible"):cfg.C("esp.color_hidden"))
              :e.cls==EClass::NPC?cfg.C("esp.color_npcs")
              :e.cls==EClass::World?cfg.C("esp.color_world"):cfg.C("esp.color_proj");
    float fade=esp_distance_alpha(d);if(fade<=0)return;
    auto element=[&](const char* feature){return esp_rgba(e.cls==EClass::Player?esp_element_color(feature,e.visible):base,fade);};
    ImU32 col=element("box");
    std::array<Vec3,8> corners;float x1=1e9f,y1=1e9f,x2=-1e9f,y2=-1e9f;
    if(target_geometry::corners(e,corners)){
        for(auto point:corners){Vec2 p=esp_render::project(frame,point,W,H);if(p.x<-1000)return;x1=std::min(x1,p.x);x2=std::max(x2,p.x);y1=std::min(y1,p.y);y2=std::max(y2,p.y);}
    }else{Vec2 top=esp_render::project(frame,e.pos+Vec3{0,0,80*std::clamp(e.scale,.1f,10.f)},W,H);if(top.x<-1000)return;float height=std::fabs(sp.y-top.y);x1=sp.x-height*.21f;x2=sp.x+height*.21f;y1=std::min(top.y,sp.y);y2=std::max(top.y,sp.y);}
    float bh=y2-y1;if(bh<2||x2-x1<1)return;
    if(e.cls==EClass::Player)esp_box(dl,x1,y1,x2,y2,e.visible,fade);
    else if(cfg.B("esp.box"))dl->AddRect({x1,y1},{x2,y2},esp_rgba(base,fade),0,0,cfg.F("esp.box_width"));
    if(entity_health::pair(e))esp_health(dl,x1,y1,x2,y2,e.hp,e.max_hp,e.visible,fade);
    if(cfg.B("esp.head_circle")){
        ImU32 col=element("head_circle");
        Vec3 region;if(frame.native_binding_epoch==snap.native_binding_epoch.load()&&native_target::point(e,0,region,frame.native_binding_epoch,mem.attachment_epoch(),now_ms())){Vec2 hpp=esp_render::project(frame,region,W,H);
            if(hpp.x>-1000.f)dl->AddCircle({hpp.x,hpp.y},clampf(bh*.055f,2.f,18.f),col,16,cfg.F("esp.head_circle_width"));}
    }
    if(cfg.B("esp.tracers")){
        dl->AddLine({(float)W/2.f,(float)H},{sp.x,y2},element("tracers"),cfg.F("esp.tracers_width"));
    }
    using namespace esp_elements;char soul_text[48]{},distance_text[32]{};snprintf(soul_text,sizeof(soul_text),"%llu souls",(unsigned long long)e.souls);snprintf(distance_text,sizeof(distance_text),"%.0fm",d);
    const char* actor_name=!e.display_name.empty()?e.display_name.c_str():(e.settings_subject.kind==profile_subject::Kind::Hero&&!e.settings_subject.name.empty()?e.settings_subject.name.c_str():"Player");
    const char* text[]={actor_name,soul_text,distance_text,"ULT READY"};std::array<bool,Count> enabled{};std::array<ImVec2,Count> sizes{};std::array<ability_tracking::View,4> states{};
    bool player=e.cls==EClass::Player;const float game_time=player?frame.game_time:0;
    // A newer reader publish cannot make this copied entity artificially fresh.
    const bool fresh=player&&frame.ability_fresh(now_ms());
    for(int i=0;i<4;i++)states[i]=ability_tracking::view(e,i,game_time,fresh);auto row=ability_row(states,cfg.F("esp.ability_size"),cfg.B("esp.ability_seconds"));
    enabled[Name]=player&&cfg.B("esp.name");enabled[Souls]=player&&e.souls>0&&cfg.B("esp.souls");enabled[Distance]=cfg.B("esp.distance");enabled[Ultimate]=player&&cfg.B("esp.ultimate")&&states[3].state==ability_tracking::State::Ready;enabled[Abilities]=player&&cfg.B("esp.abilities");
    for(int i=0;i<Count;i++)sizes[i]=i==Abilities?row.size:ImGui::GetFont()->CalcTextSizeA(esp_text_size(features[i]),1e10f,0,text[i]);
    auto blocks=place(enabled,sizes,x1,y1,x2,y2);
    for(int i=0;i<Count;i++)if(blocks[i].enabled){if(i==Abilities)draw_abilities(dl,blocks[i].position,row,fade);else esp_text(dl,features[i],blocks[i].position,i==Ultimate?esp_rgba(cfg.C("esp.ultimate_color"),fade):element(features[i]),text[i]);}

}
static void world_icon(ImDrawList* draw,ImVec2 p,world_labels::Icon icon,ImU32 color,float size){
    using Icon=world_labels::Icon;const float scale=size/8.f;
    auto q=[&](float x,float y){return ImVec2{p.x+x*scale,p.y+y*scale};};
    if(icon==Icon::Health){draw->AddRectFilled(q(-1.4f,-4),q(1.4f,4),color);draw->AddRectFilled(q(-4,-1.4f),q(4,1.4f),color);}
    else if(icon==Icon::Crate||icon==Icon::Drawing){draw->AddRect(q(-4,-4),q(4,4),color,scale,0,1.3f*scale);if(icon==Icon::Crate){draw->AddLine(q(-4,-4),q(4,4),color,scale);draw->AddLine(q(-4,4),q(4,-4),color,scale);}else draw->AddLine(q(-2,2),q(2,-2),color,scale);}
    else if(icon==Icon::Rejuvenator||icon==Icon::Idol){draw->AddQuad(q(0,-5),q(4,0),q(0,5),q(-4,0),color,1.4f*scale);if(icon==Icon::Rejuvenator)draw->AddCircleFilled(p,1.2f*scale,color,8);}
    else if(icon==Icon::Breakable){draw->AddLine(q(-4,4),q(4,-4),color,1.5f*scale);draw->AddLine(q(-1,-4),q(4,-1),color,1.5f*scale);}
    else if(icon==Icon::Candy){draw->AddCircle(p,2.5f*scale,color,10,1.4f*scale);draw->AddLine(q(-3,0),q(-5,-2),color,scale);draw->AddLine(q(3,0),q(5,2),color,scale);}
    else{draw->AddCircle(p,4*scale,color,12,1.4f*scale);if(icon==Icon::Currency)draw->AddCircleFilled(p,1.3f*scale,color,8);}
}
static void draw_world(ImDrawList* draw,const Entity& entity,const esp_render::Local& local,u64 width,u64 height,const esp_render::Snapshot& frame,const world_style_config::Styles& styles){
    if(!cfg.B("world.enabled")||!cfg.B("cls.world")||entity.cls!=EClass::World||!entity.base||entity.world_obstacle)return;
    const auto* definition=world_labels::find(entity.type_name);if(!definition)return;
    const auto category=world_style_catalog::index(*definition);if(category==world_style_catalog::missing)return;
    const auto& style=styles[category];if(!world_style_config::visible(style))return;
    const float distance=world_units::metres(local.pos.dist(entity.pos));if(!std::isfinite(distance)||distance>style.draw_distance)return;
    const float fade=esp_distance_alpha(distance);if(fade<=0)return;
    const auto point=esp_render::project(frame,entity.pos,width,height);const float margin=style.icon?std::max(6.f,style.icon_size*5.f/8.f+1.f):2.f;
    if(!std::isfinite(point.x)||!std::isfinite(point.y)||point.x<margin||point.y<margin||point.x>static_cast<float>(width)-margin||point.y>static_cast<float>(height)-margin)return;
    const ImU32 color=esp_rgba(style.color,fade);
    if(style.icon)world_icon(draw,{point.x,point.y},definition->icon,color,style.icon_size);
    if(!style.label&&!style.distance)return;
    char text[128]{};
    if(style.label&&style.distance)snprintf(text,sizeof(text),"%s  %.0fm",definition->label,distance);
    else if(style.label)snprintf(text,sizeof(text),"%s",definition->label);
    else snprintf(text,sizeof(text),"%.0fm",distance);
    const auto size=ImGui::GetFont()->CalcTextSizeA(style.text_size,1e10f,0,text);
    const ImVec2 position{point.x-size.x*.5f,point.y+(style.icon?style.icon_size*5.f/8.f+2.f:0.f)};
    if(style.outline)for(auto offset:{ImVec2{-1,0},ImVec2{1,0},ImVec2{0,-1},ImVec2{0,1}})draw->AddText(ImGui::GetFont(),style.text_size,{position.x+offset.x,position.y+offset.y},IM_COL32(0,0,0,(color>>24)&255),text);
    draw->AddText(ImGui::GetFont(),style.text_size,position,color,text);
}
// Independent screen-space presentation of the already captured projectile point.
static void draw_projectile(ImDrawList* draw,const Vec3& position,const esp_render::Snapshot& frame,u64 width,u64 height,const projectile_presentation::Style& style){
    if(!projectile_presentation::visible(style))return;
    const float distance=world_units::metres(frame.local.pos.dist(position));
    if(!projectile_presentation::in_range(distance,style.max_dist))return;
    const auto point=esp_render::project(frame,position,width,height);
    const float radius=style.marker_size*.5f,margin=style.marker?radius+2.f:1.f;
    if(!std::isfinite(point.x)||!std::isfinite(point.y)||point.x<margin||point.y<margin||point.x>static_cast<float>(width)-margin||point.y>static_cast<float>(height)-margin)return;
    const ImU32 color=IM_COL32(static_cast<int>(style.color.r*255),static_cast<int>(style.color.g*255),static_cast<int>(style.color.b*255),static_cast<int>(style.color.a*255));
    const ImU32 outline=IM_COL32(0,0,0,(color>>24)&255);
    if(style.marker){
        const ImVec2 top{point.x,point.y-radius},right{point.x+radius,point.y},bottom{point.x,point.y+radius},left{point.x-radius,point.y};
        draw->AddQuad(top,right,bottom,left,outline,3.f);draw->AddQuad(top,right,bottom,left,color,1.5f);
    }
    if(!style.name&&!style.distance)return;
    char text[64]{};
    if(style.name&&style.distance)snprintf(text,sizeof(text),"Projectile  %.0fm",distance);
    else if(style.name)snprintf(text,sizeof(text),"Projectile");
    else snprintf(text,sizeof(text),"%.0fm",distance);
    auto* font=ImGui::GetFont();const auto size=font->CalcTextSizeA(style.font_size,1e10f,0,text);
    const ImVec2 label{clampf(point.x-size.x*.5f,1.f,std::max(1.f,static_cast<float>(width)-size.x-1.f)),clampf(point.y+(style.marker?radius+3.f:0.f),1.f,std::max(1.f,static_cast<float>(height)-size.y-1.f))};
    for(auto offset:{ImVec2{-1,0},ImVec2{1,0},ImVec2{0,-1},ImVec2{0,1}})draw->AddText(font,style.font_size,{label.x+offset.x,label.y+offset.y},outline,text);
    draw->AddText(font,style.font_size,label,color,text);
}

static void draw_minion(ImDrawList* dl,const Entity& e,const esp_render::Local& me,u64 W,u64 H,const esp_render::Snapshot& frame){
    if(!cfg.B("minions.enabled")||(e.alive_valid&&!e.alive))return;bool friendly=e.team==me.team;bool neutral=e.type_name.find("Neutral")!=std::string::npos;bool boss=e.type_name.find("Boss")!=std::string::npos||e.type_name.find("MidBoss")!=std::string::npos;
    if(neutral&&!cfg.B("minions.neutral"))return;if(boss&&!cfg.B("minions.bosses"))return;if(!neutral&&!boss&&!cfg.B("minions.troopers"))return;
    if(friendly?!cfg.B("minions.friendly"):!cfg.B("minions.enemy"))return;float distance=world_units::metres(me.pos.dist(e.pos));if(distance>cfg.I("minions.distance_limit"))return;
    Vec3 lower=e.pos,upper=e.pos+Vec3{0,0,64};if(e.bounds_valid){lower=e.pos+e.bounds_min*e.scale;upper=e.pos+e.bounds_max*e.scale;}
    auto bottom=esp_render::project(frame,lower,W,H),top=esp_render::project(frame,upper,W,H);if(bottom.x<-1000||top.x<-1000)return;float h=std::fabs(bottom.y-top.y);if(h<2)return;float x=(bottom.x+top.x)/2,w=h*.42f,y1=std::min(top.y,bottom.y),y2=std::max(top.y,bottom.y);
    ImU32 color=esp_rgba(cfg.C(friendly?"minions.color_friendly":"minions.color_enemy"));if(cfg.B("minions.box"))dl->AddRect({x-w/2,y1},{x+w/2,y2},color);
    if(cfg.B("minions.health")&&entity_health::pair(e)){float p=clampf(e.hp/e.max_hp,0,1);dl->AddRectFilled({x-w/2-5,y1},{x-w/2-2,y2},IM_COL32(8,8,8,200));dl->AddRectFilled({x-w/2-5,y2-h*p},{x-w/2-2,y2},color);}
    if(cfg.B("minions.name")){const char* name=boss?"Boss":neutral?"Neutral camp":"Trooper";auto size=ImGui::CalcTextSize(name);dl->AddText({x-size.x/2,y1-size.y-3},color,name);}
    if(cfg.B("minions.distance")){char text[24];snprintf(text,sizeof(text),"%.0fm",distance);auto size=ImGui::CalcTextSize(text);dl->AddText({x-size.x/2,y2+3},color,text);}
}
void draw(u64 sw,u64 sh){
    if(!cfg.B("visuals.enabled"))return;
    esp_render::Demand demand;const bool players=cfg.B("cls.players");
    auto player_elements=[](){return cfg.B("esp.box")||cfg.B("esp.health")||cfg.B("esp.tracers")||cfg.B("esp.head_circle")||cfg.B("esp.name")||cfg.B("esp.souls")||cfg.B("esp.distance")||cfg.B("esp.ultimate")||cfg.B("esp.abilities");};
    {Settings::VisualScope side(false);demand.enemies=players&&cfg.B("esp.enabled")&&player_elements();}
    {Settings::VisualScope side(true);demand.teammates=players&&cfg.B("esp.enabled")&&player_elements();}
    // Non-player settings are global even if a caller had a teammate scope.
    Settings::VisualScope global(false);
    demand.npcs=cfg.B("minions.enabled")&&(cfg.B("minions.enemy")||cfg.B("minions.friendly"))&&(cfg.B("minions.troopers")||cfg.B("minions.neutral")||cfg.B("minions.bosses"))&&(cfg.B("minions.box")||cfg.B("minions.health")||cfg.B("minions.name")||cfg.B("minions.distance"));
    const bool world_master=cfg.B("world.enabled")&&cfg.B("cls.world");
    const auto world_styles=world_master?world_style_config::resolve(cfg):world_style_config::Styles{};
    demand.world=world_master&&world_style_config::any_visible(world_styles);
    const auto projectile_style=projectile_presentation::normalized(projectile_presentation::Style{cfg.B("projectiles.marker"),cfg.B("projectiles.name"),cfg.B("projectiles.distance"),cfg.F("projectiles.marker_size"),cfg.F("projectiles.font_size"),cfg.I("projectiles.max_dist"),cfg.C("esp.color_proj")});
    demand.projectiles=cfg.B("world.enabled")&&cfg.B("cls.projectiles")&&projectile_presentation::visible(projectile_style);
    if(!demand.any())return;
    // Capacity reuse only: every successful draw recaptures data under ONE lock.
    // Failed capture returns without consuming old buffer contents.
    static thread_local esp_render::Snapshot frame;
    if(!esp_render::capture(snap,snap_mtx,demand,[]{return now_ms();},frame))return;
    const auto& me=frame.local;ImDrawList* dl=ImGui::GetBackgroundDrawList();
    for(const auto& e:frame.enemies)draw_entity(dl,e,me,sw,sh,frame);
    for(const auto& e:frame.npcs)draw_minion(dl,e,me,sw,sh,frame);
    for(const auto& e:frame.world)draw_world(dl,e,me,sw,sh,frame,world_styles);
    for(const auto& e:frame.projectiles)draw_projectile(dl,e.pos,frame,sw,sh,projectile_style);
    for(const auto& e:frame.teammates)draw_entity(dl,e,me,sw,sh,frame);
}

static std::atomic<bool> run_flag{false},alive{false};
static std::atomic<int> error_code{0};
static std::thread server;
static int bound_port=0;static bool bound_loopback=true;
int current_port(){return bound_port;}
bool loopback_only(){return bound_loopback;}
static std::string pin;
const char* current_pin(){return pin.c_str();}
bool running(){return alive;}
std::string status_text(){int e=error_code;return e?"Radar failed (socket error "+std::to_string(e)+")":(alive?"Radar running":(run_flag?"Starting radar...":"Radar stopped"));}
void stop(){run_flag=false;if(server.joinable())server.join();alive=false;}

static bool send_all(SOCKET socket,const std::string& bytes){
    size_t offset=0;const auto deadline=now_ms()+4000;
    while(offset<bytes.size()&&run_flag&&now_ms()<deadline){
        const int count=send(socket,bytes.data()+offset,(int)std::min<size_t>(65536,bytes.size()-offset),0);
        if(count>0){offset+=count;continue;}
        if(count==0)return false;
        const int error=WSAGetLastError();
        if(error!=WSAEWOULDBLOCK&&error!=WSAEINTR)return false;
        fd_set writable;FD_ZERO(&writable);FD_SET(socket,&writable);timeval timeout{0,50000};
        if(select(0,nullptr,&writable,nullptr,&timeout)==SOCKET_ERROR&&WSAGetLastError()!=WSAEINTR)return false;
    }
    return offset==bytes.size();
}
static bool send_response(SOCKET socket,const char* status,const char* type,const std::string& body){
    std::string response=std::string("HTTP/1.1 ")+status+"\r\nContent-Type: "+type+"\r\nContent-Length: "+std::to_string(body.size())+"\r\nConnection: close\r\nCache-Control: no-store\r\nReferrer-Policy: no-referrer\r\nX-Content-Type-Options: nosniff\r\n\r\n"+body;
    return send_all(socket,response);
}
static bool receive_headers(SOCKET socket,std::string& request){
    const auto deadline=now_ms()+1000;char chunk[2048];
    while(run_flag&&now_ms()<deadline){
        int count=recv(socket,chunk,sizeof(chunk),0);
        if(count>0){if(request.size()+(size_t)count>8192)return false;request.append(chunk,count);if(request.find("\r\n\r\n")!=std::string::npos)return true;continue;}
        if(count==0)return false;int error=WSAGetLastError();if(error!=WSAEWOULDBLOCK&&error!=WSAEINTR)return false;
        fd_set readable;FD_ZERO(&readable);FD_SET(socket,&readable);timeval timeout{0,50000};
        if(select(0,&readable,nullptr,nullptr,&timeout)==SOCKET_ERROR&&WSAGetLastError()!=WSAEINTR)return false;
    }
    return false;
}
struct MapAssets{json document={{"version",1},{"maps",json::object()}};std::map<std::string,std::string> png;};
// Presentation-only copy of already-published snapshot fields; no target reads.
struct RadarXY{
    float x=0,y=0,hp=0,max_hp=0,ultimate_end=0,ultimate_stopped=0;
    u64 id=0,source_ms=0,ultimate_ms=0;u32 hero=0;const char* team="";
    bool hp_valid=false,max_hp_valid=false,hp_pair_valid=false;
    bool ultimate_valid=false,ultimate_trained=false;
};
struct RadarReadout{
    bool attached=false,frame_valid=false;u64 sample_ms=0,session_epoch=0;
    float game_time=0,reader_hz=0;std::string map;std::vector<RadarXY> points;
};
static RadarReadout capture_radar(){
    RadarReadout result;result.points.reserve(32);
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(snap_mtx);
        result.attached=snap.in_match.load();result.frame_valid=snap.frame_valid.load();
        result.sample_ms=snap.last_read_ms.load();result.session_epoch=snap.native_binding_epoch.load();
        result.map=snap.map_name;result.game_time=snap.game_time;result.reader_hz=snap.read_hz_exact.load();
        auto add=[&](const Entity& e,const char* team){
            if(!e.base||!e.valid||!std::isfinite(e.pos.x)||!std::isfinite(e.pos.y))return;
            RadarXY point;point.x=e.pos.x;point.y=e.pos.y;point.id=e.base;point.team=team;
            point.source_ms=e.host_sample_ms;point.hero=e.hero;
            point.hp=e.hp;point.max_hp=e.max_hp;point.hp_valid=e.health_current_valid;
            point.max_hp_valid=e.health_max_valid;point.hp_pair_valid=e.health_pair_valid;
            point.ultimate_valid=e.public_ultimate_valid;point.ultimate_trained=e.public_ultimate_trained;
            point.ultimate_end=e.public_ultimate_cooldown_end;point.ultimate_stopped=e.public_ultimate_stopped_remaining;
            point.ultimate_ms=e.public_ultimate_sample_ms;result.points.push_back(point);
        };
        for(const auto& e:snap.enemies)add(e,"enemy");
        for(const auto& e:snap.friendlies)add(e,"friendly");add(snap.local,"local");
    }
    return result;
}
static json radar_age(u64 source_ms,u64 served_ms){return source_ms&&served_ms>=source_ms?json(served_ms-source_ms):json(nullptr);}
static bool radar_source_fresh(u64 source_ms,u64 served_ms){return source_ms&&served_ms>=source_ms&&served_ms-source_ms<=250;}
static json radar_entity(const RadarXY& point,const RadarReadout& readout,u64 served_ms){
    const char* name=hero_name_by_id(point.hero);
    const bool known_hero=point.hero&&name&&name[0]&&std::string(name)!="Unknown";
    const bool hp_known=point.hp_valid&&std::isfinite(point.hp);
    const bool max_hp_known=point.max_hp_valid&&std::isfinite(point.max_hp)&&point.max_hp>0;
    const bool pair_known=point.hp_pair_valid&&hp_known&&max_hp_known;
    const bool ultimate_known=point.ultimate_valid&&radar_source_fresh(point.ultimate_ms,served_ms)&&std::isfinite(readout.game_time)&&std::isfinite(point.ultimate_end)&&std::isfinite(point.ultimate_stopped);
    json ultimate={{"valid",ultimate_known},{"source_ms",point.ultimate_ms},{"age_ms",radar_age(point.ultimate_ms,served_ms)},{"trained",nullptr},{"ready",nullptr},{"remaining_seconds",nullptr}};
    if(ultimate_known){
        ultimate["trained"]=point.ultimate_trained;
        if(point.ultimate_trained){
            const float remaining=std::max(point.ultimate_stopped,point.ultimate_end-readout.game_time);
            ultimate["ready"]=remaining<=0;
            // Sampled public cooldown only. A browser clock must not run down paused time.
            ultimate["remaining_seconds"]=std::clamp(remaining,0.f,36000.f);
        }
    }
    return {{"x",point.x},{"y",point.y},{"id",std::to_string(point.id)},{"team",point.team},
        {"source_ms",point.source_ms},{"source_age_ms",radar_age(point.source_ms,served_ms)},
        {"hero_id",point.hero},{"hero_name",known_hero?json(name):json(nullptr)},
        {"hp",hp_known?json(point.hp):json(nullptr)},{"max_hp",max_hp_known?json(point.max_hp):json(nullptr)},
        {"hp_pair_valid",pair_known},{"ultimate",std::move(ultimate)}};
}
static bool safe_name(const std::string& name){return !name.empty()&&name.size()<=48&&std::all_of(name.begin(),name.end(),[](unsigned char c){return(c>='a'&&c<='z')||(c>='0'&&c<='9')||c=='_'||c=='-';});}
static bool read_bounded(const std::filesystem::path& path,size_t maximum,std::string& bytes){
    std::ifstream input(path,std::ios::binary|std::ios::ate);if(!input)return false;const auto size=input.tellg();if(size<=0||(uint64_t)size>maximum)return false;bytes.resize((size_t)size);input.seekg(0);return(bool)input.read(bytes.data(),(std::streamsize)bytes.size());
}
static MapAssets load_map_assets(){
    MapAssets assets;wchar_t path[4096]{};const DWORD count=GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr,path,4096);if(!count||count>=4096)return assets;
    const auto directory=std::filesystem::path(path).parent_path()/"assets"/"radar";std::string text;
    if(!read_bounded(directory/"maps.json",65536,text)){plat_log("Radar: map-image configuration unavailable; custom browser calibration remains available");return assets;}
    try{
        const auto config=json::parse(text);if(config.value("version",0)!=1||!config.contains("maps")||!config["maps"].is_object()||config["maps"].size()>16)return assets;
        for(auto it=config["maps"].begin();it!=config["maps"].end();++it){
            try{
                const auto id=it.key();const auto& row=it.value();if(!safe_name(id)||!row.is_object())continue;
                const std::string filename=row.value("image","");if(filename.size()<5||!filename.ends_with(".png")||!safe_name(filename.substr(0,filename.size()-4)))continue;
                auto transform=row.at("transform");bool valid=transform.is_object();
                for(auto key:{"origin_x","origin_y","world_width","world_height","rotation_degrees","offset_u","offset_v"})valid=valid&&transform.contains(key)&&transform[key].is_number()&&std::isfinite(transform[key].get<double>());
                if(!valid)continue;
                if(std::abs(transform["origin_x"].get<double>())>1e8||std::abs(transform["origin_y"].get<double>())>1e8||transform["world_width"].get<double>()<=0||transform["world_width"].get<double>()>1e8||transform["world_height"].get<double>()<=0||transform["world_height"].get<double>()>1e8||std::abs(transform["rotation_degrees"].get<double>())>3600||std::abs(transform["offset_u"].get<double>())>10||std::abs(transform["offset_v"].get<double>())>10)continue;
                if(!transform.contains("flip_x")||!transform["flip_x"].is_boolean()||!transform.contains("flip_y")||!transform["flip_y"].is_boolean())continue;
                std::string image;if(!read_bounded(directory/filename,4*1024*1024,image)||image.size()<24||std::memcmp(image.data(),"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n",8)||std::memcmp(image.data()+12,"IHDR",4))continue;
                auto dimension=[&](size_t at){return(uint32_t)(u8)image[at]<<24|(uint32_t)(u8)image[at+1]<<16|(uint32_t)(u8)image[at+2]<<8|(u8)image[at+3];};
                const auto width=dimension(16),height=dimension(20);if(!width||!height||width>4096||height>4096)continue;
                const auto label=row.value("label",id),provenance=row.value("provenance",std::string()),key=row.value("calibration_key",id);
                if(label.size()>160||provenance.size()>1024||key.size()>128)continue;
                assets.document["maps"][id]={{"label",label},{"transform",transform},{"calibration_key",key},{"provenance",provenance}};
                assets.png.emplace(id,std::move(image));plat_log("Radar: loaded map image %s (%ux%u); world transform comes from maps.json, live alignment not verified",id.c_str(),width,height);
            }catch(const std::exception&){plat_log("Radar: rejected invalid map-image profile");}
        }
    }catch(const std::exception&){plat_log("Radar: invalid map-image configuration");}
    return assets;
}
static bool authorized(const std::string& path,const std::string& expected){
    auto q=path.find('?');if(q==std::string::npos)return false;
    std::string query=path.substr(q+1);size_t start=0;
    while(start<query.size()){auto end=query.find('&',start);auto part=query.substr(start,end==std::string::npos?end:end-start);
        if(part=="pin="+expected)return true;if(end==std::string::npos)break;start=end+1;}
    return false;
}
void start(bool loopback){
    stop();error_code=0;pin.clear();for(int i=0;i<6;i++)pin.push_back('0'+(int)rnd_rng(0,9.999f));
    int port=cfg.I("radar.port");bound_port=port;bound_loopback=loopback;std::string access_pin=pin;run_flag=true;
    server=std::thread([port,loopback,access_pin](){
        const MapAssets map_assets=load_map_assets();
        WSADATA w{};int result=WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2,2),&w);
        if(result){error_code=result;run_flag=false;return;}
        SOCKET listener=socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,IPPROTO_TCP);
        if(listener==INVALID_SOCKET){error_code=WSAGetLastError();run_flag=false;WSACleanup();return;}
        sockaddr_in address{};address.sin_family=AF_INET;address.sin_port=htons((u_short)port);
        address.sin_addr.s_addr=htonl(loopback?INADDR_LOOPBACK:INADDR_ANY);
        if(bind(listener,(sockaddr*)&address,sizeof(address))||listen(listener,4)){
            error_code=WSAGetLastError();run_flag=false;closesocket(listener);WSACleanup();return;
        }
        u_long nonblocking=1;if(ioctlsocket(listener,FIONBIO,&nonblocking)){error_code=WSAGetLastError();run_flag=false;closesocket(listener);WSACleanup();return;}alive=true;
        while(run_flag){
            fd_set readable;FD_ZERO(&readable);FD_SET(listener,&readable);timeval timeout{0,50000};
            const int ready=select(0,&readable,nullptr,nullptr,&timeout);
            if(!ready)continue;
            if(ready==SOCKET_ERROR){const int error=WSAGetLastError();if(error==WSAEINTR)continue;error_code=error;run_flag=false;break;}
            SOCKET client=accept(listener,nullptr,nullptr);
            if(client==INVALID_SOCKET){const int error=WSAGetLastError();if(error==WSAEWOULDBLOCK||error==WSAEINTR)continue;error_code=error;run_flag=false;break;}
            if(ioctlsocket(client,FIONBIO,&nonblocking)){closesocket(client);continue;}
            std::string request;if(!receive_headers(client,request)){closesocket(client);continue;}
            const auto line_end=request.find("\r\n"),a=request.find(' '),b=a==std::string::npos?a:request.find(' ',a+1);
            if(a==std::string::npos||b==std::string::npos||b>=line_end||request.substr(0,a)!="GET"){send_response(client,"405 Method Not Allowed","text/plain","GET required");closesocket(client);continue;}
            const std::string path=request.substr(a+1,b-a-1);
            auto q=path.find('?');auto endpoint=path.substr(0,q);
            // Apply the same PIN gate before every route, including the HTML page.
            if(!authorized(path,access_pin)){
                send_response(client,"403 Forbidden","application/json","{\"error\":\"Invalid PIN\"}");
                closesocket(client);continue;
            }
            if(endpoint=="/maps"||endpoint.starts_with("/map-image/")){
                if(!authorized(path,access_pin))send_response(client,"403 Forbidden","application/json","{\"error\":\"Invalid PIN\"}");
                else if(endpoint=="/maps")send_response(client,"200 OK","application/json",map_assets.document.dump());
                else{
                    const std::string id=endpoint.size()>15&&endpoint.ends_with(".png")?endpoint.substr(11,endpoint.size()-15):std::string();
                    const auto image=map_assets.png.find(id);
                    if(image==map_assets.png.end())send_response(client,"404 Not Found","text/plain","Map image not configured");
                    else send_response(client,"200 OK","image/png",image->second);
                }
            }else if(endpoint=="/data"){
                if(!authorized(path,access_pin))send_response(client,"403 Forbidden","application/json","{\"error\":\"Invalid PIN\"}");
                else{
                    const RadarReadout readout=capture_radar();
                    const auto served_ms=now_ms();const bool age_known=readout.sample_ms&&served_ms>=readout.sample_ms;
                    const bool fresh=readout.attached&&readout.frame_valid&&radar_source_fresh(readout.sample_ms,served_ms);
                    // JSON construction and serialization run after releasing snap_mtx.
                    json data={{"ents",json::array()},{"attached",readout.attached},{"frame_valid",readout.frame_valid},{"valid",fresh},{"map_name",readout.map},
                        {"snapshot_ms",readout.sample_ms},{"server_time_ms",served_ms},{"age_ms",age_known?radar_age(readout.sample_ms,served_ms):json(nullptr)},
                        {"session_epoch",std::to_string(readout.session_epoch)},
                        {"reader_hz",std::isfinite(readout.reader_hz)&&readout.reader_hz>0?json(readout.reader_hz):json(nullptr)}};
                    if(fresh)for(const auto& point:readout.points){
                        // Preserve original actor acquisition; a newer frame never freshens a held actor.
                        if(radar_source_fresh(point.source_ms,served_ms))data["ents"].push_back(radar_entity(point,readout,served_ms));
                    }
                    send_response(client,"200 OK","application/json",data.dump());
                }
            }else if(endpoint=="/"){
                const char* html=R"HTML(<!doctype html>

const numericKeys=['origin_x','origin_y','world_width','world_height','rotation_degrees','offset_u','offset_v'];
const defaultTransform={origin_x:0,origin_y:0,world_width:21504,world_height:21504,rotation_degrees:0,flip_x:false,flip_y:true,offset_u:0.5,offset_v:0.5};
let profiles={},lastData={ents:[],attached:false,frame_valid:false,valid:false,map_name:'',age_ms:null},activeId='',profile=null,transform=null,mapImage=null,imageReady=false,imageError='',customUrl='',busy=false;
let refreshHz=20,pollTimer=null,freshnessTimer=null,receivedAt=null,roundTripMs=0,lastNetworkError='',stopped=false,responseTimes=[],sessionEpoch=null;
let view={zoom:1,panX:0,panY:0},drag=null,selectedHeroes=new Set(),allHeroes=true;
const options={showHero:true,showHp:true,showUlt:false,showLocal:true,showFriendly:true,showEnemy:true,lightMap:true,markerSize:6};
try{const saved=Number(localStorage.getItem('aceRadarRefreshHz'));if(allowedRates.includes(saved))refreshHz=saved;}catch{}
ratePicker.value=String(refreshHz);
function elapsedSinceReceipt(){return Number.isFinite(receivedAt)?Math.max(0,performance.now()-receivedAt):Infinity;}
function sourceAge(age){return Number.isFinite(age)&&age>=0?age+roundTripMs+elapsedSinceReceipt():Infinity;}
function currentAge(){return sourceAge(lastData.age_ms);}
function markersFresh(){return lastData.attached===true&&lastData.frame_valid===true&&lastData.valid===true&&currentAge()<=STALE_MS;}
function entityFresh(e){return markersFresh()&&sourceAge(e.source_age_ms)<=STALE_MS;}
function ultimateFresh(e){return entityFresh(e)&&e.ultimate?.valid===true&&sourceAge(e.ultimate.age_ms)<=STALE_MS;}
function measuredWebHz(now){const recent=responseTimes.filter(t=>now-t<=2000);return recent.length>=2?(recent.length-1)*1000/(recent[recent.length-1]-recent[0]):null;}
function rateText(){const web=measuredWebHz(performance.now()),reader=markersFresh()&&Number.isFinite(lastData.reader_hz)&&lastData.reader_hz>0?lastData.reader_hz:null;return 'Web '+(Number.isFinite(web)?web.toFixed(1)+' replies/s':'replies unknown')+' (target '+refreshHz+' Hz) · reader '+(reader===null?'unknown':reader.toFixed(1)+' Hz measured');}
function updateStatus(){const age=currentAge(),ageText=Number.isFinite(age)?'source age ≤'+Math.ceil(age)+' ms':'source age unknown';let text=lastNetworkError||(!lastData.attached?'Waiting for live game data':!lastData.frame_valid?'Invalid snapshot · markers hidden':!markersFresh()?'Stale snapshot · markers hidden':lastData.ents.filter(entityFresh).length+' current entities');document.getElementById('status').textContent=text+' · '+ageText+' · '+rateText();document.getElementById('rates').textContent=rateText();}
function validTransform(t){return !!t&&numericKeys.every(k=>typeof t[k]==='number'&&Number.isFinite(t[k]))&&Math.abs(t.origin_x)<=1e8&&Math.abs(t.origin_y)<=1e8&&t.world_width>0&&t.world_width<=1e8&&t.world_height>0&&t.world_height<=1e8&&Math.abs(t.rotation_degrees)<=3600&&Math.abs(t.offset_u)<=10&&Math.abs(t.offset_v)<=10&&typeof t.flip_x==='boolean'&&typeof t.flip_y==='boolean';}
function worldToMap(x,y,t){const a=t.rotation_degrees*Math.PI/180,c=Math.cos(a),s=Math.sin(a),dx=x-t.origin_x,dy=y-t.origin_y,rx=c*dx-s*dy,ry=s*dx+c*dy;return {u:t.offset_u+(t.flip_x?-rx:rx)/t.world_width,v:t.offset_v+(t.flip_y?-ry:ry)/t.world_height};}
function fitMapRect(width,height,imageWidth,imageHeight){const scale=Math.min(width/imageWidth,height/imageHeight);return {width:imageWidth*scale,height:imageHeight*scale,cx:width/2,cy:height/2};}
function mapToScreen(u,v,rect,state){return {x:rect.cx+state.panX+(u-.5)*rect.width*state.zoom,y:rect.cy+state.panY+(v-.5)*rect.height*state.zoom};}
function screenToMap(x,y,rect,state){return {u:.5+(x-rect.cx-state.panX)/(rect.width*state.zoom),v:.5+(y-rect.cy-state.panY)/(rect.height*state.zoom)};}
function zoomViewAt(state,next,x,y,cx,cy){const zoom=Math.max(1,Math.min(8,next)),ratio=zoom/state.zoom;return {zoom,panX:x-cx-(x-cx-state.panX)*ratio,panY:y-cy-(y-cy-state.panY)*ratio};}
function storageKey(){return 'aceRadarCalibration:'+activeId+':'+(profile?.calibration_key||'custom');}
function resetView(){view={zoom:1,panX:0,panY:0};render();}
function setFields(){for(const k of numericKeys){const input=document.getElementById(k);input.value=transform?transform[k]:'';input.disabled=!transform;}for(const k of ['flip_x','flip_y']){const input=document.getElementById(k);input.checked=!!transform?.[k];input.disabled=!transform;}document.getElementById('source').textContent=profile?.provenance||'Choose a map image to calibrate.';document.getElementById('calibrationError').textContent='';}
function loadImage(url){imageReady=false;imageError='';const image=new Image();mapImage=image;image.onload=()=>{if(mapImage!==image)return;if(!image.naturalWidth||!image.naturalHeight||image.naturalWidth>4096||image.naturalHeight>4096){imageError='Map image must be between 1 and 4096 pixels per side.';render();return;}imageReady=true;render();};image.onerror=()=>{if(mapImage!==image)return;imageError='Map image unavailable. Check the radar image files or PIN.';render();};image.referrerPolicy='no-referrer';image.src=url;}
function chooseMap(){const wanted=picker.value||String(lastData.map_name||'').toLowerCase();if(wanted===activeId)return;activeId=wanted;profile=profiles[wanted]||null;mapImage=null;imageReady=false;imageError='';view={zoom:1,panX:0,panY:0};if(!profile){transform=null;setFields();render();return;}transform={...profile.transform};try{const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey()));if(validTransform(saved))transform=saved;}catch{}setFields();loadImage(wanted==='custom'&&customUrl?customUrl:'/map-image/'+encodeURIComponent(wanted)+'.png?pin='+encodeURIComponent(pin));}
function readFields(){if(!transform)return;const candidate={...transform};for(const k of numericKeys){const input=document.getElementById(k);candidate[k]=input.value.trim()===''?NaN:Number(input.value);}for(const k of ['flip_x','flip_y'])candidate[k]=document.getElementById(k).checked;if(!validTransform(candidate)){document.getElementById('calibrationError').textContent='Enter finite calibration values and a positive width and height.';return;}transform=candidate;document.getElementById('calibrationError').textContent='';try{localStorage.setItem(storageKey(),JSON.stringify(transform));}catch{}render();}
function heroKnown(e){return Number.isInteger(e.hero_id)&&e.hero_id>0&&typeof e.hero_name==='string'&&e.hero_name.length>0;}
function includeEntity(e){return entityFresh(e)&&(e.team==='local'?options.showLocal:e.team==='friendly'?options.showFriendly:e.team==='enemy'?options.showEnemy:false)&&(allHeroes||(heroKnown(e)&&selectedHeroes.has(e.hero_id)));}
function healthText(e){if(!Number.isFinite(e.hp))return 'HP ?';return Math.round(e.hp)+(e.hp_pair_valid===true&&Number.isFinite(e.max_hp)&&e.max_hp>0?'/'+Math.round(e.max_hp):' HP');}
function ultimateText(e){if(!ultimateFresh(e))return 'Ult ?';const u=e.ultimate;if(u.trained===false)return 'Ult untrained';if(u.trained!==true||typeof u.ready!=='boolean')return 'Ult ?';if(u.ready)return 'Ult ready';return Number.isFinite(u.remaining_seconds)&&u.remaining_seconds>0?'Ult '+Math.ceil(u.remaining_seconds)+'s':'Ult ?';}
function entityLabel(e){const parts=[];if(options.showHero)parts.push(heroKnown(e)?e.hero_name:'Unknown hero');if(options.showHp)parts.push(healthText(e));if(options.showUlt)parts.push(ultimateText(e));return parts.join(' · ');}
function refreshHeroFilter(){const container=document.getElementById('heroFilter'),heroes=new Map();for(const e of lastData.ents)if(entityFresh(e)&&heroKnown(e))heroes.set(e.hero_id,e.hero_name);const key=String(sessionEpoch)+':'+allHeroes+':'+[...heroes].sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]).map(([id,name])=>id+':'+name).join('|');if(container.dataset.key===key)return;container.dataset.key=key;container.replaceChildren();for(const [id,name]of [...heroes].sort((a,b)=>a[1].localeCompare(b[1]))){const label=document.createElement('label'),input=document.createElement('input');input.type='checkbox';input.checked=allHeroes||selectedHeroes.has(id);input.disabled=allHeroes;input.onchange=()=>{if(input.checked)selectedHeroes.add(id);else selectedHeroes.delete(id);render();};label.append(input,document.createTextNode(name));container.append(label);}document.getElementById('heroNote').textContent=heroes.size?'Filter uses known hero names in the current snapshot.':'No current known heroes. Unknown identities are shown only with All heroes.';}
function render(){updateStatus();refreshHeroFilter();const bounds=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),width=Math.max(1,bounds.width),height=Math.max(1,bounds.height),dpr=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);if(canvas.width!==Math.round(width*dpr)||canvas.height!==Math.round(height*dpr)){canvas.width=Math.round(width*dpr);canvas.height=Math.round(height*dpr);}ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);ctx.fillStyle='#d5e1db';ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);document.getElementById('zoomValue').textContent=Math.round(view.zoom*100)+'%';
 const notice=document.getElementById('notice');if(!profile||!transform){notice.textContent=lastData.map_name?'No calibrated image for '+lastData.map_name+'. Choose a map or use a custom image in Settings.':'Map not identified. Choose a map in the top bar.';document.getElementById('local').textContent='Your world position is unavailable.';return;}if(!imageReady){notice.textContent=imageError||'Loading map image…';return;}
 const rect=fitMapRect(width,height,mapImage.naturalWidth,mapImage.naturalHeight),corner=mapToScreen(0,0,rect,view),w=rect.width*view.zoom,h=rect.height*view.zoom;ctx.save();ctx.filter=options.lightMap?'invert(1) grayscale(1) brightness(.8) contrast(2)':'brightness(2.4)';ctx.drawImage(mapImage,corner.x,corner.y,w,h);ctx.restore();ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(corner.x,corner.y,w,h);ctx.clip();let outside=0,filtered=0;
 for(const e of lastData.ents){if(!entityFresh(e)||!Number.isFinite(e.x)||!Number.isFinite(e.y))continue;if(!includeEntity(e)){filtered++;continue;}const p=worldToMap(e.x,e.y,transform);if(p.u<0||p.u>1||p.v<0||p.v>1){outside++;continue;}const point=mapToScreen(p.u,p.v,rect,view),size=Number(options.markerSize)+(e.team==='local'?2:0),color=e.team==='local'?'#6442ad':e.team==='friendly'?'#087558':'#bb2948';ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.strokeStyle='#fff';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(point.x,point.y,size,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();const label=entityLabel(e);if(label){ctx.font='600 12px system-ui,sans-serif';ctx.textBaseline='middle';const textWidth=ctx.measureText(label).width,boxX=point.x+size+5,boxY=point.y-10;ctx.fillStyle='#f7faf6ed';ctx.fillRect(boxX-3,boxY,textWidth+6,20);ctx.fillStyle='#19343f';ctx.fillText(label,boxX,point.y);}if(options.showHp&&e.hp_pair_valid===true&&Number.isFinite(e.hp)&&Number.isFinite(e.max_hp)&&e.max_hp>0){const barWidth=26;ctx.fillStyle='#ffffff';ctx.fillRect(point.x-barWidth/2-1,point.y+size+3,barWidth+2,5);ctx.fillStyle='#087558';ctx.fillRect(point.x-barWidth/2,point.y+size+4,barWidth*Math.max(0,Math.min(1,e.hp/e.max_hp)),3);}}
 ctx.restore();notice.textContent=(picker.value?'Manual map: '+profile.label+' · ':'')+(outside?outside+' outside image · ':'')+(filtered?filtered+' filtered · ':'')+(!markersFresh()?'Markers hidden until a valid fresh snapshot · ':'')+'Wheel to zoom · drag to pan · calibration alignment needs live verification';
 const local=lastData.ents.find(e=>e.team==='local'&&entityFresh(e)&&Number.isFinite(e.x)&&Number.isFinite(e.y));document.getElementById('local').textContent=local?'Your world position: X '+local.x.toFixed(1)+' · Y '+local.y.toFixed(1):'Your world position is unavailable.';
}
function validResponse(j){return !!j&&Array.isArray(j.ents)&&typeof j.attached==='boolean'&&typeof j.frame_valid==='boolean'&&typeof j.valid==='boolean'&&Number.isSafeInteger(j.snapshot_ms)&&j.snapshot_ms>=0&&Number.isSafeInteger(j.server_time_ms)&&j.server_time_ms>=0&&(j.age_ms===null||(Number.isSafeInteger(j.age_ms)&&j.age_ms>=0&&j.snapshot_ms>0&&j.server_time_ms-j.snapshot_ms===j.age_ms))&&typeof j.session_epoch==='string'&&/^[0-9]+$/.test(j.session_epoch)&&j.ents.every(e=>e&&Number.isFinite(e.x)&&Number.isFinite(e.y)&&typeof e.id==='string'&&['local','friendly','enemy'].includes(e.team)&&Number.isSafeInteger(e.source_ms)&&e.source_ms>0&&Number.isSafeInteger(e.source_age_ms)&&e.source_age_ms>=0&&j.server_time_ms-e.source_ms===e.source_age_ms);}
async function fetchJsonDeadline(path){const controller=new AbortController(),timer=setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS),started=performance.now();try{const r=await fetch(path,{cache:'no-store',signal:controller.signal});if(!r.ok)throw Error(r.status===403?'Invalid PIN':'Radar request failed ('+r.status+')');const j=await r.json();return {data:j,elapsed:performance.now()-started};}finally{clearTimeout(timer);}}
function armFreshnessExpiry(){clearTimeout(freshnessTimer);if(!markersFresh())return;const ages=[currentAge()];for(const e of lastData.ents){if(entityFresh(e)){ages.push(sourceAge(e.source_age_ms));if(ultimateFresh(e))ages.push(sourceAge(e.ultimate.age_ms));}}freshnessTimer=setTimeout(()=>{render();armFreshnessExpiry();},Math.max(1,STALE_MS-Math.max(...ages)+1));}
function schedulePoll(delay){clearTimeout(pollTimer);if(!stopped)pollTimer=setTimeout(update,Math.max(0,delay));}
async function update(){if(busy||stopped)return;busy=true;const started=performance.now();try{const result=await fetchJsonDeadline('/data?pin='+encodeURIComponent(pin));if(stopped)return;const j=result.data;if(!validResponse(j))throw Error('Invalid radar snapshot response');if(sessionEpoch!==j.session_epoch){sessionEpoch=j.session_epoch;selectedHeroes.clear();allHeroes=true;document.getElementById('allHeroes').checked=true;document.getElementById('heroFilter').dataset.key='';}lastData=j;receivedAt=performance.now();roundTripMs=result.elapsed;responseTimes=responseTimes.filter(t=>receivedAt-t<=2000);responseTimes.push(receivedAt);lastNetworkError='';chooseMap();armFreshnessExpiry();}catch(e){if(!stopped)lastNetworkError=e.name==='AbortError'?'Radar request timed out':e.message;}finally{busy=false;if(!stopped){render();schedulePoll(1000/refreshHz-(performance.now()-started));}}}
function zoomAt(next,x,y){const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();view=zoomViewAt(view,next,x,y,rect.width/2,rect.height/2);render();}
canvas.addEventListener('wheel',e=>{e.preventDefault();const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),delta=e.deltaY*(e.deltaMode===1?16:e.deltaMode===2?rect.height:1);zoomAt(view.zoom*Math.exp(-Math.max(-1000,Math.min(1000,delta))*.0015),e.clientX-rect.left,e.clientY-rect.top);},{passive:false});
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(e.button!==0||drag)return;canvas.focus({preventScroll:true});drag={id:e.pointerId,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,panX:view.panX,panY:view.panY};canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);canvas.classList.add('dragging');});
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!drag||drag.id!==e.pointerId)return;view.panX=drag.panX+e.clientX-drag.x;view.panY=drag.panY+e.clientY-drag.y;render();});
function stopDrag(e){if(!drag||drag.id!==e.pointerId)return;drag=null;canvas.classList.remove('dragging');if(canvas.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId))canvas.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);}
for(const name of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])canvas.addEventListener(name,stopDrag);
canvas.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{const step=35;if(['+','=','-','0','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown'].includes(e.key))e.preventDefault();else return;if(e.key==='0')resetView();else if(e.key==='+'||e.key==='=')zoomAt(view.zoom*1.25,canvas.clientWidth/2,canvas.clientHeight/2);else if(e.key==='-')zoomAt(view.zoom/1.25,canvas.clientWidth/2,canvas.clientHeight/2);else{view.panX+=e.key==='ArrowLeft'?step:e.key==='ArrowRight'?-step:0;view.panY+=e.key==='ArrowUp'?step:e.key==='ArrowDown'?-step:0;render();}});
document.getElementById('zoomIn').onclick=()=>zoomAt(view.zoom*1.25,canvas.clientWidth/2,canvas.clientHeight/2);document.getElementById('zoomOut').onclick=()=>zoomAt(view.zoom/1.25,canvas.clientWidth/2,canvas.clientHeight/2);document.getElementById('fit').onclick=resetView;
document.getElementById('fullscreen').onclick=async()=>{try{if(document.fullscreenElement)await document.exitFullscreen();else if(viewport.requestFullscreen)await viewport.requestFullscreen();}catch{document.getElementById('notice').textContent='Browser fullscreen is unavailable. The map still fills this page.';}};document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange',()=>{document.getElementById('fullscreen').textContent=document.fullscreenElement?'Exit fullscreen':'Fullscreen';render();});
function setDrawer(open){document.getElementById('drawer').hidden=!open;for(const id of ['openSettings','openMapSettings'])document.getElementById(id).setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));if(open)document.getElementById('closeSettings').focus({preventScroll:true});else document.getElementById(document.fullscreenElement?'openMapSettings':'openSettings').focus({preventScroll:true});}

:::FILE icon.cpp
#include "icon.h"
#include "utils.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
#include <ctime>
#include <cmath>
static void put16(std::vector<u8>&v,u32 x){ v.push_back((u8)(x&0xFF)); v.push_back((u8)((x>>8)&0xFF)); }
static void put32(std::vector<u8>&v,u32 x){ v.push_back((u8)(x&0xFF)); v.push_back((u8)((x>>8)&0xFF));
                                         v.push_back((u8)((x>>16)&0xFF)); v.push_back((u8)((x>>24)&0xFF)); }
HICON ensure_ace_icon(){
    const int S=32;
    if(GetFileAttributesA("ace.ico")==INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES){
        std::vector<u8> px(S*S*4);
        auto setpx=[&](int x,int y,u8 r,u8 g,u8 b,u8 a){
            if(x<0||y<0||x>=S||y>=S) return;
            int i=((S-1-y)*S+x)*4;
            px[i]=b; px[i+1]=g; px[i+2]=r; px[i+3]=a;
        };
        float cx=16.f, cy=16.f, s=11.f;
        for(int y=0;y<S;y++) for(int x=0;x<S;x++){
            float dx=(float)x-cx, dy=(float)y-cy;
            bool corner=((x<3)||(x>S-4))&&((y<3)||(y>S-4));
            bool border=(x==0||y==0||x==S-1||y==S-1);
            if(corner){ setpx(x,y,0,0,0,0); continue; }
            if(border){ setpx(x,y,232,180,74,255); continue; }
            setpx(x,y,26,24,20,255);
            float d1=std::sqrt((dx+s*0.45f)*(dx+s*0.45f)+(dy-s*0.15f)*(dy-s*0.15f));
            float d2=std::sqrt((dx-s*0.45f)*(dx-s*0.45f)+(dy-s*0.15f)*(dy-s*0.15f));
            bool sp=(d1<s*0.42f)||(d2<s*0.42f);
            if(dy>=-0.95f*s&&dy<=0.2f*s){
                float w=0.72f*s*((dy+0.95f*s)/(1.15f*s));
                if(std::fabs(dx)<=w) sp=true;
            }
            if(dy>0.3f*s&&dy<0.95f*s){
                float wi=0.16f*s*((0.95f*s-dy)/(0.65f*s));
                if(std::fabs(dx)<=wi) sp=true;
                if(dy>=0.55f*s){
                    float wo=0.48f*s*((0.95f*s-dy)/(0.40f*s));
                    if(std::fabs(dx)<=wo) sp=true;
                }
            }
            if(sp) setpx(x,y,232,180,74,255);
        }
        std::vector<u8> ico;
        put16(ico,0); put16(ico,1); put16(ico,1);
        ico.push_back((u8)S); ico.push_back((u8)S);
        ico.push_back(0); ico.push_back(0);
        put16(ico,1); put16(ico,32);
        put32(ico,(u32)(40+px.size()+128));
        put32(ico,(u32)(6+16));
        put32(ico,40); put32(ico,S); put32(ico,S*2);
        put16(ico,1); put16(ico,32);
        for(int i=0;i<6;i++) put32(ico,0);
        ico.insert(ico.end(),px.begin(),px.end());
        for(int i=0;i<128;i++) ico.push_back(0);
        FILE* f=fopen("ace.ico","wb");
        if(f){ fwrite(ico.data(),1,ico.size(),f); fclose(f); }
    }
    return (HICON)LoadImageA(nullptr,"ace.ico",IMAGE_ICON,32,32,LR_LOADFROMFILE);
}
