namespace defense{
static std::mutex status_mutex;static std::string message="Waiting for live data";
static std::unordered_map<u64,u64> handled;static u64 reserved_until=0;static unsigned last_hero=0;
static void note(std::string text){std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(status_mutex);message=std::move(text);}
bool busy(){return now_ms()<reserved_until;}
std::string status(){std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(status_mutex);return message;}
void reset(){handled.clear();reserved_until=0;last_hero=0;}
std::string prefix(unsigned hero){return "defense."+std::to_string(hero)+".";}
std::string selection(const std::string& prefix,u32 token){return prefix+"watch."+std::to_string(token);}
static bool native_area_impact(const ability_data::Entry& e){return std::strcmp(e.key,"citadel_ability_bull_leap")==0;}
static bool lockon_impact(const ability_data::Entry& e){return std::strcmp(e.key,"citadel_ability_lash_ultimate")==0;}
static bool charge_impact(const ability_data::Entry& e){return std::strcmp(e.key,"citadel_ability_bull_charge")==0;}
bool observable(const ability_data::Entry& entry){
    return entry.enemy&&!entry.passive&&(entry.projectile||native_area_impact(entry)||lockon_impact(entry)||charge_impact(entry)||(entry.aoe&&entry.self_centered));
}
bool counterspell_observable(const ability_data::Entry& e){
    if(!observable(e))return false;
    // These sustained tick/aura effects are deliberately not Counterspell
    // targets, even if a legacy config still has their watch flag enabled.
    if(std::strcmp(e.key,"citadel_ability_bull_heal")==0||std::strcmp(e.key,"ability_nurse_fear")==0||std::strcmp(e.key,"ability_frank_painaura")==0)return false;
    // An AoE radius or generic channel flag does not provide a discrete impact
    // time. Only moving projectile paths and the explicit native readers qualify.
    return e.projectile||native_area_impact(e)||lockon_impact(e)||charge_impact(e);
}
const char* observation(const ability_data::Entry& e){return !e.enemy?"Non-hostile":(e.passive?"Passive":(e.projectile?"Projectile":(native_area_impact(e)?"Native area impact":(e.aoe?"Area / cast target":(observable(e)?"Charge":"Unavailable")))));}
const char* counterspell_observation(const ability_data::Entry& e){
    return e.projectile?"Reacts when the enemy projectile's current path will hit you, with range and line-of-sight checks.":(native_area_impact(e)?"Uses the game's impact position and future impact time, with range and line-of-sight checks.":(lockon_impact(e)?"Requires your handle in the cast's lock-on targets and a future scheduled cast-state transition.":"Requires an approaching charge path that intersects your position, with line-of-sight checks."));
}
static const Ability* ability(const Entity& e,u32 token){for(auto& a:e.abilities)if(a.token==token&&a.valid)return &a;return nullptr;}
static const ability_data::Entry* named(const char* key){for(auto& d:ability_data::entries)if(std::strcmp(d.key,key)==0)return &d;return nullptr;}
static bool contains(const Threat& t,u32 handle){return std::find(t.victims.begin(),t.victims.end(),handle)!=t.victims.end();}
static float dot(Vec3 a,Vec3 b){return a.x*b.x+a.y*b.y+a.z*b.z;}
static float intercept(const Entity& projectile,const Entity& victim,float radius){
    if(!victim.bounds_valid)return -1;
    Vec3 relative=projectile.pos-victim.pos,velocity=projectile.vel-victim.vel;
    float position[3]={relative.x,relative.y,relative.z},speed[3]={velocity.x,velocity.y,velocity.z};
    float low[3]={victim.bounds_min.x-radius,victim.bounds_min.y-radius,victim.bounds_min.z-radius};
    float high[3]={victim.bounds_max.x+radius,victim.bounds_max.y+radius,victim.bounds_max.z+radius};
    float enter=0,exit=2;
    for(int axis=0;axis<3;axis++){
        if(std::fabs(speed[axis])<.00001f){if(position[axis]<low[axis]||position[axis]>high[axis])return -1;continue;}
        float first=(low[axis]-position[axis])/speed[axis],last=(high[axis]-position[axis])/speed[axis];if(first>last)std::swap(first,last);
        enter=std::max(enter,first);exit=std::min(exit,last);if(enter>exit)return -1;
    }
    return enter>=0&&enter<=2?enter:-1;
}
static bool clear_path(const World& world,Vec3 from,Vec3 to,unsigned channel){if(!world.require_los)return true;auto ray=collision::trace(from,to,channel);return ray.known&&ray.clear;}
std::vector<Threat> detect(const World& world){
    std::vector<Threat> result;std::vector<const Entity*> victims{&world.local};for(auto& e:world.friends)if(e.alive)victims.push_back(&e);
    for(auto& projectile:world.projectiles){
        auto* data=ability_data::find(projectile.ability_token);if(!data||!data->projectile||!observable(*data))continue;
        auto owner=std::find_if(world.enemies.begin(),world.enemies.end(),[&](auto& enemy){return enemy.base==projectile.owner;});if(owner==world.enemies.end())continue;
        Threat threat;threat.id=projectile.handle;threat.source=owner->base;threat.token=data->token;threat.projectile=true;threat.aoe=data->aoe;threat.eta=100;
        float radius=std::max(0.f,projectile.collision_radius)+std::max(0.f,data->radius);
        for(auto* victim:victims){float time=intercept(projectile,*victim,radius);if(time>=0&&clear_path(world,projectile.pos,projectile.pos+projectile.vel*time,collision::Projectile)&&clear_path(world,projectile.pos+projectile.vel*time,victim->pos+victim->vel*time+(victim->bounds_min+victim->bounds_max)*.5f,collision::Ability)){threat.victims.push_back(victim->handle);threat.eta=std::min(threat.eta,time);}}
        if(!threat.victims.empty())result.push_back(std::move(threat));
    }
    for(auto& enemy:world.enemies)if(enemy.alive)for(auto& cast:enemy.abilities){
        auto* data=ability_data::find(cast.token);if(!data||!cast.valid||!observable(*data)||data->projectile)continue;
        bool charge=charge_impact(*data),native_area=native_area_impact(*data),lockon=lockon_impact(*data);
        if(native_area&&(!cast.has_impact_position||!std::isfinite(cast.impact_time)||cast.impact_time<=world.time))continue;
        if(lockon&&(cast.targets.empty()||!std::isfinite(cast.impact_time)||cast.impact_time<=world.time))continue;
        if(!cast.casting&&!cast.channeling&&!(cast.has_impact_position&&cast.impact_time>world.time))continue;
        Threat threat;threat.source=enemy.base;threat.token=data->token;threat.aoe=data->aoe||native_area;threat.id=enemy.base^((u64)data->token<<17)^((u64)(std::max(cast.cast_start,cast.channel_start)*1000));
        float start=cast.casting?cast.cast_start:cast.channel_start;
        threat.eta=cast.impact_time>world.time?cast.impact_time-world.time:(cast.casting?data->cast:data->channel)-(world.time-start);
        if(charge){
            Entity movement=enemy;movement.pos=enemy.pos;threat.eta=100;
            for(auto* victim:victims){float t=intercept(movement,*victim,world_units::units(2.2f));if(t>=0&&clear_path(world,enemy.pos+Vec3{0,0,40},victim->pos+Vec3{0,0,40},collision::Ability)){threat.eta=std::min(threat.eta,t);threat.victims.push_back(victim->handle);}}
        }else if(!cast.targets.empty()){
            // Explicit lock-on target handles prevent a nearby, unrelated cast triggering a dodge.
            for(auto* victim:victims)if(std::find(cast.targets.begin(),cast.targets.end(),victim->handle)!=cast.targets.end()&&clear_path(world,enemy.pos+Vec3{0,0,40},victim->pos+Vec3{0,0,40},collision::Ability))threat.victims.push_back(victim->handle);
        }else if(threat.aoe&&data->radius>0&&(data->self_centered||cast.has_impact_position)){
            Vec3 center=cast.has_impact_position?cast.impact_position:enemy.pos;
            for(auto* victim:victims)if((victim->pos+victim->vel*std::max(0.f,threat.eta)).dist(center)<=data->radius+24&&clear_path(world,center+Vec3{0,0,16},victim->pos+Vec3{0,0,40},collision::Ability))threat.victims.push_back(victim->handle);
        }
        if(threat.eta>=0&&threat.eta<=2&&!threat.victims.empty())result.push_back(std::move(threat));
    }
    std::sort(result.begin(),result.end(),[](auto& a,auto& b){return a.eta<b.eta;});return result;
}
Decision choose(const World& world,const std::vector<Threat>& threats){
    Decision none;if(!world.usable||!world.local.alive||world.local.invuln||!world.local.modifiers_valid)return none;
    auto p=prefix(world.local.hero);const char* key=world.local.hero==11?"citadel_ability_void_sphere":(world.local.hero==77?"ability_fencer_riposte":(world.local.hero==63?"ability_vampirebat_batblink":nullptr));
    auto* defensive=key?named(key):nullptr;auto* dodge=defensive?ability(world.local,defensive->token):nullptr;
    auto* counter=named("upgrade_counterspell");auto* owned=counter?ability(world.local,counter->token):nullptr;auto* parry_data=named("citadel_ability_melee_parry");auto* parry=parry_data?ability(world.local,parry_data->token):nullptr;
    for(auto& threat:threats){
        if(threat.eta*1000>cfg.F("defense.lead_ms"))continue;
        auto* incoming=ability_data::find(threat.token);if(!incoming)continue;
        bool self=contains(threat,world.local.handle);
        bool nearby_friend=false;if(world.local.hero==11&&threat.aoe&&!incoming->single)for(auto& ally:world.friends)if(ally.alive&&contains(threat,ally.handle)&&ally.pos.dist(world.local.pos)<=world_units::units(13))nearby_friend=true;
        bool selected=cfg.B(selection(p,threat.token).c_str());
        if(dodge&&dodge->ready&&cfg.B((p+"enabled").c_str())&&selected&&(self||nearby_friend)){
            if(nearby_friend&&cfg.B((p+"protect_team").c_str())){int alt=cfg.I((p+"alt_key").c_str());if(alt){bool modifier=cfg.I((p+"alt_mode").c_str())==0;return {Decision::GroupDodge,threat.id,modifier?cfg.I((p+"key").c_str()):alt,modifier?alt:0,std::string("Group dodge: ")+incoming->title};}}
            if(self)return {Decision::Dodge,threat.id,cfg.I((p+"key").c_str()),0,std::string("Defensive ability: ")+incoming->title};
        }
        if(self&&counterspell_observable(*incoming)&&owned&&owned->ready&&parry&&parry->ready&&cfg.B("defense.counterspell.enabled")&&cfg.B(selection("defense.counterspell.",threat.token).c_str()))return {Decision::Counterspell,threat.id,cfg.I("defense.counterspell.key"),0,std::string("Counterspell: ")+incoming->title};
    }
    return none;
}
void tick(){
    consumer_demand::note_defensive_tick();
    if(inp.panic||!game_data_permits_output()){note("Waiting for fresh, playable game data");return;}
    World world;unsigned actual_hero=0;bool enabled=false;
    {std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(snap_mtx);
        actual_hero=snap.local.hero;enabled=consumer_demand::defensive(cfg,actual_hero);
        if(enabled){world.local=snap.local;world.enemies=snap.enemies;world.friends=snap.friendlies;world.projectiles=snap.projectiles;world.time=snap.game_time;world.host_time=now_ms();world.usable=snap.frame_valid;world.require_los=snap.backend_managed;}
        else world.host_time=now_ms();
    }
    // Identity/reservation bookkeeping still runs on playable disabled frames.
    if(actual_hero!=last_hero){reset();last_hero=actual_hero;}
    if(world.host_time<reserved_until)return;for(auto it=handled.begin();it!=handled.end();)if(it->second<world.host_time)it=handled.erase(it);else ++it;
    if(!enabled){note("Defensive automation disabled");return;}
    auto threats=detect(world);threats.erase(std::remove_if(threats.begin(),threats.end(),[&](auto& t){return handled.count(t.id)!=0;}),threats.end());
    auto decision=choose(world,threats);if(decision.type==Decision::None){note("Watching selected threats");return;}
    if(!decision.key){note("Action blocked: bind its output key");return;}
    if(!hw::can_send(decision.key)||(decision.modifier&&!hw::can_send(decision.modifier))){note("Action blocked: keyboard injection is not verified on this device");return;}
    constexpr int press=35;
    if(decision.modifier)hw::key_chord(decision.modifier,decision.key,press);else hw::key_tap(decision.key,press);
    handled[decision.threat]=world.host_time+3000;reserved_until=world.host_time+(decision.type==Decision::Dodge||decision.type==Decision::GroupDodge?450:900);
    action_note(decision.reason);note(decision.reason);
}
}

namespace collision{
enum Channel:unsigned {Vision=1,Bullet=2,Projectile=4,Ability=8};
struct Shape{Vec3 a,b,c;float radius=0;u32 kind=0,mask=15;};
struct Node{Vec3 low,high;u32 first=0,count=0,left=0,right=0;};
struct Result{bool known=false,clear=false;float fraction=1;Vec3 hit{};};
struct Revision{u64 scene=0,obstacles=0;};
inline bool operator==(Revision a,Revision b){return a.scene==b.scene&&a.obstacles==b.obstacles;}
inline bool operator!=(Revision a,Revision b){return !(a==b);}
class Scene{
    std::vector<Shape> shapes_;std::vector<Node> nodes_;std::string map_;
public:
    void build(std::vector<Shape> shapes,std::string map);
    // Explicit format revision supplied by the game-qualified asset registry.
    bool load(const std::string& file,const std::string& map,u32 expected_revision,std::string& error);
    // Deadlock-only compatibility for existing baker/standalone fixtures.
    bool load(const std::string& file,const std::string& map,std::string& error);
    bool save(const std::string& file,u32 revision,std::string& error)const;
    Result trace(Vec3 from,Vec3 to,unsigned channel)const;
    // Boolean visibility path: hit/fraction identify the first encountered blocker, not the nearest.
    Result trace_any(Vec3 from,Vec3 to,unsigned channel)const;
    size_t size()const{return shapes_.size();}const std::string& map()const{return map_;}
};
struct Obstacle{Vec3 origin,low,high,angles;float scale=1;};
void set_obstacles(std::vector<Obstacle> obstacles);
// Queues native .acecol work; no collision-asset I/O or decompression on the caller.
void select_map(const GameMapKey& key);
// Deadlock-only legacy entry point. Live dispatch must use the qualified key.
void select_map(const std::string& map);std::string status();
// Call once on application exit, after reader/query workers have stopped.
void shutdown();

Result trace_any(Vec3 from,Vec3 to,unsigned channel);

namespace collision{
static float dot(Vec3 a,Vec3 b){return a.x*b.x+a.y*b.y+a.z*b.z;}
static Vec3 cross(Vec3 a,Vec3 b){return {a.y*b.z-a.z*b.y,a.z*b.x-a.x*b.z,a.x*b.y-a.y*b.x};}
static bool finite(Vec3 p){return std::isfinite(p.x)&&std::isfinite(p.y)&&std::isfinite(p.z)&&p.len()<1e8f;}
static Vec3 lower(Vec3 a,Vec3 b){return {std::min(a.x,b.x),std::min(a.y,b.y),std::min(a.z,b.z)};}
static Vec3 upper(Vec3 a,Vec3 b){return {std::max(a.x,b.x),std::max(a.y,b.y),std::max(a.z,b.z)};}
static Vec3 lo(const Shape& s){return s.kind?lower(s.a,s.b)-Vec3{s.radius,s.radius,s.radius}:lower(lower(s.a,s.b),s.c);}
static Vec3 hi(const Shape& s){return s.kind?upper(s.a,s.b)+Vec3{s.radius,s.radius,s.radius}:upper(upper(s.a,s.b),s.c);}
static float component(Vec3 v,int axis){return axis==0?v.x:(axis==1?v.y:v.z);}
void Scene::build(std::vector<Shape> shapes,std::string map){
    shapes_=std::move(shapes);map_=std::move(map);nodes_.clear();
    shapes_.erase(std::remove_if(shapes_.begin(),shapes_.end(),[](const Shape&s){return !s.mask||!finite(s.a)||!finite(s.b)||!finite(s.c)||s.kind>1||!std::isfinite(s.radius)||s.radius<0;}),shapes_.end());
    std::function<u32(u32,u32)> split=[&](u32 first,u32 count){
        u32 index=(u32)nodes_.size();Node node;node.low={1e30f,1e30f,1e30f};node.high={-1e30f,-1e30f,-1e30f};
        for(u32 i=first;i<first+count;i++){node.low=lower(node.low,lo(shapes_[i]));node.high=upper(node.high,hi(shapes_[i]));}
        nodes_.push_back(node);if(count<=8){nodes_[index].first=first;nodes_[index].count=count;return index;}
        Vec3 extent=node.high-node.low;int axis=extent.y>extent.x?1:0;if(extent.z>component(extent,axis))axis=2;
        u32 middle=first+count/2;std::nth_element(shapes_.begin()+first,shapes_.begin()+middle,shapes_.begin()+first+count,[&](const Shape&a,const Shape&b){return component(lo(a)+hi(a),axis)<component(lo(b)+hi(b),axis);});
        auto left=split(first,middle-first),right=split(middle,first+count-middle);nodes_[index].left=left;nodes_[index].right=right;return index;
    };if(!shapes_.empty())split(0,(u32)shapes_.size());
}
static bool box(Vec3 start,Vec3 delta,Vec3 low,Vec3 high,float limit){
    float enter=0,exit=limit;for(int i=0;i<3;i++){float p=component(start,i),v=component(delta,i),l=component(low,i),h=component(high,i);
        if(std::fabs(v)<1e-9f){if(p<l||p>h)return false;continue;}float a=(l-p)/v,b=(h-p)/v;if(a>b)std::swap(a,b);enter=std::max(enter,a);exit=std::min(exit,b);if(enter>exit)return false;
    }return true;
}
static float sphere(Vec3 start,Vec3 delta,Vec3 center,float radius){
    Vec3 v=start-center;float a=dot(delta,delta),b=dot(v,delta),c=dot(v,v)-radius*radius,d=b*b-a*c;if(c<=0)return 0;if(a<1e-12f||d<0)return 2;float t=(-b-std::sqrt(d))/a;return t>=0?t:2;
}
static float intersect(const Shape& s,Vec3 start,Vec3 delta){
    if(s.kind){
        float best=std::min(sphere(start,delta,s.a,s.radius),sphere(start,delta,s.b,s.radius));Vec3 axis=s.b-s.a;float length=axis.len();if(length<1e-5f)return best;
        axis=axis*(1.f/length);Vec3 v=start-s.a,dp=delta-axis*dot(delta,axis),vp=v-axis*dot(v,axis);float a=dot(dp,dp),b=dot(vp,dp),c=dot(vp,vp)-s.radius*s.radius,discriminant=b*b-a*c;
        float height=dot(v,axis);if(c<=0&&height>=0&&height<=length)return 0;
        if(a>1e-10f&&discriminant>=0){float t=(-b-std::sqrt(discriminant))/a;float h=height+t*dot(delta,axis);if(t>=0&&h>=0&&h<=length)best=std::min(best,t);}return best;
    }
    Vec3 ab=s.b-s.a,ac=s.c-s.a,p=cross(delta,ac);float determinant=dot(ab,p);if(std::fabs(determinant)<1e-8f)return 2;
    float inv=1/determinant;Vec3 t=start-s.a;float u=dot(t,p)*inv;if(u<0||u>1)return 2;Vec3 q=cross(t,ab);float v=dot(delta,q)*inv;if(v<0||u+v>1)return 2;float distance=dot(ac,q)*inv;return distance>=0?distance:2;
}
Result Scene::trace(Vec3 from,Vec3 to,unsigned channel)const{
    Result result;if(nodes_.empty()||!finite(from)||!finite(to)||!channel)return result;result.known=true;result.clear=true;Vec3 delta=to-from;if(delta.len()<.01f)return result;
    std::array<u32,128> stack{};size_t top=1;stack[0]=0;
    while(top){auto index=stack[--top];const auto& node=nodes_[index];if(!box(from,delta,node.low,node.high,result.fraction))continue;
        if(node.count){for(u32 i=node.first;i<node.first+node.count;i++){const auto& shape=shapes_[i];if(!(shape.mask&channel))continue;float t=intersect(shape,from,delta);if(t>=0&&t<result.fraction&&t<1-.01f/delta.len()){result.fraction=t;result.clear=false;}}}
        else{if(top+2>stack.size()){result.known=false;result.clear=false;return result;}stack[top++]=node.left;stack[top++]=node.right;}
    }result.hit=from+delta*result.fraction;return result;
}
Result Scene::trace_any(Vec3 from,Vec3 to,unsigned channel)const{
    Result result;if(nodes_.empty()||!finite(from)||!finite(to)||!channel)return result;
    result.known=true;result.clear=true;result.hit=to;Vec3 delta=to-from;const float length=delta.len();if(length<.01f)return result;
    const float endpoint=1-.01f/length;std::array<u32,128> stack{};size_t top=1;stack[0]=0;
    while(top){
        const auto& node=nodes_[stack[--top]];if(!box(from,delta,node.low,node.high,1))continue;
        if(node.count){
            for(u32 i=node.first;i<node.first+node.count;i++){
                const auto& shape=shapes_[i];if(!(shape.mask&channel))continue;const float t=intersect(shape,from,delta);
                if(t>=0&&t<1&&t<endpoint){result.clear=false;result.fraction=t;result.hit=from+delta*t;return result;}
            }
        }else{
            if(top+2>stack.size()){result.known=false;result.clear=false;return result;}
            stack[top++]=node.left;stack[top++]=node.right;
        }
    }return result;
}
struct Header{char magic[8];u32 version,revision,raw_size,packed_size,shapes,nodes;u64 hash;char map[64];};
static u64 hash_bytes(const unsigned char* data,size_t size){u64 value=14695981039346656037ull;for(size_t i=0;i<size;i++){value^=data[i];value*=1099511628211ull;}return value;}
bool Scene::save(const std::string& file,u32 revision,std::string& error)const{
    if(nodes_.empty()||map_.size()>63){error="Empty collision scene";return false;}size_t raw_size=shapes_.size()*sizeof(Shape)+nodes_.size()*sizeof(Node);if(raw_size>512*1024*1024){error="Collision scene too large";return false;}
    std::vector<unsigned char> raw(raw_size);std::memcpy(raw.data(),shapes_.data(),shapes_.size()*sizeof(Shape));std::memcpy(raw.data()+shapes_.size()*sizeof(Shape),nodes_.data(),nodes_.size()*sizeof(Node));
    COMPRESSOR_HANDLE handle=nullptr;if(!CreateCompressor(COMPRESS_ALGORITHM_XPRESS_HUFF,nullptr,&handle)){error="Compressor unavailable";return false;}SIZE_T needed=0;Compress(handle,raw.data(),raw.size(),nullptr,0,&needed);std::vector<unsigned char> packed(needed);
    bool ok=Compress(handle,raw.data(),raw.size(),packed.data(),packed.size(),&needed);CloseCompressor(handle);if(!ok){error="Collision compression failed";return false;}packed.resize(needed);
    Header h{};std::memcpy(h.magic,"ACELOS2",7);h.version=2;h.revision=revision;h.raw_size=(u32)raw.size();h.packed_size=(u32)packed.size();h.shapes=(u32)shapes_.size();h.nodes=(u32)nodes_.size();h.hash=hash_bytes(raw.data(),raw.size());std::memcpy(h.map,map_.data(),map_.size());
    std::ofstream out(file,std::ios::binary);out.write((char*)&h,sizeof(h));out.write((char*)packed.data(),packed.size());if(!out){error="Collision file write failed";return false;}return true;
}
bool Scene::load(const std::string& file,const std::string& map,std::string& error){return load(file,map,11193905,error);}
bool Scene::load(const std::string& file,const std::string& map,u32 expected_revision,std::string& error){
    shapes_.clear();nodes_.clear();map_.clear();std::ifstream in(file,std::ios::binary|std::ios::ate);auto file_size=in.tellg();in.seekg(0);Header h{};in.read((char*)&h,sizeof(h));
    if(!in||std::memcmp(h.magic,"ACELOS2",8)||h.version!=2||h.revision!=expected_revision||!std::memchr(h.map,0,64)||map!=h.map||h.raw_size>512*1024*1024||h.packed_size>512*1024*1024||h.shapes==0||h.nodes==0||h.nodes>2ull*h.shapes||sizeof(h)+(u64)h.packed_size!=(u64)file_size||(u64)h.shapes*sizeof(Shape)+(u64)h.nodes*sizeof(Node)!=h.raw_size){error="Missing or incompatible map collision file";return false;}
    std::vector<unsigned char> packed(h.packed_size),raw(h.raw_size);in.read((char*)packed.data(),packed.size());DECOMPRESSOR_HANDLE handle=nullptr;SIZE_T written=0;
    if(!in||!CreateDecompressor(COMPRESS_ALGORITHM_XPRESS_HUFF,nullptr,&handle)){error="Collision decompressor unavailable";return false;}bool ok=Decompress(handle,packed.data(),packed.size(),raw.data(),raw.size(),&written);CloseDecompressor(handle);
    if(!ok||written!=raw.size()||hash_bytes(raw.data(),raw.size())!=h.hash){error="Corrupt map collision data";return false;}
    std::vector<Shape> shapes(h.shapes);std::vector<Node> nodes(h.nodes);std::memcpy(shapes.data(),raw.data(),shapes.size()*sizeof(Shape));std::memcpy(nodes.data(),raw.data()+shapes.size()*sizeof(Shape),nodes.size()*sizeof(Node));
    for(const auto&s:shapes)if(!finite(s.a)||!finite(s.b)||!finite(s.c)||s.kind>1||!std::isfinite(s.radius)||s.radius<0){error="Invalid collision primitive";return false;}
    std::vector<bool> visited(nodes.size());std::function<bool(u32,unsigned)> validate=[&](u32 index,unsigned depth){if(index>=nodes.size()||depth>100||visited[index])return false;visited[index]=true;auto& n=nodes[index];if(!finite(n.low)||!finite(n.high)||n.low.x>n.high.x||n.low.y>n.high.y||n.low.z>n.high.z)return false;if(n.count)return (u64)n.first+n.count<=shapes.size();return validate(n.left,depth+1)&&validate(n.right,depth+1);};
    if(!validate(0,0)||std::find(visited.begin(),visited.end(),false)!=visited.end()){error="Invalid collision BVH";return false;}shapes_=std::move(shapes);nodes_=std::move(nodes);map_=map;return true;
}
bool camera_origin(const float* m,Vec3& position){Vec3 a{m[0],m[1],m[2]},b{m[4],m[5],m[6]},c{m[12],m[13],m[14]};float determinant=dot(a,cross(b,c));if(!std::isfinite(determinant)||std::fabs(determinant)<1e-7f)return false;position=(cross(b,c)*(-m[3])+cross(c,a)*(-m[7])+cross(a,b)*(-m[15]))*(1/determinant);return finite(position);}
static std::array<u32,13> obstacle_key(const Obstacle& value){
    auto bits=[](float number){if(number==0)number=0;u32 key=0;std::memcpy(&key,&number,sizeof(key));return key;};
    return {bits(value.origin.x),bits(value.origin.y),bits(value.origin.z),bits(value.low.x),bits(value.low.y),bits(value.low.z),bits(value.high.x),bits(value.high.y),bits(value.high.z),bits(value.angles.x),bits(value.angles.y),bits(value.angles.z),bits(value.scale)};
}

// Geometry is built/decompressed only by this worker. A reader holds an
// immutable scene/obstacle snapshot, never the loader mutex during traversal.
class NativeSceneLoader {
    using ScenePtr=std::shared_ptr<const Scene>;
    using ObstaclesPtr=std::shared_ptr<const std::vector<Obstacle>>;
    mutable std::mutex mutex_;
    std::mutex shutdown_mutex_;
    std::condition_variable wake_;
    std::thread worker_;
    bool stopping_=false,requested_once_=false,pending_=false;
    asset_loader_retry::State retry_;
    u64 generation_=0,published_generation_=0;
    GameMapKey requested_;
    std::string message_="Map collision not loaded";
    Revision revision_{};
    ScenePtr scene_;
    ObstaclesPtr obstacles_=std::make_shared<const std::vector<Obstacle>>();
    // Keep retired ownership until existing traces release their references.
    // The worker then reclaims the large BVH outside every state/query lock.
    std::vector<ScenePtr> retired_;
    static void advance(u64& value){if(++value==0)++value;}
    void run(){
        for(;;){
            GameMapKey key;u64 generation=0;bool have_job=false;
            std::vector<ScenePtr> reclaim;
            {
                std::unique_lock lock(mutex_);
                if(!pending_&&retired_.empty())wake_.wait(lock,[&]{return stopping_||pending_||!retired_.empty();});
                else if(!pending_)wake_.wait_for(lock,std::chrono::milliseconds(25),[&]{return stopping_||pending_;});
                if(stopping_)return;
                for(auto it=retired_.begin();it!=retired_.end();){
                    if(it->use_count()==1){reclaim.push_back(std::move(*it));it=retired_.erase(it);}else ++it;
                }
                if(pending_){key=requested_;generation=generation_;pending_=false;have_job=true;}
            }
            reclaim.clear();
            if(!have_job)continue;
            const auto started=now_ms();const auto* asset=find_map_asset(key);const std::string label=key.game_id+"/"+key.map_id+" @"+std::to_string(key.build_revision);std::shared_ptr<Scene> next;std::string error;bool loaded=false;
            try{next=std::make_shared<Scene>();if(asset)loaded=next->load(asset->path,key.map_id,asset->asset_revision,error);else error="Map asset is not registered";}
            catch(const std::exception&){error="Collision load raised an exception";}
            catch(...){error="Collision load raised an unknown exception";}
            std::string report;bool obsolete=false;
            {
                std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
                if(stopping_)return;
                obsolete=generation!=generation_||key!=requested_;
                if(!obsolete){
                    // A stale completion must not alter the current request's retry state.
                    retry_.finish(loaded,now_ms());
                    if(loaded){scene_=std::move(next);published_generation_=generation;advance(revision_.scene);message_="Ready: "+label+": "+std::to_string(scene_->size())+" collision primitives";}
                    else{published_generation_=0;message_="Unavailable: "+label+": "+(error.empty()?"Collision load failed":error);}
                    report=message_;
                }
            }
            if(obsolete)plat_log("Collision load discarded: %s (request changed), elapsed=%llu ms",label.c_str(),(unsigned long long)(now_ms()-started));
            else plat_log("Collision: %s, load elapsed=%llu ms",report.c_str(),(unsigned long long)(now_ms()-started));
        }
    }
public:
    struct Context{ScenePtr scene;ObstaclesPtr obstacles;Revision revision;u64 generation=0;};
    NativeSceneLoader()=default;
    ~NativeSceneLoader(){shutdown();}
    NativeSceneLoader(const NativeSceneLoader&)=delete;
    NativeSceneLoader& operator=(const NativeSceneLoader&)=delete;
    void request(const GameMapKey& key){
        std::string report;
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
            if(stopping_||!retry_.accepts(requested_once_&&requested_==key,now_ms()))return;
            // Invalidate before scheduling I/O. Retired geometry cannot answer
            // queries for a new, empty, invalid or unsuccessfully loaded map.
            requested_once_=true;requested_=key;advance(generation_);advance(revision_.scene);published_generation_=0;
            if(scene_)retired_.push_back(std::move(scene_));
            // Dynamic geometry from another map/game is not retained either.
            if(!obstacles_->empty()){obstacles_=std::make_shared<const std::vector<Obstacle>>();advance(revision_.obstacles);}
            const bool valid_key=!key.game_id.empty()&&key.game_id.size()<=64&&!key.map_id.empty()&&key.map_id.size()<=128;
            const auto* asset=valid_key?find_map_asset(key):nullptr;pending_=asset!=nullptr;
            // Existing per-frame selection retries only failed registered assets,
            // after the backoff; it never restarts a ready or in-flight load.
            retry_.begin(pending_);
            const std::string label=key.game_id+"/"+key.map_id+" @"+std::to_string(key.build_revision);
            message_=key.map_id.empty()?"Unavailable: map not identified":(!asset?"Unavailable: no map geometry registered for "+label:"Loading: "+label);
            if(asset&&!worker_.joinable()){
                try{worker_=std::thread([this]{run();});}
                catch(...){pending_=false;retry_.finish(false,now_ms());message_="Unavailable: map loader worker could not start";}
            }
            report=message_;
        }
        wake_.notify_one();plat_log("Collision: %s",report.c_str());
    }
    Context acquire()const{
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
        if(stopping_||!scene_||published_generation_!=generation_||scene_->map()!=requested_.map_id)return {};
        return {scene_,obstacles_,revision_,generation_};
    }
    Result checked(const Context& context,Result value)const{
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
        if(stopping_||context.generation!=generation_||published_generation_!=generation_||context.scene!=scene_||context.revision!=revision_)return {};
        return value;
    }
    Revision revision()const{std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);return revision_;}
    std::string status()const{std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);return message_;}
    void obstacles(std::vector<Obstacle> next){
        std::sort(next.begin(),next.end(),[](const auto& a,const auto& b){return obstacle_key(a)<obstacle_key(b);});
        next.erase(std::unique(next.begin(),next.end(),[](const auto& a,const auto& b){return obstacle_key(a)==obstacle_key(b);}),next.end());
        auto replacement=std::make_shared<const std::vector<Obstacle>>(std::move(next));ObstaclesPtr previous;
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);bool equal=obstacles_->size()==replacement->size();
            if(equal)for(size_t i=0;i<replacement->size();i++)if(obstacle_key((*obstacles_)[i])!=obstacle_key((*replacement)[i])){equal=false;break;}
            if(equal)return;
            previous=std::move(obstacles_);obstacles_=std::move(replacement);advance(revision_.obstacles);
        }
    }
    // Terminal operation: the host stops query/reader workers first. Joining may
    // wait for the current native decompression; it is never forcibly cancelled.
    void shutdown(){
        std::lock_guard shutdown_lock(shutdown_mutex_);ScenePtr release;
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
            if(stopping_)return;
            stopping_=true;pending_=false;retry_.stop();advance(generation_);advance(revision_.scene);published_generation_=0;
            release=std::move(scene_);message_="Map collision stopped";
        }
        wake_.notify_all();if(worker_.joinable())worker_.join();
        // Host has ended queries. Release final BVH ownership outside the lock.
        release.reset();retired_.clear();
    }
};
// Constructed on first host-side use, after ordinary namespace globals, so its
// destructor joins the worker before those globals are destroyed. Explicit
// shutdown() is the normal application-exit path and this is only a backstop.
static NativeSceneLoader& loader(){static NativeSceneLoader value;return value;}
void select_map(const GameMapKey& key){loader().request(key);}
void select_map(const std::string& map){select_map(GameMapKey{"deadlock",map,11193905});}
void set_obstacles(std::vector<Obstacle> obstacles){loader().obstacles(std::move(obstacles));}
Revision revision(){return loader().revision();}
std::string status(){return loader().status();}
void shutdown(){loader().shutdown();}
Result trace(Vec3 from,Vec3 to,unsigned channel){
    auto& owner=loader();auto context=owner.acquire();if(!context.scene)return {};auto result=context.scene->trace(from,to,channel);if(!result.known)return owner.checked(context,result);
    for(const auto& obstacle:*context.obstacles){
        float pitch=deg2rad(obstacle.angles.x),yaw=deg2rad(obstacle.angles.y),roll=deg2rad(obstacle.angles.z);float cp=std::cos(pitch),sp=std::sin(pitch),cy=std::cos(yaw),sy=std::sin(yaw),cr=std::cos(roll),sr=std::sin(roll);
        Vec3 x{cp*cy,cp*sy,-sp},y{cy*sp*sr-sy*cr,sy*sp*sr+cy*cr,cp*sr},z{cy*sp*cr+sy*sr,sy*sp*cr-cy*sr,cp*cr};
        auto local=[&](Vec3 point){Vec3 relative=point-obstacle.origin;return Vec3{dot(relative,x),dot(relative,y),dot(relative,z)}*(1/obstacle.scale);};Vec3 a=local(from),delta=local(to)-a;float enter=0,exit=result.fraction;bool hit=true;
        for(int axis=0;axis<3;axis++){float p=component(a,axis),v=component(delta,axis),low=component(obstacle.low,axis),high=component(obstacle.high,axis);if(std::fabs(v)<1e-8f){if(p<low||p>high){hit=false;break;}continue;}float first=(low-p)/v,last=(high-p)/v;if(first>last)std::swap(first,last);enter=std::max(enter,first);exit=std::min(exit,last);if(enter>exit){hit=false;break;}}
        if(hit&&enter<result.fraction){result.clear=false;result.fraction=enter;result.hit=from+(to-from)*enter;}
    }return owner.checked(context,result);
}
Result trace_any(Vec3 from,Vec3 to,unsigned channel){
    auto& owner=loader();auto context=owner.acquire();if(!context.scene)return {};auto result=context.scene->trace_any(from,to,channel);if(!result.known||!result.clear)return owner.checked(context,result);
    for(const auto& obstacle:*context.obstacles){
        // Missing/invalid dynamic geometry cannot establish a clear ray.
        if(!finite(obstacle.origin)||!finite(obstacle.low)||!finite(obstacle.high)||!finite(obstacle.angles)||!std::isfinite(obstacle.scale)||obstacle.scale<=0||obstacle.low.x>obstacle.high.x||obstacle.low.y>obstacle.high.y||obstacle.low.z>obstacle.high.z){result.known=false;result.clear=false;return owner.checked(context,result);}
        float pitch=deg2rad(obstacle.angles.x),yaw=deg2rad(obstacle.angles.y),roll=deg2rad(obstacle.angles.z);float cp=std::cos(pitch),sp=std::sin(pitch),cy=std::cos(yaw),sy=std::sin(yaw),cr=std::cos(roll),sr=std::sin(roll);
        Vec3 x{cp*cy,cp*sy,-sp},y{cy*sp*sr-sy*cr,sy*sp*sr+cy*cr,cp*sr},z{cy*sp*cr+sy*sr,sy*sp*cr-cy*sr,cp*cr};
        auto local=[&](Vec3 point){Vec3 relative=point-obstacle.origin;return Vec3{dot(relative,x),dot(relative,y),dot(relative,z)}*(1/obstacle.scale);};Vec3 a=local(from),delta=local(to)-a;float enter=0,exit=1;bool hit=true;
        for(int axis=0;axis<3;axis++){float p=component(a,axis),v=component(delta,axis),low=component(obstacle.low,axis),high=component(obstacle.high,axis);if(std::fabs(v)<1e-8f){if(p<low||p>high){hit=false;break;}continue;}float first=(low-p)/v,last=(high-p)/v;if(first>last)std::swap(first,last);enter=std::max(enter,first);exit=std::min(exit,last);if(enter>exit){hit=false;break;}}
        if(hit&&enter<1){result.clear=false;result.fraction=enter;result.hit=from+(to-from)*enter;return owner.checked(context,result);}
    }return owner.checked(context,result);
}
}
#ifdef ACE_COLLISION_BAKER
int main(int argc,char**argv){

namespace autouse{
enum Kind{Buff,Area,Cleanse,Targeted};
struct Rule{const char* key;const char* title;u32 token,hero;Kind kind;float radius,delay;unsigned upgrade_bits;};
inline const std::vector<Rule>& rules(){
    static const std::vector<Rule> result=[](){std::vector<Rule> entries;
        auto add=[&](const char* key,Kind kind,float radius,float delay,unsigned upgrade_bits=0){for(const auto& data:ability_data::entries)if(std::string(data.key)==key)entries.push_back({data.key,data.title,data.token,data.hero,kind,radius,delay,upgrade_bits});};
        add("upgrade_surging_power",Buff,0,0);add("upgrade_metal_skin",Buff,0,0);add("upgrade_return_fire",Buff,0,0);add("upgrade_unstoppable",Buff,0,0);add("upgrade_infuser",Buff,0,0);add("upgrade_silencer",Buff,0,0);add("upgrade_dps_aura",Buff,0,0);add("upgrade_colossus",Area,world_units::units(14),0);add("upgrade_nullification_aura",Area,world_units::units(20),.6f);add("ability_nano_shadow_step",Cleanse,0,0,4);add("upgrade_cold_front",Area,world_units::units(10),.6f);add("upgrade_arctic_blast",Area,world_units::units(16),.6f);
        add("citadel_ability_self_vacuum",Area,world_units::units(7),.2f);add("synth_affliction",Area,world_units::units(9),.6f);
        add("ability_ult_combo",Targeted,world_units::units(4),0);
        add("upgrade_reduce_debuff_duration",Cleanse,0,0);add("ability_smoke_bomb",Cleanse,0,0,8);
        add("upgrade_containment",Targeted,world_units::units(25),.1f);add("upgrade_greater_withering_whip",Targeted,world_units::units(32),.1f);add("upgrade_glitch",Targeted,world_units::units(20),.1f);
        return entries;
    }();return result;
}
inline std::string prefix(u32 token){return "auto."+std::to_string(token)+".";}

#include "autouse.h"
#include "consumer_demand.h"

namespace autouse{
static std::mutex status_mutex;static std::string message="Automatic usage disabled";
static void note(std::string text){std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(status_mutex);message=std::move(text);}
std::string status(){std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(status_mutex);return message;}
bool reload_window(float begin,float end,float pause,float fraction,float width,float time){
    if(!std::isfinite(begin+end+pause+fraction+width+time)||begin<0||end<=begin||pause<0||fraction<=0||fraction>=1||width<=0||width>2)return false;
    float effective=begin+pause;if(effective>=end)return false;float center=effective+(end-effective)*fraction;
    // Match the native primary-weapon window; wait until its centre, with a 20ms trailing margin.
    return time>=center&&time<center+width*.5f-.02f;
}
static bool clear_path(Vec3 from,Vec3 to,bool required){if(!required)return true;auto result=collision::trace(from,to,collision::Ability);return result.known&&result.clear;}
Choice choose(const Entity& local,const std::vector<Entity>& enemies,const std::vector<Entity>& friends,float time,bool require_los,u64 width,u64 height){
    Choice none;if(!local.alive||!local.modifiers_valid||!local.abilities_valid||local.invuln)return none;
    // Selected, removable enemy effects take priority over offensive item usage.
    for(int pass=0;pass<2;pass++)for(const auto& rule:rules()){
        if((pass==0)!=(rule.kind==Cleanse)||(rule.hero&&rule.hero!=local.hero))continue;
        auto p=prefix(rule.token);if(!cfg.B((p+"enabled").c_str()))continue;
        const Ability* own=nullptr;for(const auto& a:local.abilities)if(a.token==rule.token&&a.valid&&a.ready)own=&a;
        if(!own||(own->upgrade_bits&rule.upgrade_bits)!=rule.upgrade_bits)continue;
        int key=cfg.I((p+"key").c_str());if(!key)continue;
        if(rule.kind==Cleanse){bool selected=false;for(auto token:local.removable_debuffs)if(cfg.B(("cleanse.watch."+std::to_string(token)).c_str()))selected=true;if(!selected)continue;return {rule.token,own->base,key,false,std::string(rule.title)+": selected removable debuff"};}
        if(std::string(rule.key)=="upgrade_surging_power"&&(local.disarmed||local.reloading||!local.weapon_valid))continue;
        float health=0;if(!entity_health::percentage(local,health)||health>cfg.F((p+"health").c_str()))continue;
        float radius=world_units::units(cfg.F((p+"range").c_str()));
        float effective=ability_range::known_lower_bound(local,rule.token,rule.radius);
        if(rule.kind==Area||rule.kind==Targeted)radius=std::min(radius,effective);
        if(rule.kind==Targeted){
            // Unit-target items cast at the current reticle. Do not send an item key at an off-screen candidate.
            if(!width||!height)continue;
            for(const auto& enemy:enemies){
                if(!target_rules::selected(local,enemy,p)||enemy.pos.dist(local.pos)>radius)continue;
                if(std::string(rule.key)=="ability_ult_combo"){
                    int support=0;float support_range=world_units::units(cfg.F((p+"friend_range").c_str()));
                    for(const auto& ally:friends)if(ally.alive&&ally.team==local.team&&ally.pos.dist(enemy.pos)<=support_range&&clear_path(ally.pos+Vec3{0,0,40},enemy.pos+Vec3{0,0,55},require_los))support++;
                    if(support<cfg.I((p+"friends").c_str()))continue;
                }
                if(!clear_path(local.pos+Vec3{0,0,40},enemy.pos+Vec3{0,0,55},require_los))continue;
                auto screen=world_to_screen(enemy.pos+Vec3{0,0,55},width,height);if(screen.x<-1000||(screen-Vec2{width*.5f,height*.5f}).len()>6)continue;
                return {rule.token,own->base,key,false,std::string(rule.title)+": selected visible hero under crosshair"};
            }continue;
        }
        int count=0;for(const auto& enemy:enemies){if(!enemy.alive||!enemy.visible||enemy.invuln||enemy.stealthed)continue;
            if(enemy.pos.dist(local.pos)>radius||(enemy.pos+enemy.vel*rule.delay).dist(local.pos+local.vel*rule.delay)>radius)continue;
            if(!clear_path(local.pos+Vec3{0,0,40},enemy.pos+Vec3{0,0,40},require_los))continue;
            if(std::string(rule.key)=="upgrade_surging_power"&&enemy.bullet_invuln)continue;count++;
        }if(count<cfg.I((p+"enemies").c_str()))continue;
        int teammates=0;float teammate_range=world_units::units(cfg.F((p+"friend_range").c_str()));
        for(const auto& ally:friends)if(ally.alive&&ally.pos.dist(local.pos)<=teammate_range&&clear_path(local.pos+Vec3{0,0,40},ally.pos+Vec3{0,0,40},require_los))teammates++;
        if(teammates<cfg.I((p+"friends").c_str()))continue;
        return {rule.token,own->base,key,false,std::string(rule.title)+": "+std::to_string(count)+" visible enemies"};
    }
    if(cfg.B("auto.active_reload")&&local.weapon_valid&&local.reloading&&local.active_reload_allowed&&!local.disarmed&&reload_window(local.reload_begin,local.reload_end,local.reload_pause,local.reload_fraction,local.reload_width,time)){
        for(const auto& a:local.abilities)if(a.type=="CCitadel_Item_ActiveReload"&&a.valid&&a.ready&&!a.active_reload_failed)return {a.token,a.base,cfg.I("auto.reload_key"),true,"Active Reload: native success window"};
    }return none;
}
void tick(u64 width,u64 height){
    consumer_demand::note_automatic_tick();
    if(!game_data_permits_output()||inp.panic||defense::busy()){note("Waiting for playable data / defensive action");return;}
    Entity local;std::vector<Entity> enemies,friends;float time=0;bool require_los=false,enabled=false;u64 pawn=0;
    {std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(snap_mtx);
        pawn=snap.local.base;enabled=consumer_demand::automatic(cfg,snap.local.hero);
        if(enabled){local=snap.local;enemies=snap.enemies;friends=snap.friendlies;time=snap.game_time;require_los=snap.backend_managed;}
    }
    static u64 hero_pawn=0;static std::unordered_map<u64,u64> attempts;static u64 last_reload=0;
    if(hero_pawn!=pawn){attempts.clear();last_reload=0;hero_pawn=pawn;}
    if(!enabled){note("Automatic usage disabled");return;}
    auto choice=choose(local,enemies,friends,time,require_los,width,height);if(!choice.token){note("Watching configured conditions");return;}
    u64 reload_id=(u64)(local.reload_begin*1000);if(choice.reload&&reload_id==last_reload)return;
    u64 now=now_ms();auto found=attempts.find(choice.ability);if(found!=attempts.end()&&now-found->second<1500)return;
    if(cfg.I("input.mode")==2){if(cfg.B("dbg.action_log"))action_note("Automatic use (test only): "+choice.reason);}
    else{if(!hw::can_send(choice.key)){note("Action blocked: output key capability is not verified");return;}hw::key_tap(choice.key,30);}
    attempts[choice.ability]=now;if(choice.reload)last_reload=reload_id;note(((cfg.I("input.mode")==2)?"Test only: ":"Input attempted: ")+choice.reason);
}
}

:::FILE game_icons.cpp
#include "game_icons.h"
#include "game_art.h"
#include <wincodec.h>
#include <vector>
namespace game_icons{
static ID3D11ShaderResourceView* images[5]{};static unsigned widths[5]{},heights[5]{};static bool uninitialize=false;
void shutdown(){for(auto& image:images){if(image)image->Release();image=nullptr;}if(uninitialize)CoUninitialize();uninitialize=false;}
void initialize(ID3D11Device* device){
    shutdown();uninitialize=SUCCEEDED(CoInitializeEx(nullptr,COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED));
    for(int i=0;i<5;i++){
        IWICImagingFactory* factory=nullptr;IWICStream* stream=nullptr;IWICBitmapDecoder* decoder=nullptr;IWICBitmapFrameDecode* frame=nullptr;IWICFormatConverter* converter=nullptr;ID3D11Texture2D* texture=nullptr;
        HRESULT hr=CoCreateInstance(CLSID_WICImagingFactory,nullptr,CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER,IID_PPV_ARGS(&factory));
        if(SUCCEEDED(hr))hr=factory->CreateStream(&stream);if(SUCCEEDED(hr))hr=stream->InitializeFromMemory((BYTE*)game_art::images[i].data,(DWORD)game_art::images[i].size);
        if(SUCCEEDED(hr))hr=factory->CreateDecoderFromStream(stream,nullptr,WICDecodeMetadataCacheOnLoad,&decoder);if(SUCCEEDED(hr))hr=decoder->GetFrame(0,&frame);
        if(SUCCEEDED(hr))hr=factory->CreateFormatConverter(&converter);if(SUCCEEDED(hr))hr=converter->Initialize(frame,GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppRGBA,WICBitmapDitherTypeNone,nullptr,0,WICBitmapPaletteTypeCustom);
        UINT width=0,height=0;if(SUCCEEDED(hr))hr=converter->GetSize(&width,&height);
        if(SUCCEEDED(hr)&&width&&height&&width<=2048&&height<=2048){widths[i]=width;heights[i]=height;std::vector<unsigned char> pixels(width*height*4);hr=converter->CopyPixels(nullptr,width*4,(UINT)pixels.size(),pixels.data());
            if(SUCCEEDED(hr)){for(size_t pixel=0;pixel<pixels.size();pixel+=4){for(int channel=0;channel<3;channel++)pixels[pixel+channel]=(unsigned char)(32+(unsigned)pixels[pixel+channel]*223/255);pixels[pixel+3]=255;}D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC desc{};desc.Width=width;desc.Height=height;desc.MipLevels=desc.ArraySize=1;desc.Format=DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;desc.SampleDesc.Count=1;desc.Usage=D3D11_USAGE_IMMUTABLE;desc.BindFlags=D3D11_BIND_SHADER_RESOURCE;D3D11_SUBRESOURCE_DATA data{pixels.data(),width*4,0};hr=device->CreateTexture2D(&desc,&data,&texture);if(SUCCEEDED(hr))device->CreateShaderResourceView(texture,nullptr,&images[i]);}
        }
        if(texture)texture->Release();if(converter)converter->Release();if(frame)frame->Release();if(decoder)decoder->Release();if(stream)stream->Release();if(factory)factory->Release();
    }
}
ImTextureID get(int index){return index>=0&&index<5?(ImTextureID)images[index]:nullptr;}
void dimensions(int index,unsigned& width,unsigned& height){width=index>=0&&index<5?widths[index]:0;height=index>=0&&index<5?heights[index]:0;}
}

:::FILE ability_tracking.h
#pragma once
#include "entities.h"
#include "ability_catalog.h"
#include <cmath>
namespace ability_tracking{
enum class State{Unknown,Untrained,Ready,Cooldown,Casting,Unavailable};
struct View{unsigned token=0;State state=State::Unknown;int seconds=0,charges=0;};
inline View view(const Entity& entity,int slot,float game_time,bool fresh){
    View result;const auto* definition=ability_data::signature(entity.hero,slot);if(definition)result.token=definition->token;
    if(!fresh||!std::isfinite(game_time))return result;
    if(slot==3&&entity.public_ultimate_valid&&entity.public_ultimate_sample_ms&&now_ms()>=entity.public_ultimate_sample_ms&&now_ms()-entity.public_ultimate_sample_ms<=250){
        if(!entity.public_ultimate_trained){result.state=State::Untrained;return result;}
        float remaining=std::max(entity.public_ultimate_stopped_remaining,entity.public_ultimate_cooldown_end-game_time);
        if(remaining>0){result.state=State::Cooldown;result.seconds=(int)std::ceil(std::min(36000.f,remaining));return result;}
        result.state=State::Ready;return result;
    }
    if(!entity.abilities_valid)return result;
    for(auto& ability:entity.abilities)if(ability.slot==slot&&ability.valid){
        // Reject an unexpected token in a signature slot rather than labeling the wrong ability.
        if(!definition||ability.token!=definition->token)continue;
        result.charges=ability.charges;
        if(!ability.trained){result.state=State::Untrained;return result;}
        if(ability.casting||ability.channeling){result.state=State::Casting;return result;}
        if(ability.ready){result.state=State::Ready;return result;}
        if(ability.cooldown_end>game_time&&std::isfinite(ability.cooldown_end)){result.seconds=(int)std::ceil(std::min(36000.f,ability.cooldown_end-game_time));result.state=State::Cooldown;return result;}
        result.state=State::Unavailable;return result;
    }return result;
}
}

inline bool movement(unsigned token){switch(token){case 2824119765u:case 509856396u:case 725153709u:case 147493976u:case 494112189u:case 1792773251u:case 1426567660u:case 1009029159u:case 2054144742u:case 1904698842u:case 2031714424u:case 3452399392u:case 2240607294u:case 3516947824u:case 1247583368u:case 1963397252u:case 2670099061u:case 2398133749u:case 1336069669u:case 1568845221u:case 1458044103u:case 1835738020u:case 2717130900u:case 1796564033u:case 1469918191u:case 4147641675u:case 2566573207u:return true;default:return false;}}
inline bool selected(const Entity& local,const Entity& enemy,const std::string& prefix){
    if(!enemy.alive||enemy.team==local.team||!enemy.visible||enemy.invuln||enemy.stealthed)return false;
    if(!cfg.B((prefix+"all_heroes").c_str())&&!cfg.B((prefix+"hero."+std::to_string(enemy.hero)).c_str()))return false;
    if(cfg.B((prefix+"soul_lead_only").c_str())&&(enemy.souls<local.souls||enemy.souls-local.souls<(u64)cfg.I((prefix+"soul_lead").c_str())))return false;
    if(cfg.B((prefix+"movement_ready").c_str())){
        if(!enemy.abilities_valid)return false;bool found=false;
        for(const auto& a:enemy.abilities)if(a.valid&&a.ready&&movement(a.token)&&cfg.B((prefix+"watch."+std::to_string(a.token)).c_str()))found=true;
        if(!found)return false;
    }return true;
}

:::FILE prediction.h
#pragma once
#include "utils.h"
namespace prediction{
enum class Kind{Unavailable,Projectile,Beam,UnitTarget};
struct Shot{
    Kind kind=Kind::Unavailable;bool valid=false,variable_speed=false;
    float speed=0,gravity=0,inherit_velocity=0,delay=0,lifetime=0,range=0,radius=0;
    u64 source=0;u32 token=0;std::string name,reason="Ballistics not available";
};
struct Solution{bool valid=false;Vec3 point{},launch{},velocity{},target{};float flight=0,delay=0;};
inline bool finite(Vec3 v){return std::isfinite(v.x)&&std::isfinite(v.y)&&std::isfinite(v.z);}
inline Solution solve(const Shot& shot,Vec3 origin,Vec3 shooter_velocity,Vec3 target,Vec3 target_velocity,float additional_delay=0){
    Solution result;
    if(!shot.valid||shot.kind==Kind::Unavailable||!finite(origin)||!finite(shooter_velocity)||!finite(target)||!finite(target_velocity)||!std::isfinite(additional_delay)||additional_delay<0||additional_delay>1||!std::isfinite(shot.delay)||shot.delay<0||shot.delay>5)return result;
    float delay=shot.delay+additional_delay;Vec3 launch=origin+shooter_velocity*delay,at_launch=target+target_velocity*delay;
    if(shot.kind==Kind::Beam){if(shot.range>0&&launch.dist(at_launch)>shot.range)return result;result.valid=true;result.point=at_launch;result.launch=launch;result.target=at_launch;result.delay=delay;return result;}
    if(!std::isfinite(shot.speed)||shot.speed<=0||!std::isfinite(shot.gravity)||shot.gravity<0||!std::isfinite(shot.inherit_velocity)||shot.inherit_velocity<0||shot.inherit_velocity>2)return result;
    float maximum=shot.lifetime>0?std::min(shot.lifetime,8.f):8.f;if(shot.range>0)maximum=std::min(maximum,shot.range/shot.speed);if(!std::isfinite(maximum)||maximum<=0)return result;
    Vec3 r=at_launch-launch,v=target_velocity-shooter_velocity*shot.inherit_velocity;
    auto required=[&](float t){return r+v*t+Vec3{0,0,.5f*shot.gravity*t*t};};
    auto error=[&](float t){return required(t).len()-shot.speed*t;};
    float low=0,high=0,previous=error(0);if(previous<.001f)return result;
    // Find the first physically reachable root. The later high arc is deliberately not chosen.
    for(int i=1;i<=256;i++){float t=maximum*i/256,now=error(t);if(!std::isfinite(now))return result;if(now<=0&&previous>=0){high=t;break;}low=t;previous=now;}
    if(high<=0)return result;
    for(int i=0;i<36;i++){float mid=(low+high)*.5f;if(error(mid)>0)low=mid;else high=mid;}
    float flight=(low+high)*.5f;Vec3 needed=required(flight);float distance=needed.len();if(distance<=0||!finite(needed))return result;
    result.valid=true;result.point=launch+needed;result.launch=launch;result.velocity=needed*(shot.speed/distance)+shooter_velocity*shot.inherit_velocity;result.target=target+target_velocity*(delay+flight);result.flight=flight;result.delay=delay;return result;
}
inline Vec3 position(const Solution& result,float time,float gravity){return result.launch+result.velocity*time+Vec3{0,0,-.5f*gravity*time*time};}
}

:::FILE prediction_native.h
#pragma once
#include "prediction.h"
#include <array>
#include <functional>
namespace prediction_native{
using Read=std::function<bool(u64,void*,u32)>;
inline constexpr u32 primary_symbol=0x3641c28,gravity_reference=0x39986e0;
inline constexpr u32 cache_enabled=0x3e1b7af,cache_modes=0x3e1b6b0,cache_default_mode=0x3e1b7b4;
inline constexpr u32 parameter_hash=0x63392de3;
template<class T>inline bool get(const Read& read,u64 a,T& v){return a>0x10000&&a<0x00007fffffffffffULL&&read(a,&v,sizeof(v));}
inline bool multiplier(const Read& read,u64 client,u64 modifiers,int value,int tick,float& result){
    unsigned char enabled=0,mode=0;if(!get(read,client+cache_enabled,enabled)||enabled!=1||!get(read,client+cache_modes+value,mode))return false;
    if(!mode&&!get(read,client+cache_default_mode,mode))return false;
    // These modes explicitly ignore call-specific parameters. Other modes need a different cache key.
    if(mode!=3&&mode!=4)return false;
    u32 epoch=0;uint16_t dirty=0;if(!get(read,modifiers+0x210,epoch)||!epoch||!get(read,modifiers+0x214+value*2,dirty)||dirty)return false;
    std::array<unsigned char,48> entry{};u64 at=modifiers+0x410+value*48;if(!read(at,entry.data(),(u32)entry.size()))return false;
    auto word=[&](int offset){u32 v;std::memcpy(&v,entry.data()+offset,4);return v;};
    if((word(0)&1)||word(4)!=parameter_hash||word(8)!=epoch||(mode==4&&(tick<0||word(12)!=(u32)tick)))return false;
    u32 after=0,last_epoch=0;if(!get(read,at,after)||after!=word(0)||!get(read,modifiers+0x210,last_epoch)||last_epoch!=epoch)return false;
    u32 kind=word(16);float percent=0;std::memcpy(&percent,entry.data()+32,4);
    if(kind==0){result=1;return true;}if((kind!=2&&kind!=5)||!std::isfinite(percent)||percent < -100||percent>10000)return false;
    result=std::max(0.f,(100+percent)*.01f);return true;
}
inline bool no_modifiers(const Read& read,u64 modifiers,int value){
    unsigned char list=0;if(!get(read,modifiers+0xa0+value,list))return false;if(list==255)return true;
    u64 groups=0;int count=-1;return get(read,modifiers+0x90,groups)&&get(read,groups+list*24,count)&&count==0;
}
inline bool weapon_info(const Read& read,u64 client,u64 vdata,u64& result){
    u64 symbol=0,nodes=0;int root=-1;u32 capacity=0;
    if(!get(read,client+primary_symbol,symbol)||!symbol||!get(read,vdata+0x18c,capacity)||!get(read,vdata+0x190,nodes)||!get(read,vdata+0x198,root))return false;
    capacity&=0x7fffffff;if(!capacity||capacity>128)return false;
    for(unsigned tries=0;tries<capacity&&root>=0&&(u32)root<capacity;tries++){
        u64 node=nodes+(u64)root*0x8e8,key=0;int left=-1,right=-1;
        if(!get(read,node+0x10,key))return false;if(key==symbol){result=node+0x18;return true;}
        if(!get(read,node,left)||!get(read,node+4,right))return false;root=symbol<key?left:right;
    }return false;
}
inline prediction::Shot read(const Read& memory,u64 client,u64 vdata,u64 modifiers,int tick,bool ability){
    prediction::Shot shot;u64 info=0;if(!weapon_info(memory,client,vdata,info)){shot.reason="Weapon definition unavailable";return shot;}
    std::array<unsigned char,0x108> raw{};if(!memory(info,raw.data(),(u32)raw.size()))return shot;
    auto scalar=[&](int offset){float v=0;std::memcpy(&v,raw.data()+offset,4);return v;};int type=0;std::memcpy(&type,raw.data()+0xc,4);
    if(type==1){shot.range=scalar(0x50);shot.delay=scalar(0x40);shot.kind=prediction::Kind::Beam;shot.valid=std::isfinite(shot.range+shot.delay)&&shot.range>=0&&shot.delay>=0&&shot.delay<=5;shot.reason="Beam: no projectile flight";return shot;}
    if(type!=0||raw[0xba]||raw[0xf8]){shot.reason="Curved, charged or variable-gravity attack needs a separate verified profile";return shot;}
    // m_mapWeaponInfos uses EBulletSpeed / bonus-bullet-speed stat 176.
    // Entity-based ability projectiles use a different profile and stat 175.
    float factor=0;if(no_modifiers(memory,modifiers,176))factor=1;else if(!multiplier(memory,client,modifiers,176,tick,factor)){shot.reason="Live speed modifier cache unavailable";return shot;}
    if(!ability&&!no_modifiers(memory,modifiers,177)){shot.reason="Base-speed override requires a verified profile";return shot;}
    u64 gravity_data=0;float gravity=0;if(!get(memory,client+gravity_reference+8,gravity_data)||!get(memory,gravity_data+0x58,gravity)||!std::isfinite(gravity)||gravity<0||gravity>4000){shot.reason="Live gravity unavailable";return shot;}
    float speed=scalar(0xd8),scale=scalar(0xe0),inherit=scalar(0xf4),delay=scalar(0x40),life=scalar(0xec),range=scalar(0x50),radius=scalar(0xe4),random=scalar(0xdc);
    if(!std::isfinite(speed+scale+inherit+delay+life+range+radius+random)||speed<=0||speed>1e7f||scale<0||scale>20||inherit<0||inherit>2||delay<0||delay>5||life<0||life>120||range<0||range>1e7f||radius<0||radius>1000||random<0||random>1){shot.reason="Invalid weapon ballistics";return shot;}
    shot.kind=prediction::Kind::Projectile;shot.speed=speed*factor;shot.gravity=gravity*scale;shot.inherit_velocity=inherit;shot.delay=delay;shot.lifetime=life;shot.range=range;shot.radius=radius;shot.variable_speed=random>0;shot.valid=shot.speed>0;shot.reason=shot.valid?"Live weapon definition and modifier cache":"Projectile speed is zero";return shot;
}
}

#include "decision_frame.h"
#pragma once
#include "aim_model.h"

namespace lead{
struct Result{bool valid=false;Vec2 screen{};prediction::Solution solution;std::string reason;};
inline prediction::Solution calculate(const prediction::Shot& shot,Vec3 target,Vec3 velocity,u64 target_host_sample=0){
    Vec3 camera,own_velocity;u64 stamp=0;bool valid=false;
    if(const auto* frame=decision_frame::active()){camera=frame->camera;valid=frame->camera_valid&&frame->frame_valid&&frame->fresh(now_ms());own_velocity=frame->local.vel;stamp=frame->entity_sample_ms;}
    else{std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(snap_mtx);camera=snap.camera;valid=snap.camera_valid&&snap.frame_valid;own_velocity=snap.local.vel;stamp=snap.last_read_ms;}
    u64 now=now_ms();if(!valid||now<stamp||now-stamp>250)return {};
    if(target_host_sample&&(now<target_host_sample||now-target_host_sample>250))return {};
    const auto point_sample=target_host_sample?target_host_sample:stamp;
    float delay=(now-point_sample+cfg.I("input.latency_ms")+cfg.I("input.delay_ms"))*.001f; // Host acquisition delay only; native pose age is unknown.
    return prediction::solve(shot,camera,own_velocity,target,velocity,delay);
}
inline bool clear_path(const prediction::Shot& shot,const prediction::Solution& solution){
    const auto geometry=collision::revision();
    if(const auto* frame=decision_frame::active())if(frame->geometry!=geometry)return false;
    int steps=std::clamp((int)std::ceil(solution.flight/.01f),1,128);Vec3 before=solution.launch;
    for(int i=1;i<=steps;i++){auto next=shot.kind==prediction::Kind::Beam?solution.point:prediction::position(solution,solution.flight*i/steps,shot.gravity);auto hit=collision::trace(before,next,collision::Bullet);if(!hit.known||!hit.clear)return false;before=next;}return collision::revision()==geometry;
}
inline Result point(const prediction::Shot& shot,const Entity& target,int bone,u64 width,u64 height,bool visibility_check=true){
    Result result;result.reason=shot.reason;if(!shot.valid||bone<0||bone>=aim_model::bone_count||shot.kind==prediction::Kind::UnitTarget)return result;
    Vec3 region;if(!aim_model::region_world(target,bone,region)){result.reason=decision_frame::managed()?"Native target joint unavailable":"Target bounds unavailable"; // ACE_NATIVE_JOINT_INTEGRATION_V1
    return result;}result.solution=calculate(shot,region,target.vel,decision_frame::managed()?target.native_joints.started_ms:0);if(!result.solution.valid){result.reason="No reachable projectile intercept";return result;}
    if(visibility_check&&!clear_path(shot,result.solution)){result.reason="Projectile path blocked or collision unavailable";return result;}
    result.screen=world_to_screen(result.solution.point,width,height);result.valid=aim_model::on_screen(result.screen,(float)width,(float)height);if(!result.valid)result.reason="Predicted aim point is outside the screen";return result;
}
}

:::FILE ability_range.h
#pragma once
#include "entities.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace ability_range {
// Installed 2026-10-31 item definitions: Greater Expansion gives 30% global
// range/radius; Mystic Expansion gives 20% only to its imbued ability.
// Use the strongest known bonus as a conservative lower bound. Other live
// modifiers and stacking rules are not inferred from a static asset table.
inline float known_lower_bound(const Entity& local, u32 ability, float base) {
    if (!std::isfinite(base) || base <= 0 || !local.abilities_valid) return base;
    float bonus = 0;
    for (const auto& item : local.abilities) {
        if (item.token == 1193964439u) bonus = std::max(bonus, .30f); // Greater Expansion
        if (item.token == 754480263u && item.imbued_valid &&
            std::find(item.imbued_tokens.begin(), item.imbued_tokens.end(), ability) != item.imbued_tokens.end())
            bonus = std::max(bonus, .20f); // Mystic Expansion
    }
    return base * (1 + bonus);
}
}

namespace esp_elements{
enum Id{Name,Souls,Distance,Ultimate,Abilities,Count};
inline constexpr int default_sides[]={0,3,1,0,1};
inline constexpr const char* features[]={"name","souls","distance","ultimate","abilities"};
inline constexpr const char* titles[]={"Name","Souls","Distance","Ultimate ready","Abilities"};
inline constexpr const char* enabled_keys[]={"esp.name","esp.souls","esp.distance","esp.ultimate","esp.abilities"};
inline constexpr const char* position_keys[]={"esp.name_position","esp.souls_position","esp.distance_position","esp.ultimate_position","esp.abilities_position"};
struct Block{bool enabled=false;int side=0;ImVec2 position{},size{};};
using Blocks=std::array<Block,Count>;
inline Blocks place(const std::array<bool,Count>& enabled,const std::array<ImVec2,Count>& sizes,float x1,float y1,float x2,float y2){
    Blocks blocks{};float lanes[4]={};
    for(int i=0;i<Count;i++){auto& b=blocks[i];b.enabled=enabled[i];b.side=std::clamp(cfg.I(position_keys[i]),0,3);b.size=sizes[i];if(b.enabled)b.position=esp_layout::stacked(b.side,x1,y1,x2,y2,b.size,lanes[b.side]);}
    float side_end=y1+std::max(lanes[2],lanes[3]);float bottom_shift=std::max(0.f,side_end+4-(y2+7));
    for(auto& b:blocks)if(b.enabled&&b.side==1)b.position.y+=bottom_shift;
    return blocks;
}
// Fit each complete lane as a group, retaining spacing when the model is zoomed.
inline void fit_preview(Blocks& blocks,ImVec2 lower,ImVec2 upper){
    struct Group{bool any=false;ImVec2 lo{1e9f,1e9f},hi{-1e9f,-1e9f};float height=0;};std::array<Group,4> groups{};
    for(auto& b:blocks)if(b.enabled){auto& g=groups[b.side];g.any=true;g.lo.x=std::min(g.lo.x,b.position.x);g.lo.y=std::min(g.lo.y,b.position.y);g.hi.x=std::max(g.hi.x,b.position.x+b.size.x);g.hi.y=std::max(g.hi.y,b.position.y+b.size.y);}
    for(int side=0;side<4;side++){auto& g=groups[side];if(!g.any)continue;g.height=g.hi.y-g.lo.y;float dx=0;if(g.lo.x<lower.x)dx=lower.x-g.lo.x;if(g.hi.x+dx>upper.x)dx=upper.x-g.hi.x;for(auto& b:blocks)if(b.enabled&&b.side==side)b.position.x+=dx;g.lo.x+=dx;g.hi.x+=dx;}
    bool split_sides=groups[2].any&&groups[3].any&&groups[2].hi.x+4>groups[3].lo.x&&groups[3].hi.x+4>groups[2].lo.x;
    float side_height=split_sides?groups[2].height+groups[3].height+4:std::max(groups[2].height,groups[3].height);
    float top_height=groups[0].height,bottom_height=groups[1].height;bool any_side=groups[2].any||groups[3].any;
    float gap_top=groups[0].any&&(any_side||groups[1].any)?4.f:0.f,gap_bottom=any_side&&groups[1].any?4.f:0.f;
    float top=groups[0].any?clampf(groups[0].lo.y,lower.y,std::max(lower.y,upper.y-top_height-side_height-bottom_height-gap_top-gap_bottom)):lower.y;
    float side_min=groups[0].any?top+top_height+gap_top:lower.y;
    float preferred_side=groups[2].any?groups[2].lo.y:groups[3].lo.y;
    float sides=any_side?clampf(preferred_side,side_min,std::max(side_min,upper.y-side_height-bottom_height-gap_bottom)):side_min;
    float bottom_min=any_side?sides+side_height+gap_bottom:side_min;
    float bottom=groups[1].any?clampf(groups[1].lo.y,bottom_min,std::max(bottom_min,upper.y-bottom_height)):bottom_min;
    float starts[]={top,bottom,sides,split_sides?sides+groups[2].height+4:sides};
    for(auto& b:blocks)if(b.enabled)b.position.y+=starts[b.side]-groups[b.side].lo.y;
}
struct AbilityRow{
    std::array<ability_tracking::View,4> states{};std::array<std::string,4> captions{};
    float icon=22,caption_font=10,slot_width=22,caption_height=0;ImVec2 size{};
};
inline AbilityRow ability_row(const std::array<ability_tracking::View,4>& states,float icon_size,bool show_seconds){
    AbilityRow row;row.states=states;row.icon=clampf(icon_size,14,40);row.caption_font=clampf(row.icon*.46f,10,14);row.slot_width=row.icon;
    for(int i=0;i<4;i++){
        auto state=states[i].state;char text[24]{};
        if(state==ability_tracking::State::Cooldown&&show_seconds)snprintf(text,sizeof(text),"%ds",states[i].seconds);
        else if(state==ability_tracking::State::Unknown)snprintf(text,sizeof(text),"?");
        else if(state==ability_tracking::State::Untrained)snprintf(text,sizeof(text),"-");
        else if(state==ability_tracking::State::Casting)snprintf(text,sizeof(text),"USE");
        row.captions[i]=text;
        if(*text){auto s=ImGui::GetFont()->CalcTextSizeA(row.caption_font,1e10f,0,text);row.slot_width=std::max(row.slot_width,s.x+4);row.caption_height=std::max(row.caption_height,s.y+3);}
    }
    row.size={row.slot_width*4+12,row.icon+row.caption_height};return row;
}
inline void draw_abilities(ImDrawList* d,ImVec2 origin,const AbilityRow& row,float alpha=1){
    for(int i=0;i<4;i++){
        const auto& state=row.states[i];bool ready=state.state==ability_tracking::State::Ready;float slot_x=origin.x+i*(row.slot_width+4);ImVec2 p{slot_x+(row.slot_width-row.icon)*.5f,origin.y};auto image=ability_icons::get(state.token);
        if(image)d->AddImage(image,p,{p.x+row.icon,p.y+row.icon},{0,0},{1,1},IM_COL32(255,255,255,(int)(alpha*(ready?255:150))));
        else{d->AddRectFilled(p,{p.x+row.icon,p.y+row.icon},IM_COL32(24,28,34,(int)(alpha*210)),2);char number[4];snprintf(number,sizeof(number),"%d",i+1);auto s=ImGui::CalcTextSize(number);d->AddText({p.x+(row.icon-s.x)*.5f,p.y+(row.icon-s.y)*.5f},IM_COL32(220,225,230,(int)(alpha*255)),number);}
        d->AddRect(p,{p.x+row.icon,p.y+row.icon},ready?IM_COL32(70,235,110,(int)(alpha*255)):IM_COL32(125,130,140,(int)(alpha*230)),2,0,1.5f);
        if(!row.captions[i].empty()){
            auto s=ImGui::GetFont()->CalcTextSizeA(row.caption_font,1e10f,0,row.captions[i].c_str());ImVec2 text{slot_x+(row.slot_width-s.x)*.5f,p.y+row.icon+3};
            d->AddRectFilled({text.x-2,text.y},{text.x+s.x+2,text.y+s.y},IM_COL32(8,10,14,(int)(alpha*220)),2);d->AddText(ImGui::GetFont(),row.caption_font,text,IM_COL32(255,255,255,(int)(alpha*255)),row.captions[i].c_str());
        }
    }
}

// build.bat generates this header and JSON from one UTC timestamp per build.

:::FILE build_stamp.ps1
param([string]$ProjectRoot = (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent))
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$taskRoot = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $ProjectRoot).Path
$taskUtc = [DateTime]::UtcNow
$taskZone = [TimeZoneInfo]::FindSystemTimeZoneById('GMT Standard Time')
$taskLondon = [TimeZoneInfo]::ConvertTimeFromUtc($taskUtc, $taskZone)
$taskZoneName = if ($taskZone.IsDaylightSavingTime($taskLondon)) { 'BST' } else { 'GMT' }
$taskHashes = @('Ace_a.txt','Ace_b.txt','build.bat') | ForEach-Object {
    $taskSourceName = $_
    $taskSourceHasher = [Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
    $taskSourceStream = [IO.File]::OpenRead((Join-Path $taskRoot $taskSourceName))
    try { $taskSourceDigest = [BitConverter]::ToString($taskSourceHasher.ComputeHash($taskSourceStream)).Replace('-','').ToLowerInvariant() }
    finally { $taskSourceStream.Dispose(); $taskSourceHasher.Dispose() }
    $taskSourceName + ':' + $taskSourceDigest
}
$taskHasher = [Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
try { $taskDigest = -join ($taskHasher.ComputeHash([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes(($taskHashes -join "`n"))) | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString('x2') }) }
finally { $taskHasher.Dispose() }
$taskId = $taskUtc.ToString("yyyyMMdd'T'HHmmss'Z'") + '-' + $taskDigest.Substring(0,10)
$taskDisplay = 'Built ' + $taskLondon.ToString('d MMM yyyy, HH:mm:ss',[Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) + ' ' + $taskZoneName
$taskIso = $taskUtc.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.fff'Z'")
$taskMetadata = [ordered]@{ build_id=$taskId; built_utc=$taskIso; display=$taskDisplay; source_sha256=$taskDigest; capabilities=[ordered]@{ auto_launch_menu_deadlock=$true; cooperative_capture=$true } }
$taskHeader = "#pragma once`nnamespace build_info{`n"
foreach ($taskEntry in @(@('id',$taskId),@('utc',$taskIso),@('display',$taskDisplay),@('source_sha256',$taskDigest))) {
    $taskHeader += 'inline constexpr char ' + $taskEntry[0] + '[]=' + (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $taskEntry[1] -Compress) + ";`n"
}
$taskHeader += "}`n"
$taskEncoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $taskRoot 'src\generated_build_info.h'), $taskHeader, $taskEncoding)
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $taskRoot 'src\build-info.json'), ($taskMetadata | ConvertTo-Json), $taskEncoding)
Write-Host ('      ' + $taskDisplay + ' | ' + $taskId)
:::ENDFILE
:::FILE makcu_serial_parser.h
#pragma once
#include <string>
#include <deque>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdint>
#include <utility>

// Independent implementation of the documented MAKCU text/prompt protocol.
namespace makcu_serial{
inline std::string trimmed(std::string value){while(!value.empty()&&std::isspace((unsigned char)value.front()))value.erase(value.begin());while(!value.empty()&&std::isspace((unsigned char)value.back()))value.pop_back();return value;}
inline bool ownership(const std::string& frame,const std::string& query,int& result){
    bool found=false;size_t from=0;
    while(from<=frame.size()){
        auto end=frame.find('\n',from);std::string line=trimmed(frame.substr(from,end==std::string::npos?std::string::npos:end-from));
        if(!line.empty()&&line!=query){if(found||line.size()!=1||line[0]<'0'||line[0]>'3')return false;result=line[0]-'0';found=true;}
        if(end==std::string::npos)break;from=end+1;
    }return found;
}
class Parser{
    std::string pending_;std::deque<std::string> frames_;
public:
    uint64_t stream_events=0,overflows=0;unsigned last_stream_mask=0;
    void reset(){pending_.clear();frames_.clear();stream_events=overflows=0;last_stream_mask=0;}
    void discard_completed(){frames_.clear();}
    std::string pending_preview()const{return pending_.substr(0,128);}
    void feed(const char* bytes,size_t size){
        pending_.append(bytes,size);
        // A prefixed mask can itself equal CR/LF. Consume its byte unconditionally;
        // bare control bytes are never guessed to be events on unknown firmware.
        for(size_t at=0;at+4<=pending_.size();){
            if(pending_.compare(at,3,"km.")==0&&(unsigned char)pending_[at+3]<=31){last_stream_mask=(unsigned char)pending_[at+3];stream_events++;pending_.erase(at,4);}
            else at++;
        }
        for(size_t end;(end=pending_.find(">>>"))!=std::string::npos;){
            frames_.push_back(pending_.substr(0,end));pending_.erase(0,end+3);
            if(frames_.size()>64){frames_.pop_front();overflows++;}
        }
        if(pending_.size()>8192){pending_.clear();overflows++;}
    }
    bool take(std::string& frame){if(frames_.empty())return false;frame=std::move(frames_.front());frames_.pop_front();return true;}
};
}

:::FILE target_geometry.h
#pragma once
#include "entities.h"
#include <array>
// Regions are proportions of each entity's collision bounds, not animated bones.
namespace target_geometry{
inline bool finite(Vec3 p){return std::isfinite(p.x)&&std::isfinite(p.y)&&std::isfinite(p.z);}
inline bool bounds(const Entity& e,Vec3& low,Vec3& high){
    if(!e.bounds_valid||!finite(e.bounds_min)||!finite(e.bounds_max)||!std::isfinite(e.scale)||e.scale<.01f||e.scale>100)return false;
    low=e.bounds_min*e.scale;high=e.bounds_max*e.scale;Vec3 size=high-low;
    return size.x>.01f&&size.y>.01f&&size.z>.01f&&size.len()<10000;
}
inline Vec3 transform(const Entity& e,Vec3 p){float yaw=deg2rad(e.facing.y),c=std::cos(yaw),s=std::sin(yaw);return e.pos+Vec3{p.x*c-p.y*s,p.x*s+p.y*c,p.z};}
inline bool region(const Entity& e,int index,Vec3& result){
    static constexpr float fraction[]={.93f,.83f,.68f,.52f,.42f,.62f,.24f};
    Vec3 low,high;if(index<0||index>=7||!bounds(e,low,high)||!finite(e.pos)||!finite(e.facing))return false;
    result=transform(e,{(low.x+high.x)*.5f,(low.y+high.y)*.5f,low.z+(high.z-low.z)*fraction[index]});return finite(result);
}
inline bool corners(const Entity& e,std::array<Vec3,8>& result){
    Vec3 low,high;if(!bounds(e,low,high)||!finite(e.pos)||!finite(e.facing))return false;
    for(int i=0;i<8;i++)result[i]=transform(e,{i&1?high.x:low.x,i&2?high.y:low.y,i&4?high.z:low.z});return true;
}
}
