:::FILE memory_batch.h
#pragma once
#include "utils.h"
#include <functional>
#include <map>

struct DmaRead {
    u64 address=0;void* data=nullptr;u32 size=0,transferred=0;bool valid=false;
};
using BatchRead=std::function<bool(std::vector<DmaRead>&)>;
namespace memory_batch {
struct Counters {u64 batches=0,requests=0,bytes=0,failed=0,hits=0,misses=0;};
// Fresh per-frame bytes, indexed by virtual page. A small field lookup should
// examine its own page's ranges, rather than every player's prefetched ranges.
// Each span still has independent complete-transfer validity; no cache survives
// clear(), no hole is filled, and a covered failed range is never silently retried.
class FrameCache {
    struct Span {u64 address;std::vector<unsigned char> bytes;bool executed=false,valid=false;};
    std::map<u64,std::vector<Span>> pages_;
    std::size_t span_count_=0;
    u64 advance(u64 at,u64 end,bool valid_only)const {
        const auto page=pages_.find(at>>12);if(page==pages_.end())return at;
        u64 next=at;
        for(const auto& span:page->second)
            if((!valid_only||(span.executed&&span.valid))&&at>=span.address&&at<span.address+span.bytes.size())
                next=std::max(next,std::min<u64>(end,span.address+span.bytes.size()));
        return next;
    }
    bool covered(u64 address,u32 size,bool valid_only)const {
        if(!size||address>UINT64_MAX-size)return false;
        const u64 end=address+size;
        for(u64 at=address;at<end;){const auto next=advance(at,end,valid_only);if(next==at)return false;at=next;}
        return true;
    }
public:
    Counters counters;
    void clear(){pages_.clear();span_count_=0;counters={};}
    bool queue(u64 address,u32 size){
        if(address<0x10000||!size||size>8u*1024*1024||address>0x00007fffffffffffULL-size)return false;
        while(size){
            const u32 part=std::min<u32>(size,4096-u32(address&4095));const u64 key=address>>12;
            auto found=pages_.find(key);
            if(found==pages_.end()){
                if(span_count_>=8192)return false;
                found=pages_.try_emplace(key).first;
            }
            auto& ranges=found->second;bool exists=false;
            for(const auto& span:ranges)if(address>=span.address&&address+part<=span.address+span.bytes.size()){exists=true;break;}
            if(!exists){
                u64 low=address,high=address+part;
                // Merge touching queued ranges only. No gaps or completed
                // samples are absorbed into a new request.
                for(std::size_t i=0;i<ranges.size();){const auto& span=ranges[i];
                    if(!span.executed&&span.address<=high&&low<=span.address+span.bytes.size()){
                        low=std::min(low,span.address);high=std::max(high,span.address+span.bytes.size());ranges.erase(ranges.begin()+i);--span_count_;i=0;
                    }else ++i;
                }
                if(span_count_>=8192)return false;
                ranges.push_back({low,std::vector<unsigned char>(std::size_t(high-low)),false,false});++span_count_;
            }
            address+=part;size-=part;
        }
        return true;
    }
    bool flush(const BatchRead& batch,const std::function<bool(u64,void*,u32)>& fallback){
        std::vector<DmaRead> requests;std::vector<Span*> owners;
        for(auto& page:pages_)for(auto& span:page.second)if(!span.executed){requests.push_back({span.address,span.bytes.data(),u32(span.bytes.size()),0,false});owners.push_back(&span);}
        bool all=true;
        // Keep the existing bounded burst and full-transfer requirements.
        for(std::size_t offset=0;offset<requests.size();offset+=512){const auto count=std::min<std::size_t>(512,requests.size()-offset);
            std::vector<DmaRead> part(requests.begin()+offset,requests.begin()+offset+count);++counters.batches;counters.requests+=count;
            bool executed=true;if(batch)executed=batch(part);else for(auto& request:part){request.valid=fallback&&fallback(request.address,request.data,request.size);request.transferred=request.valid?request.size:0;}
            for(std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i){auto& span=*owners[offset+i];span.executed=true;span.valid=executed&&part[i].valid&&part[i].transferred==part[i].size;
                if(span.valid)counters.bytes+=part[i].size;else{++counters.failed;all=false;}
            }
        }
        return all;
    }
    bool contains(u64 address,u32 size)const{return covered(address,size,true);}
    bool planned(u64 address,u32 size)const{return covered(address,size,false);}
    bool copy(u64 address,void* destination,u32 size){
        // Validate the complete range before touching the caller's buffer.
        if(!destination||!contains(address,size)){++counters.misses;return false;}
        auto* out=static_cast<unsigned char*>(destination);u64 at=address,end=address+size;
        while(at<end){const auto& ranges=pages_.find(at>>12)->second;
            for(const auto& span:ranges)if(span.executed&&span.valid&&at>=span.address&&at<span.address+span.bytes.size()){
                const auto count=std::min<u64>(end-at,span.address+span.bytes.size()-at);std::memcpy(out+(at-address),span.bytes.data()+(at-span.address),std::size_t(count));at+=count;break;
            }
        }
        ++counters.hits;return true;
    }
};
}

:::FILE scan_incremental.h
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

// Standalone proposal: no process handles, no target writes, no live execution.
namespace incremental_discovery {
using Address=std::uint64_t;
// Zero permanently requests a resync after unsigned saturation; a revision is
// never silently reused. These are host membership/metadata revisions only.
constexpr std::uint64_t next_identity_revision(std::uint64_t revision)noexcept{return revision?revision+1:0;}
constexpr bool identity_revision_changed(std::uint64_t copied,std::uint64_t current)noexcept{return !current||copied!=current;}
struct Request {
    Address address=0;
    std::uint8_t* destination=nullptr;
    std::uint32_t size=0;
    // True only if EVERY requested byte was acquired. Never zero-pad success.
    bool complete=false;
};
using Read=std::function<bool(Address,void*,std::uint32_t)>;
using Scatter=std::function<bool(std::vector<Request>&)>;
struct Class {int kind=0;std::string name;};
using Classify=std::function<bool(std::uint32_t vtable_rva,Class&)>;
struct Identity {
    Address entity=0,record=0,vtable=0;
    std::uint32_t handle=0;
    int kind=0;
    std::string name;
    bool operator==(const Identity&)const=default;
};
struct Config {
    Address entities_global=0,client_base=0;
    std::uint32_t client_size=0;
    std::uint64_t session_token=0;
    std::uint32_t stride=0x70,entries_per_chunk=512,chunk_count=64;
    std::uint32_t chunk_table_offset=0x10,handle_offset=0x10,flags_offset=0x30;
    std::uint32_t object_identity_offset=0x10,reject_flags=0x717,index_mask=0x7fff;
    std::uint32_t max_headers_per_step=128;
    std::uint64_t cycle_interval_ms=1000;
};
struct Diagnostics {
    std::uint64_t cycle=0,attempted_ms=0,completed_ms=0,interval_ms=0;
    std::uint32_t chunks=0,invalid_chunks=0,pages_read=0,pages_unavailable=0;
    std::uint32_t records_read=0,empty_records=0,flags_rejected=0,invalid_addresses=0,serial_mismatches=0;
    std::uint32_t candidates=0,object_unreadable=0,vtable_outside_client=0,unknown_classes=0,known_classes=0,identity_mismatches=0;
    std::uint32_t accepted=0,pawns=0,controllers=0,step_headers=0,step_pages=0;
    std::uint32_t direct_calls=0,scatter_calls=0;
    Address first_unavailable_page=0,first_unknown_vtable=0;
    bool active=false,complete=false;
    std::string status="not started";
};
class Engine {
public:
    Engine(Read read,Scatter scatter,Classify classify);
    // Call on reconnect/PID/module/layout change, manual recache, or reset.
    void reset(const Config&);
    // Call every reader iteration, including while a cycle is in progress.
    // At most ONE allocated chunk and max_headers_per_step candidates are read.
    // The cycle interval delays only a NEW cycle, never a continuation step.
    bool step(std::uint64_t now_ms);
    void set_cycle_interval(std::uint64_t ms){config_.cycle_interval_ms=ms<=60000?ms:60000;}
    const std::unordered_map<std::uint32_t,Identity>& identities() const{return identities_;}
    std::uint64_t identity_revision()const noexcept{return identity_revision_;}
    const Diagnostics& diagnostics() const{return diagnostics_;}
    bool active()const{return diagnostics_.active;}
private:
    struct Candidate {Address entity=0,record=0;std::uint32_t handle=0,index=0;};
    Read read_;Scatter scatter_;Classify classify_;Config config_;
    std::unordered_map<std::uint32_t,Identity> identities_;
    std::uint64_t identity_revision_=1;
    void erase_identity(std::uint32_t index);
    void put_identity(std::uint32_t index,Identity value);
    std::unordered_map<std::uint32_t,Class> known_class_cache_;
    std::unordered_map<std::uint32_t,bool> unknown_class_cache_;
    std::vector<Address> chunks_;
    std::vector<Candidate> pending_;
    std::size_t pending_position_=0;
    std::uint32_t chunk_position_=0;
    Diagnostics diagnostics_;
    bool valid_config()const;
    bool begin_cycle(std::uint64_t);
    void finish_cycle(std::uint64_t,const std::string&);
    bool load_one_chunk();
    bool read_headers(std::uint32_t budget);
    void summarize();
};
} // namespace incremental_discovery

:::FILE scan_incremental.cpp
#include "scan_incremental.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <utility>

namespace incremental_discovery {
namespace {
constexpr Address maximum=0x00007fffffffffffULL;
bool span(Address a,std::uint64_t n){return a>=0x10000&&n&&a<=maximum&&n-1<=maximum-a;}
std::uint32_t word(const std::uint8_t* p){std::uint32_t v=0;std::memcpy(&v,p,sizeof(v));return v;}
Address pointer(const std::uint8_t* p){Address v=0;std::memcpy(&v,p,sizeof(v));return v;}
}
Engine::Engine(Read read,Scatter scatter,Classify classify):read_(std::move(read)),scatter_(std::move(scatter)),classify_(std::move(classify)){}
void Engine::erase_identity(std::uint32_t index){if(identities_.erase(index))identity_revision_=next_identity_revision(identity_revision_);}
void Engine::put_identity(std::uint32_t index,Identity value){
    const auto found=identities_.find(index);if(found!=identities_.end()&&found->second==value)return;
    identities_.insert_or_assign(index,std::move(value));identity_revision_=next_identity_revision(identity_revision_);
}
void Engine::reset(const Config& config){
    config_=config;identities_.clear();identity_revision_=next_identity_revision(identity_revision_);known_class_cache_.clear();unknown_class_cache_.clear();chunks_.clear();pending_.clear();pending_position_=0;chunk_position_=0;diagnostics_={};
}
bool Engine::valid_config()const{
    if(!read_||!scatter_||!classify_||!config_.session_token||!span(config_.entities_global,8)||!span(config_.client_base,config_.client_size))return false;
    if(config_.stride<0x34||config_.stride>1024||!config_.entries_per_chunk||config_.entries_per_chunk>512||!config_.chunk_count||config_.chunk_count>64||!config_.max_headers_per_step||config_.max_headers_per_step>128)return false;
    if(config_.handle_offset>config_.stride-4||config_.flags_offset>config_.stride-4||config_.object_identity_offset<8||config_.object_identity_offset>120||config_.chunk_table_offset>4096||config_.cycle_interval_ms>60000)return false;
    return std::uint64_t(config_.entries_per_chunk)*config_.chunk_count<=std::uint64_t(config_.index_mask)+1;
}
bool Engine::begin_cycle(std::uint64_t now){
    const auto previous_attempt=diagnostics_.attempted_ms;const auto cycle=diagnostics_.cycle+1;diagnostics_={};diagnostics_.cycle=cycle;diagnostics_.attempted_ms=now;diagnostics_.interval_ms=previous_attempt?now-previous_attempt:0;diagnostics_.active=true;diagnostics_.status="incremental discovery in progress";
    Address system=0;++diagnostics_.direct_calls;
    if(!read_(config_.entities_global,&system,8)||!span(system,config_.chunk_table_offset+std::uint64_t(config_.chunk_count)*8)){finish_cycle(now,"entity system pointer unavailable");return false;}
    chunks_.assign(config_.chunk_count,0);++diagnostics_.direct_calls;
    if(!read_(system+config_.chunk_table_offset,chunks_.data(),config_.chunk_count*8)){finish_cycle(now,"entity chunk table unavailable");return false;}
    pending_.clear();pending_position_=0;chunk_position_=0;return true;
}
void Engine::summarize(){
    diagnostics_.accepted=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(identities_.size());diagnostics_.pawns=diagnostics_.controllers=0;
    for(const auto& pair:identities_){if(pair.second.kind==1)++diagnostics_.pawns;else if(pair.second.kind==2)++diagnostics_.controllers;}
}
void Engine::finish_cycle(std::uint64_t now,const std::string& status){diagnostics_.active=false;diagnostics_.complete=true;diagnostics_.completed_ms=now;diagnostics_.status=status;summarize();}
bool Engine::load_one_chunk(){
    pending_.clear();pending_position_=0;
    // Empty slots consume no PCIe transactions and do not spend the one-chunk
    // I/O budget. They DO cover their indices: old entries are invalid there.
    while(chunk_position_<chunks_.size()&&!chunks_[chunk_position_]){
        const auto first=chunk_position_*config_.entries_per_chunk;
        for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<config_.entries_per_chunk;++i)erase_identity(first+i);
        ++chunk_position_;
    }
    if(chunk_position_==chunks_.size())return false;
    const auto chunk=chunk_position_++;const auto base=chunks_[chunk];++diagnostics_.chunks;
    const auto bytes=config_.stride*config_.entries_per_chunk;
    if(!span(base,bytes)){++diagnostics_.invalid_chunks;const auto first=chunk*config_.entries_per_chunk;for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<config_.entries_per_chunk;++i)erase_identity(first+i);return true;}
    // A new chunk allocation invalidates old identity-record addresses even if
    // some pages of that NEW chunk cannot currently be acquired.
    for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<config_.entries_per_chunk;++i){auto old=identities_.find(chunk*config_.entries_per_chunk+i);if(old!=identities_.end()&&old->second.record!=base+std::uint64_t(i)*config_.stride)erase_identity(chunk*config_.entries_per_chunk+i);}
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> block(bytes);std::vector<Request> requests;std::uint32_t offset=0;
    // Buffer is allocated once before PrepareEx; it remains stable through the
    // supplied callback, which must itself close the VMM scatter handle first.
    while(offset<bytes){const auto address=base+offset;const auto count=std::min<std::uint32_t>(4096-static_cast<std::uint32_t>(address&4095),bytes-offset);requests.push_back({address,block.data()+offset,count,false});offset+=count;}
    ++diagnostics_.scatter_calls;diagnostics_.step_pages+=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(requests.size());const auto executed=scatter_(requests);
    std::vector<bool> valid(requests.size(),false);
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<requests.size();++i){valid[i]=executed&&requests[i].complete;if(valid[i])++diagnostics_.pages_read;else{++diagnostics_.pages_unavailable;if(!diagnostics_.first_unavailable_page)diagnostics_.first_unavailable_page=requests[i].address;}}
    const auto record_bytes=std::max<std::uint32_t>(8,std::max(config_.handle_offset+4,config_.flags_offset+4));
    const auto first_page=base/4096;
    for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<config_.entries_per_chunk;++i){
        const auto position=i*config_.stride;const auto first=(base+position)/4096-first_page,last=(base+position+record_bytes-1)/4096-first_page;
        bool covered=true;for(auto page=first;page<=last;++page)covered=covered&&valid[static_cast<std::size_t>(page)];
        // Do not zero-fill holes or delete identities from unavailable records.
        // Any retained identity is still revalidated by the fast entity lane.
        if(!covered)continue;
        ++diagnostics_.records_read;const auto* raw=block.data()+position;const auto entity=pointer(raw);const auto handle=word(raw+config_.handle_offset),flags=word(raw+config_.flags_offset);const auto index=chunk*config_.entries_per_chunk+i;
        auto old=identities_.find(index);if(old!=identities_.end()&&(old->second.entity!=entity||old->second.handle!=handle||old->second.record!=base+position))erase_identity(index);
        if(!entity){++diagnostics_.empty_records;erase_identity(index);continue;}
        if(flags&config_.reject_flags){++diagnostics_.flags_rejected;erase_identity(index);continue;}
        if(!span(entity,config_.object_identity_offset+8)){++diagnostics_.invalid_addresses;erase_identity(index);continue;}
        if((handle&config_.index_mask)!=index||handle==UINT32_MAX){++diagnostics_.serial_mismatches;erase_identity(index);continue;}
        ++diagnostics_.candidates;pending_.push_back({entity,base+position,handle,index});
    }
    return true;
}
bool Engine::read_headers(std::uint32_t budget){
    const auto count=std::min<std::size_t>(budget,pending_.size()-pending_position_);if(!count)return false;
    const auto header_size=config_.object_identity_offset+8;
    const auto record_size=std::max<std::uint32_t>(8,std::max(config_.handle_offset+4,config_.flags_offset+4));
    std::vector<std::array<std::uint8_t,128>> bytes(count);std::vector<std::array<std::uint8_t,1024>> records(count);std::vector<Request> requests;std::vector<std::pair<std::size_t,std::size_t>> spans(count);
    auto append=[&](Address base,std::uint8_t* data,std::uint32_t length){std::uint32_t offset=0;while(offset<length){const auto address=base+offset;const auto size=std::min<std::uint32_t>(length-offset,4096-static_cast<std::uint32_t>(address&4095));requests.push_back({address,data+offset,size,false});offset+=size;}};
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i){spans[i].first=requests.size();const auto& candidate=pending_[pending_position_+i];append(candidate.entity,bytes[i].data(),header_size);append(candidate.record,records[i].data(),record_size);spans[i].second=requests.size();}
    ++diagnostics_.scatter_calls;diagnostics_.step_headers+=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(count);const auto executed=scatter_(requests);
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i){
        const auto& candidate=pending_[pending_position_+i];bool complete=executed;for(auto r=spans[i].first;r<spans[i].second;++r)complete=complete&&requests[r].complete;
        if(!complete){++diagnostics_.object_unreadable;erase_identity(candidate.index);continue;}
        // Candidates can wait several fast frames before their budgeted header
        // pass. Recheck record pointer/serial/flags in the SAME scatter phase,
        // rather than reaccepting a handle that was recycled while queued.
        if(pointer(records[i].data())!=candidate.entity||word(records[i].data()+config_.handle_offset)!=candidate.handle){++diagnostics_.serial_mismatches;erase_identity(candidate.index);continue;}
        if(word(records[i].data()+config_.flags_offset)&config_.reject_flags){++diagnostics_.flags_rejected;erase_identity(candidate.index);continue;}
        const auto vtable=pointer(bytes[i].data()),identity=pointer(bytes[i].data()+config_.object_identity_offset);
        if(vtable<config_.client_base||vtable-config_.client_base>=config_.client_size){++diagnostics_.vtable_outside_client;erase_identity(candidate.index);continue;}
        if(identity!=candidate.record){++diagnostics_.identity_mismatches;erase_identity(candidate.index);continue;}
        const auto rva=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(vtable-config_.client_base);Class type;auto known=known_class_cache_.find(rva);
        if(known!=known_class_cache_.end())type=known->second;
        else if(unknown_class_cache_.count(rva)||!classify_(rva,type)){if(unknown_class_cache_.size()>=8192)unknown_class_cache_.clear();unknown_class_cache_[rva]=true;++diagnostics_.unknown_classes;if(!diagnostics_.first_unknown_vtable)diagnostics_.first_unknown_vtable=vtable;erase_identity(candidate.index);continue;}
        else {if(known_class_cache_.size()>=8192)known_class_cache_.clear();known_class_cache_.emplace(rva,type);}
        ++diagnostics_.known_classes;put_identity(candidate.index,{candidate.entity,candidate.record,vtable,candidate.handle,type.kind,type.name});
    }
    pending_position_+=count;return true;
}
bool Engine::step(std::uint64_t now){
    diagnostics_.step_headers=0;diagnostics_.step_pages=0;
    if(!valid_config()){diagnostics_.status="invalid incremental discovery configuration";diagnostics_.active=false;return false;}
    if(!diagnostics_.active){if(diagnostics_.complete&&now>=diagnostics_.completed_ms&&now-diagnostics_.completed_ms<config_.cycle_interval_ms)return false;if(!begin_cycle(now))return false;}
    bool work=false;
    if(pending_position_==pending_.size())work=load_one_chunk();
    work=read_headers(config_.max_headers_per_step)||work;summarize();
    if(pending_position_==pending_.size()){
        // Advance through trailing absent chunks without another I/O operation.
        while(chunk_position_<chunks_.size()&&!chunks_[chunk_position_]){const auto first=chunk_position_*config_.entries_per_chunk;for(std::uint32_t i=0;i<config_.entries_per_chunk;++i)erase_identity(first+i);++chunk_position_;}
        if(chunk_position_==chunks_.size())finish_cycle(now,identities_.empty()?"covered readable records; no validated identities":"incremental identity cycle complete");
    }
    return work;
}
} // namespace incremental_discovery

#pragma once

namespace map_identity{
inline std::string from_model(std::string path){
    for(auto& c:path){if(c=='\\')c='/';else if(c>='A'&&c<='Z')c=char(c-'A'+'a');}
    if(path.rfind("maps/",0)!=0)return {};
    auto end=path.find('/',5);if(end==std::string::npos)end=path.find('.',5);if(end==std::string::npos)return {};
    std::string map=path.substr(5,end-5);if(map.empty()||map.size()>64)return {};
    if(!std::all_of(map.begin(),map.end(),[](char c){return (c>='a'&&c<='z')||(c>='0'&&c<='9')||c=='_';}))return {};
    return map;
}
// Never require bytes beyond a terminator on a following, possibly absent page.
template<class Read>bool cstring(Read read,std::uint64_t address,std::string& out,std::size_t limit=384){
    out.clear();if(address<0x10000||address>=0x00007fffffffffffULL||limit>4096)return false;
    while(out.size()<limit){char bytes[64]{};auto count=std::min<std::size_t>({sizeof(bytes),limit-out.size(),4096-(address&4095)});
        if(!read(address,bytes,(std::uint32_t)count)){out.clear();return false;}
        auto end=(const char*)std::memchr(bytes,0,count);std::size_t length=end?(std::size_t)(end-bytes):count;
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<length;i++)if((unsigned char)bytes[i]<32||(unsigned char)bytes[i]>126){out.clear();return false;}
        out.append(bytes,length);if(end)return true;address+=count;
    }out.clear();return false;
}
}

#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

// Field/source validation only. Identity and pose are validated independently
// by the reader; no maximum-health result may reject an otherwise valid pose.
namespace health_state {
enum class Source {Unavailable,BaseEntity,ControllerGlobal};
enum class Reason {Ready,GlobalUnreadable,MaximumOutOfRange,CurrentOutOfRange,AboveMaximum,AliveWithZeroHealth,CurrentUnreadable,LifeUnreadable};
struct PlayerMaximum {bool readable=false;std::int32_t maximum=0,controller_health=0;bool controller_readable=false;};
struct State {
    std::int32_t current=0,maximum=0;Source source=Source::Unavailable;Reason reason=Reason::Ready;
    bool current_valid=false,maximum_valid=false,pair_valid=false,life_valid=false,alive_valid=false,alive=false;
};
inline const char* source_name(Source source){switch(source){case Source::BaseEntity:return "base_entity";case Source::ControllerGlobal:return "controller_player_global";default:return "unavailable";}}
inline const char* reason_name(Reason reason){switch(reason){case Reason::Ready:return "health valid";case Reason::GlobalUnreadable:return "player maximum unavailable";case Reason::MaximumOutOfRange:return "maximum out of range";case Reason::CurrentOutOfRange:return "current health out of range";case Reason::AboveMaximum:return "current exceeds reported maximum";case Reason::AliveWithZeroHealth:return "alive life-state with zero health";case Reason::CurrentUnreadable:return "current health unreadable";default:return "life state unreadable";}}
constexpr State evaluate(std::int32_t current,std::int32_t base_maximum,std::uint8_t life,bool player,const PlayerMaximum* global=nullptr,bool current_readable=true,bool base_maximum_readable=true,bool life_readable=true){
    State s;s.current=current;s.current_valid=current_readable&&current>=0&&current<10000000;s.life_valid=life_readable;
    s.alive_valid=s.current_valid&&s.life_valid&&(life!=0||current>0);s.alive=s.alive_valid&&life==0&&current>0;
    bool maximum_readable=base_maximum_readable;s.maximum=base_maximum;s.source=Source::BaseEntity;
    if(player){maximum_readable=global&&global->readable;s.maximum=maximum_readable?global->maximum:0;s.source=maximum_readable?Source::ControllerGlobal:Source::Unavailable;}
    s.maximum_valid=maximum_readable&&s.maximum>0&&s.maximum<10000000;
    s.pair_valid=s.current_valid&&s.maximum_valid&&current<=s.maximum;
    if(!current_readable)s.reason=Reason::CurrentUnreadable;
    else if(!s.current_valid)s.reason=Reason::CurrentOutOfRange;
    else if(!life_readable)s.reason=Reason::LifeUnreadable;
    else if(!maximum_readable)s.reason=Reason::GlobalUnreadable;
    else if(!s.maximum_valid)s.reason=Reason::MaximumOutOfRange;
    else if(!s.pair_valid)s.reason=Reason::AboveMaximum;
    else if(life==0&&current==0)s.reason=Reason::AliveWithZeroHealth;
    return s;
}
} // namespace health_state

:::FILE visibility_cache.h
#pragma once
#include "collision.h"
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <unordered_map>

// Owned by one snapshot-publishing thread. This caches ray answers, not target
// visibility flags; projection and team state are evaluated on every snapshot.
namespace visibility_cache{
struct Answer{bool known=false,clear=false;};
class Rays{
    struct Key{
        std::array<u32,6> points{};u64 scene=0,obstacles=0;unsigned mask=0;
        bool operator==(const Key& other)const{return points==other.points&&scene==other.scene&&obstacles==other.obstacles&&mask==other.mask;}
    };
    struct Hash{
        size_t operator()(const Key& key)const{u64 hash=1469598103934665603ULL;auto mix=[&](u64 value){hash=(hash^value)*1099511628211ULL;};for(auto value:key.points)mix(value);mix(key.scene);mix(key.obstacles);mix(key.mask);return (size_t)hash;}
    };
    struct Entry{Answer answer;u64 at=0;};
    std::unordered_map<Key,Entry,Hash> values_;
    static bool make_key(Vec3 from,Vec3 to,collision::Revision revision,unsigned mask,Key& key){
        const float values[]={from.x,from.y,from.z,to.x,to.y,to.z};
        for(size_t i=0;i<6;i++){if(!std::isfinite(values[i]))return false;static_assert(sizeof(float)==sizeof(u32));std::memcpy(&key.points[i],&values[i],sizeof(float));}
        key.scene=revision.scene;key.obstacles=revision.obstacles;key.mask=mask;return mask!=0;
    }
    void prune(u64 now){for(auto it=values_.begin();it!=values_.end();)if(now<it->second.at||now-it->second.at>ttl_ms)it=values_.erase(it);else ++it;}
public:
    static constexpr u64 ttl_ms=50;static constexpr size_t capacity=1024;
    void clear(){values_.clear();}
    size_t size()const{return values_.size();}
    bool find(Vec3 from,Vec3 to,collision::Revision revision,unsigned mask,u64 now,Answer& answer){
        answer={};Key key;if(!make_key(from,to,revision,mask,key))return false;
        auto found=values_.find(key);if(found==values_.end())return false;
        if(now<found->second.at||now-found->second.at>ttl_ms){values_.erase(found);return false;}
        answer=found->second.answer;return true; // A lookup never refreshes TTL.
    }
    void remember(Vec3 from,Vec3 to,collision::Revision revision,unsigned mask,u64 now,Answer answer){
        if(!answer.known)return;Key key;if(!make_key(from,to,revision,mask,key))return;
        if(values_.size()>=capacity){prune(now);if(values_.size()>=capacity)values_.clear();}
        values_[key]={answer,now};
    }
};
inline bool same(collision::Revision a,collision::Revision b){return a.scene==b.scene&&a.obstacles==b.obstacles;}
}

:::FILE map_probe.h
#pragma once
#include "map_identity.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>

// Diagnostics for the EXISTING C_World model candidate. This is not a newly
// verified engine2 loaded-map provider and does not resolve arbitrary symbols.
namespace map_probe {
enum class Stage {IdentityRead,IdentityMismatch,HandleRead,HandleMismatch,FlagsRead,FlagsRejected,SceneRead,SceneInvalid,SceneHeaderRead,SymbolRead,SymbolNull,SymbolNotPointer,StringRead,StringNonAscii,StringUnterminated,StringEmpty,NotMapPath,LegacyCandidate};
inline const char* name(Stage s){switch(s){case Stage::IdentityRead:return "identity_read_failed";case Stage::IdentityMismatch:return "identity_pointer_changed";case Stage::HandleRead:return "handle_read_failed";case Stage::HandleMismatch:return "serial_handle_changed";case Stage::FlagsRead:return "flags_read_failed";case Stage::FlagsRejected:return "identity_flags_rejected";case Stage::SceneRead:return "scene_pointer_read_failed";case Stage::SceneInvalid:return "scene_pointer_invalid";case Stage::SceneHeaderRead:return "scene_header_read_failed";case Stage::SymbolRead:return "model_symbol_read_failed";case Stage::SymbolNull:return "model_symbol_null";case Stage::SymbolNotPointer:return "model_symbol_not_pointer";case Stage::StringRead:return "resource_string_read_failed";case Stage::StringNonAscii:return "resource_string_non_ascii";case Stage::StringUnterminated:return "resource_string_unterminated";case Stage::StringEmpty:return "resource_string_empty";case Stage::NotMapPath:return "resource_not_map_path";default:return "legacy_model_candidate";}}
struct Layout {std::uint32_t entity_identity=0,entity_scene=0,model_state=0,model_name=0;std::uint64_t client_base=0;std::uint32_t client_size=0;};
struct Probe {Stage stage=Stage::IdentityRead;std::uint64_t record=0,scene=0,scene_vtable=0,symbol=0,failed_address=0;std::uint32_t handle=0,flags=0,failed_bytes=0,read_calls=0,requested_bytes=0;std::string resource,map;};
inline bool span(std::uint64_t a,std::uint32_t n){return a>=0x10000&&n&&a<=0x00007fffffffffffULL&&n-1<=0x00007fffffffffffULL-a;}
template<class Read>Probe inspect(Read read,const Layout& layout,std::uint64_t entity,std::uint64_t expected_record,std::uint32_t expected_handle){
    Probe p;auto get=[&](std::uint64_t a,void* destination,std::uint32_t n){++p.read_calls;p.requested_bytes+=n;if(!span(a,n)||!read(a,destination,n)){p.failed_address=a;p.failed_bytes=n;return false;}return true;};
    if(!span(entity,1)||layout.entity_identity>65536||layout.entity_scene>65536||layout.model_state>65536||layout.model_name>65536){p.failed_address=entity;return p;}
    if(!get(entity+layout.entity_identity,&p.record,8))return p;
    if(p.record!=expected_record){p.stage=Stage::IdentityMismatch;return p;}
    p.stage=Stage::HandleRead;if(!get(p.record+0x10,&p.handle,4))return p;
    if(p.handle!=expected_handle){p.stage=Stage::HandleMismatch;return p;}
    p.stage=Stage::FlagsRead;if(!get(p.record+0x30,&p.flags,4))return p;
    if(p.flags&0x717){p.stage=Stage::FlagsRejected;return p;}
    p.stage=Stage::SceneRead;if(!get(entity+layout.entity_scene,&p.scene,8))return p;
    if(!span(p.scene,8)){p.stage=Stage::SceneInvalid;return p;}
    p.stage=Stage::SceneHeaderRead;if(!get(p.scene,&p.scene_vtable,8))return p;
    // The vtable is diagnostic evidence, not a guessed cast validation rule.
    // CUtlSymbolLarge is logged as an opaque value before the legacy pointer
    // interpretation. A null/nonpointer value is never chased or synthesized.
    p.stage=Stage::SymbolRead;if(!get(p.scene+layout.model_state+layout.model_name,&p.symbol,8))return p;
    if(!p.symbol){p.stage=Stage::SymbolNull;return p;}
    if(!span(p.symbol,1)){p.stage=Stage::SymbolNotPointer;return p;}
    auto address=p.symbol;
    while(p.resource.size()<384){char bytes[64]{};const auto count=static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::min<std::size_t>({sizeof(bytes),384-p.resource.size(),4096-(address&4095)}));
        p.stage=Stage::StringRead;if(!get(address,bytes,count))return p;
        auto end=static_cast<const char*>(std::memchr(bytes,0,count));const auto length=end?std::size_t(end-bytes):std::size_t(count);
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<length;++i)if(static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[i])<32||static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[i])>126){p.stage=Stage::StringNonAscii;return p;}
        p.resource.append(bytes,length);if(end){if(p.resource.empty()){p.stage=Stage::StringEmpty;return p;}p.map=map_identity::from_model(p.resource);p.stage=p.map.empty()?Stage::NotMapPath:Stage::LegacyCandidate;return p;}address+=count;
    }p.stage=Stage::StringUnterminated;return p;
}
} // namespace map_probe

:::FILE pe_header_check.h
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <cstdio>

// Exact-completion read callbacks only. No zero-fill, cached-header fallback or
// target execution. Byte layout is the documented PE32+ header layout.
namespace pe_header_check {
enum class Stage {Ready,BaseInvalid,DosRead,DosMagic,Lfanew,NtAddress,NtRead,NtSignature,Machine,OptionalMagic,BuildMismatch};
struct Expected {std::uint32_t timestamp=0,image_size=0;};
struct Result {
    Stage stage=Stage::BaseInvalid;std::uint64_t base=0,address=0;
    std::uint32_t requested=0,read_calls=0,requested_bytes=0,timestamp=0,image_size=0,signature=0;
    std::uint16_t mz=0,machine=0,optional_magic=0;std::int32_t lfanew=0;
    bool dos_complete=false,nt_complete=false;Expected expected;
    std::array<unsigned char,64> dos{};std::array<unsigned char,264> nt{};
    bool ready()const{return stage==Stage::Ready;}
    bool metadata_retry_allowed()const{return !ready()&&stage!=Stage::BuildMismatch;}
};
template<class T> T field(const unsigned char* bytes,std::size_t offset){T value{};std::memcpy(&value,bytes+offset,sizeof(value));return value;}
inline const char* name(Stage s){switch(s){case Stage::Ready:return "matched";case Stage::BaseInvalid:return "module base invalid";case Stage::DosRead:return "DOS read unavailable/incomplete";case Stage::DosMagic:return "DOS MZ mismatch";case Stage::Lfanew:return "DOS e_lfanew invalid";case Stage::NtAddress:return "NT address invalid";case Stage::NtRead:return "NT read unavailable/incomplete";case Stage::NtSignature:return "NT signature mismatch";case Stage::Machine:return "PE machine mismatch";case Stage::OptionalMagic:return "PE optional magic mismatch";default:return "build mismatch";}}
template<class Read> Result inspect(std::uint64_t base,Expected expected,Read&& read){
    Result r;r.base=base;r.expected=expected;
    constexpr std::uint64_t limit=0x00007fffffffffffULL;
    if(base<0x10000||base>=limit||base>limit-r.dos.size())return r;
    auto fetch=[&](std::uint64_t address,void* data,std::uint32_t size){r.address=address;r.requested=size;++r.read_calls;r.requested_bytes+=size;return read(address,data,size);};
    r.stage=Stage::DosRead;if(!fetch(base,r.dos.data(),(std::uint32_t)r.dos.size()))return r;
    r.dos_complete=true;r.mz=field<std::uint16_t>(r.dos.data(),0);r.lfanew=field<std::int32_t>(r.dos.data(),0x3c);
    r.stage=Stage::DosMagic;if(r.mz!=0x5a4d)return r;
    r.stage=Stage::Lfanew;if(r.lfanew<64||r.lfanew>0x100000)return r;
    r.stage=Stage::NtAddress;if(base>limit-std::uint32_t(r.lfanew)||base+std::uint32_t(r.lfanew)>limit-r.nt.size())return r;
    r.stage=Stage::NtRead;if(!fetch(base+std::uint32_t(r.lfanew),r.nt.data(),(std::uint32_t)r.nt.size()))return r;
    r.nt_complete=true;r.signature=field<std::uint32_t>(r.nt.data(),0);r.machine=field<std::uint16_t>(r.nt.data(),4);r.timestamp=field<std::uint32_t>(r.nt.data(),8);r.optional_magic=field<std::uint16_t>(r.nt.data(),24);r.image_size=field<std::uint32_t>(r.nt.data(),24+56);
    r.stage=Stage::NtSignature;if(r.signature!=0x00004550)return r;
    r.stage=Stage::Machine;if(r.machine!=0x8664)return r;
    r.stage=Stage::OptionalMagic;if(r.optional_magic!=0x20b)return r;
    r.stage=Stage::BuildMismatch;if(r.timestamp!=expected.timestamp||r.image_size!=expected.image_size)return r;
    r.stage=Stage::Ready;return r;
}
inline std::string summary(const char* module,const Result& r){
    std::string text=std::string(module)+": ";
    switch(r.stage){
    case Stage::DosRead:return text+"cannot read DOS header; restart Deadlock and retry";
    case Stage::NtRead:return text+"cannot read PE header; restart Deadlock and retry";
    case Stage::BuildMismatch:return text+"build mismatch; update required";
    default:return text+name(r.stage);
    }
}
inline std::string hex(const unsigned char* bytes,std::size_t count,bool complete){
    if(!complete)return "<unavailable/incomplete>";char text[33]{};if(count>16)count=16;for(std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i)std::snprintf(text+i*2,3,"%02X",bytes[i]);return text;
}
inline std::string describe(const char* module,const Result& r){
    char detail[768];auto dos=hex(r.dos.data(),16,r.dos_complete),nt=hex(r.nt.data(),16,r.nt_complete);
    std::snprintf(detail,sizeof(detail),"%s: %s | base=0x%llX request=0x%llX/%u calls=%u requested_bytes=%u MZ=%04X e_lfanew=%d NT=%08X machine=%04X magic=%04X timestamp=%08X expected=%08X image=%08X expected=%08X dos16=%s nt16=%s",module,name(r.stage),(unsigned long long)r.base,(unsigned long long)r.address,r.requested,r.read_calls,r.requested_bytes,r.mz,r.lfanew,r.signature,r.machine,r.optional_magic,r.timestamp,r.expected.timestamp,r.image_size,r.expected.image_size,dos.c_str(),nt.c_str());return detail;
}
} // namespace pe_header_check

:::FILE esp_render_snapshot.h
#pragma once
#include "entities.h"
#include <algorithm>

namespace esp_render {
struct Demand {
    bool enemies=false,teammates=false,npcs=false,world=false,projectiles=false;
    bool any()const{return enemies||teammates||npcs||world||projectiles;}
};
struct Local {u64 base=0;u32 team=0;Vec3 pos;};
struct Snapshot {
    Local local;std::array<float,16> view{};float game_time=0;bool frame_valid=false,ready=false;
    u64 entity_sample=0,matrix_sample=0,native_binding_epoch=0; // ACE_NATIVE_JOINT_INTEGRATION_V1
    std::vector<Entity> enemies,teammates,npcs,world,projectiles;
    bool ability_fresh(u64 now)const{return ready&&frame_valid&&now>=entity_sample&&now-entity_sample<=250;}
};
// Exact existing world_to_screen arithmetic, order, clip boundary and sentinel.
// No global state, lock, read callback or matrix resampling occurs here.
inline Vec2 project(const Snapshot& frame,Vec3 point,u64 width,u64 height){
    const auto& m=frame.view;
    float w=point.x*m[12]+point.y*m[13]+point.z*m[14]+m[15];if(!std::isfinite(w)||w<.01f)return {-99999,-99999};
    float x=point.x*m[0]+point.y*m[1]+point.z*m[2]+m[3],y=point.x*m[4]+point.y*m[5]+point.z*m[6]+m[7];
    if(!std::isfinite(x)||!std::isfinite(y))return {-99999,-99999};return {(float)width*.5f*(1+x/w),(float)height*.5f*(1-y/w)};
}
inline void copy_players(const std::vector<Entity>& source,std::vector<Entity>& destination,u32 local_team,const Demand& demand){
    if(demand.enemies&&demand.teammates){destination=source;return;}
    // Use actual team rather than assuming a vector name establishes side.
    auto wanted=[&](const Entity& e){return e.team==local_team?demand.teammates:demand.enemies;};
    const auto count=std::count_if(source.begin(),source.end(),wanted);destination.resize(std::size_t(count));
    std::size_t at=0;for(const auto& e:source)if(wanted(e))destination[at++]=e;
}
inline void copy_world(const std::vector<Entity>& source,std::vector<Entity>& destination){
    // These are exactly draw_world's existing early rejections. Collision-only
    // records remain in the shared source for their actual consumers.
    auto wanted=[](const Entity& e){return e.cls==EClass::World&&e.base&&!e.world_obstacle;};
    const auto count=std::count_if(source.begin(),source.end(),wanted);destination.resize(std::size_t(count));
    std::size_t at=0;for(const auto& e:source)if(wanted(e))destination[at++]=e;
}
template<class Clock> inline bool capture(const Snapshots& source,std::mutex& mutex,const Demand& demand,Clock&& clock,Snapshot& out){
    out.ready=false;
    // Disabled vectors are cleared outside the snapshot lock. Active vector
    // assignment can reuse both outer capacity and existing Entity allocations.
    if(!demand.enemies&&!demand.teammates){out.enemies.clear();out.teammates.clear();}
    if(!demand.npcs)out.npcs.clear();if(!demand.world)out.world.clear();if(!demand.projectiles)out.projectiles.clear();
    if(!demand.any())return false;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
    // A publisher may finish while capture waits. Read host time only after
    // acquiring the same lock, beside the publication's timestamps.
    const u64 now=clock();
    const auto matrix=source.matrix_sample_ms.load(),entities=source.last_read_ms.load();
    if(source.backend_managed&&(!source.frame_valid||!matrix||!entities||now<matrix||now<entities||now-matrix>250||now-entities>250))return false;
    if(!source.local.base)return false;
    out.local={source.local.base,source.local.team,source.local.pos};
    std::copy(std::begin(source.view),std::end(source.view),out.view.begin());
    out.game_time=source.game_time;out.frame_valid=source.frame_valid.load();out.entity_sample=entities;out.matrix_sample=matrix;out.native_binding_epoch=source.native_binding_epoch.load();
    if(demand.enemies||demand.teammates){copy_players(source.enemies,out.enemies,out.local.team,demand);copy_players(source.friendlies,out.teammates,out.local.team,demand);}
    if(demand.npcs)out.npcs=source.npcs;if(demand.world)copy_world(source.world,out.world);if(demand.projectiles)out.projectiles=source.projectiles;
    out.ready=true;return true;
}
} // namespace esp_render

:::FILE consumer_demand.h
#pragma once
#include "config.h"
#include "autouse.h"
#include <atomic>

// Necessary configuration conditions only. Inventory/readiness is deliberately
// not cached here: an enabled consumer must keep receiving current observations.
namespace consumer_demand {
// A saved option is not an active consumer when its dispatcher is retired.
// Tick heartbeats avoid reading remote ability details for dormant routes.
inline constexpr u64 dispatcher_lease_ms=250;
inline std::atomic<u64> automatic_until{0},defensive_until{0};
inline constexpr bool dispatcher_active(u64 until,u64 now){return until&&now<=until&&until-now<=dispatcher_lease_ms;}
inline void note_automatic_tick(){automatic_until.store(now_ms()+dispatcher_lease_ms,std::memory_order_release);}
inline void note_defensive_tick(){defensive_until.store(now_ms()+dispatcher_lease_ms,std::memory_order_release);}
inline bool automatic_running(u64 now){return dispatcher_active(automatic_until.load(std::memory_order_acquire),now);}
inline bool defensive_running(u64 now){return dispatcher_active(defensive_until.load(std::memory_order_acquire),now);}
inline bool automatic(Settings& settings,u32 actual_hero){
    if(settings.B("auto.active_reload"))return true;
    for(const auto& rule:autouse::rules()){
        if(rule.hero&&rule.hero!=actual_hero)continue;
        if(settings.B((autouse::prefix(rule.token)+"enabled").c_str()))return true;
    }
    return false;
}
inline bool defensive(Settings& settings,u32 actual_hero){
    if(settings.B("defense.counterspell.enabled"))return true;
    // These are the actual native dodge implementations in defense::choose.
    if(actual_hero!=11&&actual_hero!=77&&actual_hero!=63)return false;
    return settings.B(("defense."+std::to_string(actual_hero)+".enabled").c_str());
}
} // namespace consumer_demand

:::FILE action_pause_policy.h
#pragma once
#include <string_view>

// Behavioral pauses are configurable. Snapshot/input freshness and active-match
// admission remain independent requirements for managed live output.
namespace action_pause_policy {
inline constexpr char legacy_key[]="input.disable_in_menu";
inline constexpr char diagnostic_key[]="dbg.pause_raw_ui_signal";
inline constexpr bool diagnostic_default=false;
constexpr bool is_retired_key(std::string_view key) noexcept { return key==legacy_key; }
constexpr bool operative_bool(std::string_view key,bool stored) noexcept {
    return !is_retired_key(key)&&stored;
}
constexpr bool raw_signal_active(bool readable,unsigned raw) noexcept {
    return readable&&(raw&3u)!=0;
}
constexpr bool diagnostic_pause(bool enabled,bool readable,unsigned raw) noexcept {
    return enabled&&raw_signal_active(readable,raw);
}
constexpr bool ace_pause(bool enabled,bool actual_menu_open) noexcept {
    return enabled&&actual_menu_open;
}
constexpr bool regular_search_key(std::string_view key) noexcept {
    return !is_retired_key(key)&&key!=diagnostic_key;
}
struct Preferences {
    bool pause_in_ace_menu=true,pause_when_dead=true,pause_in_scoreboard=true;
    bool pause_when_spectator=true,diagnostic_raw_ui=false;
};
struct Observations {
    bool managed=false,snapshot_valid=false,input_valid=false,fresh=false,in_match=false;
    bool life_known=false,dead=false,scoreboard=false,spectator=false;
    bool raw_ui_readable=false;unsigned raw_ui_flags=0;bool ace_menu_open=false;
};
enum class Reason {Ready,InvalidSnapshot,InvalidInput,StaleSnapshot,InactiveMatch,
                   UnknownLife,Dead,RawUiSignal,Scoreboard,Spectator,AceMenu};
constexpr Reason evaluate(const Preferences& p,const Observations& s) noexcept {
    if(s.managed){
        if(!s.snapshot_valid)return Reason::InvalidSnapshot;
        if(!s.input_valid)return Reason::InvalidInput;
        if(!s.fresh)return Reason::StaleSnapshot;
        if(!s.in_match)return Reason::InactiveMatch;
        if(p.pause_when_dead&&!s.life_known)return Reason::UnknownLife;
        if(p.pause_when_dead&&s.dead)return Reason::Dead;
    }
    if(diagnostic_pause(p.diagnostic_raw_ui,s.raw_ui_readable,s.raw_ui_flags))return Reason::RawUiSignal;
    if(s.managed&&p.pause_in_scoreboard&&s.scoreboard)return Reason::Scoreboard;
    if(s.managed&&p.pause_when_spectator&&s.spectator)return Reason::Spectator;
    if(ace_pause(p.pause_in_ace_menu,s.ace_menu_open))return Reason::AceMenu;
    return Reason::Ready;
}
constexpr const char* reason_text(Reason reason) noexcept {
    switch(reason){
        case Reason::InvalidSnapshot:return "no validated game snapshot";
        case Reason::InvalidInput:return "game key data unavailable";
        case Reason::StaleSnapshot:return "game snapshot older than 250 ms";
        case Reason::InactiveMatch:return "match inactive";
        case Reason::UnknownLife:return "life data unavailable for pause-while-dead check";
        case Reason::Dead:return "local player dead";
        case Reason::RawUiSignal:return "diagnostic pause on raw UI signal";
        case Reason::Scoreboard:return "scoreboard open";
        case Reason::Spectator:return "spectating";
        case Reason::AceMenu:return "ACE menu open";
        default:return "ready";
    }
}
} // namespace action_pause_policy

:::FILE launch_request.h
#pragma once
// Host startup intent only. This never starts a game or bypasses preflight.
namespace launch_request {
enum class Mode { Manual, Preview, LoaderPreview, DeadlockMenu, Invalid };
constexpr bool equal(const char* a,const char* b) noexcept {
    if(!a||!b)return false;
    while(*a&&*a==*b){++a;++b;}
    return *a==*b;
}
constexpr Mode parse(int count,const char* const* arguments) noexcept {
    if(count<1||!arguments||!arguments[0])return Mode::Invalid;
    if(count==1)return Mode::Manual;
    if(count==2&&equal(arguments[1],"--preview"))return Mode::Preview;
    if(count==2&&equal(arguments[1],"--loader-preview"))return Mode::LoaderPreview;
    if(count==3&&equal(arguments[1],"--launch-menu")&&equal(arguments[2],"deadlock"))return Mode::DeadlockMenu;
    return Mode::Invalid;
}
}

#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <array>
#include <memory>

struct ID3D11Device;
struct ID3D11DeviceContext;
struct IDXGISwapChain;
struct HWND__;

// Opt-in, one-shot capture of OUR existing overlay back buffer. The renderer is
// the sole D3D caller; the writer thread receives CPU bytes only. No game APIs.
namespace cooperative_capture {
namespace protocol {
inline constexpr std::uint64_t max_ttl_seconds=30;
inline constexpr std::size_t max_request_bytes=4096;
inline constexpr std::size_t max_png_bytes=8*1024*1024;
inline constexpr std::uint32_t max_dimension=4096;
inline constexpr std::uint64_t max_pixels=16777216;
constexpr bool id32(std::string_view value) {
    if(value.size()!=32)return false;
    for(char c:value)if(!((c>='0'&&c<='9')||(c>='a'&&c<='f')))return false;
    return true;
}
constexpr bool dimensions(std::uint32_t w,std::uint32_t h) {
    return w&&h&&w<=max_dimension&&h<=max_dimension&&std::uint64_t(w)*h<=max_pixels;
}
constexpr bool view(std::string_view value) {return value=="overlay"||value=="menu";}
constexpr bool request_time(std::uint64_t created,std::uint64_t expires,std::uint64_t now) {
    return created<=now&&expires>now&&expires>created&&expires-created<=max_ttl_seconds;
}
constexpr bool target_identity(std::uint32_t target_pid,std::uint64_t target_ticks,std::string_view target_build,
                               std::uint32_t own_pid,std::uint64_t own_ticks,std::string_view own_build) {
    return target_pid==own_pid&&target_ticks==own_ticks&&target_build==own_build;
}
// Fuser capture changes only alpha. Transparent capture retains associated
// framebuffer RGBA exactly, rather than pretending it is straight-alpha PNG.
constexpr std::uint8_t output_alpha(std::uint8_t stored,bool fuser) {return fuser?255:stored;}
// Storage-order conversion only. BGRA is supported by the native WIC PNG
// encoder; the encoded PNG's R/G/B/A channel values remain the source values.
constexpr std::array<std::uint8_t,4> rgba_to_bgra(std::array<std::uint8_t,4> pixel) {
    return {pixel[2],pixel[1],pixel[0],pixel[3]};
}
struct Binding {
    std::string installation_id,session_id,expected_build_id;
    std::uint32_t target_pid=0;
    std::uint64_t target_created_ticks=0;
};
struct Context:Binding {std::uint64_t session_expires_unix=0;};
struct Request:Binding {std::string request_id,job_id,requested_view;std::uint64_t created_unix=0,expires_unix=0;};
// Strict UTF-8 JSON: exact key sets, duplicate decoded keys rejected, unsigned
// integer tokens only (no bool/negative/floating/string coercion), <=4096 bytes.
bool parse_request(std::string_view bytes,Request& out,std::string& error);
bool parse_context(std::string_view bytes,Context& out,std::string& error);
bool admit(const Request&,const Context&,std::uint32_t own_pid,std::uint64_t own_created_ticks,
           std::string_view own_build,std::uint64_t now,std::string& error);
}

class Service {
public:
    using Log=void(*)(const char*);
    Service();
    ~Service();
    Service(const Service&)=delete;
    Service& operator=(const Service&)=delete;
    // Does not create the private directory. Missing/unsafe context means no
    // capture. Call after the overlay's COM initialization on its render thread.
    bool initialize(std::string_view compiled_build_id,Log logger=nullptr) noexcept;
    // Call once before menu drawing. True suppresses MENU DRAWING for this one
    // requested overlay frame only. Never change the real menu/input-gate state.
    // A menu-view request requires the real menu already open; no input is sent.
    bool prepare_frame(bool actual_menu_open) noexcept;
    // The renderer calls this instead of copying when menu draw-list exclusion
    // cannot be proven. Normal UI submission/rendering continues unchanged.
    void reject_prepared(std::string_view detail) noexcept;
    // Call exactly after ImGui_ImplDX11_RenderDrawData and before Present.
    // False fuser means the actual transparent overlay mode, NOT game content.
    void after_draw(ID3D11Device*,ID3D11DeviceContext*,IDXGISwapChain*,HWND__* own_window,
                    bool fuser,std::uint64_t render_frame_id) noexcept;
    // Call on that same thread before releasing the device/context/COM. Pending
    // jobs fail explicitly; CPU-only writer is joined before returning.
    void shutdown() noexcept;
private:
    struct Impl;
    std::unique_ptr<Impl> impl_;
};
namespace detail {
template<class Callback>class scope_exit {
    Callback callback_;
public:
    explicit constexpr scope_exit(Callback callback):callback_(callback){}
    scope_exit(const scope_exit&)=delete;
    constexpr ~scope_exit()noexcept {callback_();}
};
}
