// Reads the actual Reader route fact. No caller-provided mode checkbox exists.
class Source final:public native_joints::FreshSource{
    ::Reader& reader_;
public:
    explicit Source(::Reader& reader):reader_(reader){}
    bool supports_independent_uncached_reads()const noexcept override{return reader_.dma_read_ready();}
    u64 binding_epoch()const noexcept override{return reader_.dma_read_ready()?reader_.attachment_epoch():0;}
    bool read_fresh(std::span<native_joints::ReadRequest> requests)override{
        for(auto& r:requests){r.valid=false;r.transferred=0;}
        const auto epoch=binding_epoch();if(!epoch)return false;
        std::vector<DmaRead> reads;reads.reserve(requests.size());
        for(const auto& r:requests)reads.push_back({r.address,r.destination,r.size,0,false});
        const bool executed=reader_.scatter(reads)&&binding_epoch()==epoch;
        for(size_t i=0;i<reads.size();++i){requests[i].transferred=reads[i].transferred;requests[i].valid=executed&&reads[i].valid&&reads[i].transferred==reads[i].size;}
        return executed;
    }
};
inline const char* failure_text(native_joints::Failure failure){
    static constexpr const char* names[]={"none","no demand","unsupported demand","independent-read contract unavailable","not bound","game version guard mismatch","binding changed","invalid address","read failed","acquisition budget exceeded","identity mismatch","invalid scene","invalid model","invalid count","invalid name","joint name missing","joint name ambiguous","joint not in hitbox set","pose cache locked","pose cache not ready","metadata changed","pose changed during acquisition","non-finite transform"};
    const auto index=static_cast<unsigned>(failure);return index<std::size(names)?names[index]:"unknown failure";
}
struct Stats{native_joints::Failure first_failure=native_joints::Failure::None;u64 bytes=0,requests=0,elapsed_ms=0,fresh_calls=0;unsigned demanded=0,attempted=0,accepted=0,warmups=0,budget_skipped=0,backoff_skipped=0,warm_rows=0,cold_rows=0,plan_discards=0;};
class BudgetSource final:public native_joints::FreshSource{
    native_joints::FreshSource& source_;u64 remaining_bytes_=0,remaining_requests_=0;bool exhausted_=false;
public:
    Stats stats;
    explicit BudgetSource(native_joints::FreshSource& source):source_(source){}
    bool budget_exhausted()const noexcept{return exhausted_;}
    void begin(){remaining_bytes_=256*1024;remaining_requests_=4096;exhausted_=false;stats={};}
    bool supports_independent_uncached_reads()const noexcept override{return source_.supports_independent_uncached_reads();}
    u64 binding_epoch()const noexcept override{return source_.binding_epoch();}
    bool read_fresh(std::span<native_joints::ReadRequest> requests)override{
        u64 bytes=0;for(const auto& r:requests)bytes+=r.size;
        if(bytes>remaining_bytes_||requests.size()>remaining_requests_){exhausted_=true;return false;}
        remaining_bytes_-=bytes;remaining_requests_-=requests.size();stats.bytes+=bytes;stats.requests+=requests.size();++stats.fresh_calls;
        return source_.read_fresh(requests);
    }
};
struct Work{Entity* entity=nullptr;native_joints::Target target{};native_joints::Demand demand=0;};
namespace wire=native_joints::detail;
using Failure=native_joints::Failure;
// Shared dependency stages; no thread workers and no prior frame/stage replay.
class Bank{
    struct Entry{u64 entity=0,identity=0,next_retry=0,last_selected=0;u32 handle=0;unsigned failures=0;bool metadata=false;wire::MetadataKey key{};std::array<wire::Descriptor,2> descriptors{};std::optional<native_joint_quarantine::Plan> plan;};
    struct Actor{Work* work=nullptr;Entry* entry=nullptr;Failure failure=Failure::None;wire::Snapshot a{},b{};std::array<wire::SelectedRead,2> first{},second{};u64 started_ms=0,completed_ms=0;bool warm=false;};
    struct Tagged{size_t actor=0;native_joints::ReadRequest read;};
    std::unique_ptr<Source> owned_source_;BudgetSource source_;native_joints::Reader verifier_;std::unordered_map<u64,Entry> entries_;
    u64 epoch_=0,verify_retry_=0,selection_turn_=0;size_t cursor_=0;bool verified_=false,version_rejected_=false;
    static bool live(const Actor& a){return a.failure==Failure::None;}
    static void fail(Actor& a,Failure f){if(live(a))a.failure=f;}
    static bool negative_metadata(Failure f){return f==Failure::MissingName||f==Failure::AmbiguousName||f==Failure::InvalidName||f==Failure::NotHitbox||f==Failure::InvalidScene||f==Failure::InvalidModel||f==Failure::InvalidCount;}
    void add(std::vector<Tagged>& q,std::vector<Actor>& a,size_t i,native_joints::ReadRequest r){if(!live(a[i]))return;if(!r.destination||!wire::valid_span(r.address,r.size)){fail(a[i],Failure::InvalidAddress);return;}q.push_back({i,r});}
    template<class T>void add(std::vector<Tagged>& q,std::vector<Actor>& a,size_t i,u64 at,T& v){add(q,a,i,wire::request(at,v));}
    void run(std::vector<Tagged>& q,std::vector<Actor>& actors){
        std::vector<native_joints::ReadRequest> requests;std::vector<size_t> owner;
        for(auto& t:q)if(live(actors[t.actor])){requests.push_back(t.read);owner.push_back(t.actor);}
        for(size_t begin=0;begin<requests.size();begin+=256){const auto n=std::min<size_t>(256,requests.size()-begin);auto part=std::span<native_joints::ReadRequest>(requests).subspan(begin,n);const auto epoch=source_.binding_epoch();
            if(std::none_of(owner.begin()+begin,owner.begin()+begin+n,[&](size_t i){return live(actors[i]);}))continue;
            if(!epoch||epoch!=epoch_){for(size_t j=0;j<n;++j)fail(actors[owner[begin+j]],Failure::BindingChanged);continue;}
            const bool executed=source_.read_fresh(part),same=source_.binding_epoch()==epoch;
            for(size_t j=0;j<n;++j)if(!same)fail(actors[owner[begin+j]],Failure::BindingChanged);else if(!executed||!part[j].valid||part[j].transferred!=part[j].size)fail(actors[owner[begin+j]],source_.budget_exhausted()?Failure::BudgetExceeded:Failure::ReadFailed);
        }q.clear();
    }
    static void observe(Actor& a,const wire::Snapshot& s){auto& e=*a.entry;if(!e.metadata)return;if(s.actor_context_captured&&(e.key.identity!=s.identity||e.key.scene!=s.scene||e.key.handle!=s.handle))e.metadata=false;if(e.metadata&&s.metadata_captured&&!(e.key==wire::key(s)))e.metadata=false;if(!e.metadata)e.plan.reset();}
    static u64 millis(native_joints::HostClock::time_point value){return static_cast<u64>(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(value.time_since_epoch()).count());}
    void warm(std::vector<Actor>& actors){
        std::vector<native_joint_quarantine::Row> rows;std::vector<size_t> owner;
        for(size_t i=0;i<actors.size();++i)if(actors[i].warm){native_joint_quarantine::Row row;row.plan=&*actors[i].entry->plan;rows.push_back(std::move(row));owner.push_back(i);}
        native_joint_quarantine::Runner::sample(source_,rows);
        for(size_t k=0;k<rows.size();++k){auto& a=actors[owner[k]];const auto& row=rows[k];a.failure=row.failure;a.a=row.first.state;a.b=row.second.state;a.started_ms=millis(row.started_at);a.completed_ms=millis(row.completed_at);
            const auto j=a.work->demand==native_joints::head?0:1;a.first[j]=row.first.leaf;a.second[j]=row.second.leaf;if(row.needs_cold){a.entry->plan.reset();++source_.stats.plan_discards;}
        }
    }
    void capture(std::vector<Actor>& actors,bool after,u64 module){
        std::vector<Tagged> q;auto state=[&](Actor& a)->wire::Snapshot&{return after?a.b:a.a;};
        // Stage 1: entity identity and scene roots across all admitted actors.
        for(size_t i=0;i<actors.size();++i){auto& a=actors[i];if(a.warm||!live(a))continue;auto& s=state(a);const auto& t=a.work->target;if(!wire::valid_span(t.entity,wire::entity_scene_offset+8)||!wire::valid_span(t.expected_identity,wire::identity_flags_offset+4)){fail(a,Failure::InvalidAddress);continue;}add(q,actors,i,t.entity+wire::entity_identity_offset,s.identity);add(q,actors,i,t.entity+wire::entity_scene_offset,s.scene);}run(q,actors);
        // Stage 2: identity/type, cache roots/mask/lock and condition fields.
        for(size_t i=0;i<actors.size();++i){auto& a=actors[i];if(a.warm||!live(a))continue;auto& s=state(a);if(s.identity!=a.work->target.expected_identity){fail(a,Failure::IdentityMismatch);continue;}if(!wire::valid_span(s.scene,wire::computed_mask_offset+4)){fail(a,Failure::InvalidScene);continue;}
            add(q,actors,i,s.identity+wire::identity_handle_offset,s.handle);add(q,actors,i,s.identity+wire::identity_flags_offset,s.identity_flags);
            add(q,actors,i,s.scene,s.vtable);add(q,actors,i,s.scene+wire::scene_owner_offset,s.owner);add(q,actors,i,s.scene+wire::scene_lock_offset,s.lock);
            add(q,actors,i,s.scene+wire::model_record_offset,s.model_record);add(q,actors,i,s.scene+wire::pose_pointer_offset,s.poses);add(q,actors,i,s.scene+wire::bitmap_pointer_offset,s.bitmap);add(q,actors,i,s.scene+wire::pose_count_offset,s.pose_count);add(q,actors,i,s.scene+wire::computed_mask_offset,s.computed_mask);add(q,actors,i,s.scene+wire::condition_pointer_offset,s.condition_pointer);add(q,actors,i,s.scene+wire::condition_mask_offset,s.condition_mask);
        }run(q,actors);
        // Stage 3: model object and optional global object in one acquisition.
        for(size_t i=0;i<actors.size();++i){auto& a=actors[i];if(a.warm||!live(a))continue;auto& s=state(a);
            if(s.handle!=a.work->target.expected_handle||(s.identity_flags&wire::rejected_identity_flags)){fail(a,Failure::IdentityMismatch);continue;}if(s.vtable!=module+wire::scene_vtable_rva||s.owner!=a.work->target.entity){fail(a,Failure::InvalidScene);continue;}s.actor_context_captured=true;observe(a,s);
            if(!s.lock.quiet()){fail(a,Failure::Locked);continue;}if(!wire::valid_count(s.pose_count,1024)){fail(a,Failure::InvalidCount);continue;}
            if(!wire::valid_span(s.model_record,8)||!wire::valid_span(s.poses,u64(s.pose_count)*32)||(s.poses&15)||!wire::valid_span(s.bitmap,((u64(s.pose_count)+31)/32)*4)){fail(a,Failure::InvalidModel);continue;}
            add(q,actors,i,s.model_record,s.model);if(s.condition_pointer&&(s.condition_mask&0x100))add(q,actors,i,module+wire::condition_object_pointer_rva,s.condition_object);
        }run(q,actors);
        // Stage 4: model metadata and optional global object byte together.
        for(size_t i=0;i<actors.size();++i){auto& a=actors[i];if(a.warm||!live(a))continue;auto& s=state(a);if(!wire::valid_span(s.model,wire::flags_pointer_offset+8)){fail(a,Failure::InvalidModel);continue;}
            add(q,actors,i,s.model+wire::model_count_offset,s.model_count);add(q,actors,i,s.model+wire::names_pointer_offset,s.names);add(q,actors,i,s.model+wire::flags_pointer_offset,s.flags);
            if(s.condition_pointer&&(s.condition_mask&0x100)){if(!wire::valid_span(s.condition_object,0x59)){fail(a,Failure::InvalidModel);continue;}add(q,actors,i,s.condition_object+0x58,s.condition_object_byte);}
        }run(q,actors);
        // Stages 5/6: only dependencies required by the native short circuit.
        for(size_t i=0;i<actors.size();++i){auto& a=actors[i];if(a.warm||!live(a))continue;auto& s=state(a);if(!wire::valid_count(s.model_count,1024)){fail(a,Failure::InvalidCount);continue;}if(!wire::valid_span(s.names,u64(s.model_count)*8)||!wire::valid_span(s.flags,u64(s.model_count)*4)){fail(a,Failure::InvalidModel);continue;}s.metadata_captured=true;observe(a,s);if(s.condition_pointer&&(s.condition_mask&0x100)&&s.condition_object_byte)add(q,actors,i,module+wire::condition_dword_rva,s.condition_dword);}run(q,actors);
        for(size_t i=0;i<actors.size();++i){auto& a=actors[i];auto& s=state(a);if(!a.warm&&live(a)&&s.condition_pointer&&(s.condition_mask&0x100)&&s.condition_object_byte&&s.condition_dword==-1)add(q,actors,i,module+wire::condition_byte_rva,s.condition_byte);}run(q,actors);
        for(auto& a:actors)if(!a.warm&&live(a)){const auto& s=state(a);if(!wire::mask_ready(s.computed_mask,s.request()))fail(a,Failure::CacheNotReady);}
    }
    void metadata(std::vector<Actor>& actors){
        size_t chosen=actors.size();for(size_t i=0;i<actors.size();++i)if(!actors[i].warm&&live(actors[i])&&!actors[i].entry->metadata){if(chosen==actors.size())chosen=i;else{fail(actors[i],Failure::BudgetExceeded);++source_.stats.budget_skipped;}}
        if(chosen==actors.size())return;auto& a=actors[chosen];auto& e=*a.entry;const auto& s=a.a;++source_.stats.warmups;
        const auto n=static_cast<size_t>(s.model_count);std::vector<u64> pointers(n);std::vector<u32> flags(n);std::vector<std::array<char,wire::name_capacity>> names(n);std::vector<Tagged> q;
        add(q,actors,chosen,wire::bytes(s.names,pointers.data(),n*8));add(q,actors,chosen,wire::bytes(s.flags,flags.data(),n*4));run(q,actors);
        for(size_t j=0;j<n;++j)add(q,actors,chosen,wire::bytes(pointers[j],names[j].data(),names[j].size()));run(q,actors);
        if(!live(a))return;e.descriptors={};constexpr std::array<std::string_view,2> expected={"head","neck_0"};
        for(size_t j=0;j<n;++j){std::string name;if(!wire::parse_name(names[j],name)){fail(a,Failure::InvalidName);return;}for(size_t k=0;k<2;++k)if(name==expected[k]){auto& d=e.descriptors[k];++d.matches;d.index=(int)j;d.name=pointers[j];d.flags=flags[j];d.exact_name=name;}}
        e.key=wire::key(s);e.metadata=true;
    }
    void selected(std::vector<Actor>& actors,bool second){
        std::vector<Tagged> q;
        for(size_t i=0;i<actors.size();++i){auto& a=actors[i];if(a.warm||!live(a))continue;const auto& s=a.a;auto& result=second?a.second:a.first;
            for(unsigned j=0;j<2;++j)if(a.work->demand&(1u<<j)){const auto& d=a.entry->descriptors[j];if(d.matches!=1){fail(a,d.matches?Failure::AmbiguousName:Failure::MissingName);break;}if(!(d.flags&0x100)){fail(a,Failure::NotHitbox);break;}if(d.index<0||d.index>=s.model_count||d.index>=s.pose_count){fail(a,Failure::InvalidCount);break;}
                auto& r=result[j];const auto index=static_cast<u32>(d.index);add(q,actors,i,s.names+u64(index)*8,r.name);add(q,actors,i,s.flags+u64(index)*4,r.flags);add(q,actors,i,s.bitmap+u64(index>>5)*4,r.bitmap_word);add(q,actors,i,s.poses+u64(index)*32,r.pose);
                // The expected string can share this acquisition with its fresh
                // table entry. A changed entry rejects all of this actor's data.
                add(q,actors,i,wire::bytes(d.name,r.name_bytes.data(),r.name_bytes.size()));
            }
        }run(q,actors);
        for(auto& a:actors)if(!a.warm&&live(a)){auto& result=second?a.second:a.first;for(unsigned j=0;j<2;++j)if(a.work->demand&(1u<<j)){const auto& d=a.entry->descriptors[j];auto& r=result[j];
            if(r.name!=d.name||r.flags!=d.flags){fail(a,Failure::MetadataChanged);break;}if(!(r.bitmap_word&(1u<<(u32(d.index)&31)))){fail(a,Failure::CacheNotReady);break;}if(!wire::finite_pose(r.pose)){fail(a,Failure::NonFiniteTransform);break;}if(!wire::parse_name(r.name_bytes,r.name_string)){fail(a,Failure::InvalidName);break;}if(r.name_string!=d.exact_name){fail(a,Failure::MetadataChanged);break;}
        }}
    }
public:
    explicit Bank(::Reader& reader):owned_source_(std::make_unique<Source>(reader)),source_(*owned_source_),verifier_(source_){}
    // The same actual protocol can be compiled/exercised with a host-only byte
    // fixture; production uses the Reader overload above, never fake poses.
    explicit Bank(native_joints::FreshSource& source):source_(source),verifier_(source_){}
    void reset(){entries_.clear();epoch_=0;cursor_=0;verify_retry_=0;selection_turn_=0;verified_=version_rejected_=false;verifier_.reset();}
    Stats sample(u64 module,u64 epoch,std::vector<Work>& work){
        const auto started=now_ms();source_.begin();for(auto& w:work)if(w.entity)w.entity->native_joints={};if(epoch_!=epoch){reset();epoch_=epoch;}
        // This counter orders bounded host metadata eviction only; it is not a
        // native model generation. Saturation drops host metadata and retries.
        if(selection_turn_==std::numeric_limits<u64>::max()){reset();epoch_=epoch;}++selection_turn_;
        std::unordered_set<u32> current;for(const auto& w:work){current.insert(w.target.expected_handle);if(w.entity&&w.demand)++source_.stats.demanded;}for(auto i=entries_.begin();i!=entries_.end();)if(!current.count(i->second.handle))i=entries_.erase(i);else ++i;
        auto finish=[&](){source_.stats.elapsed_ms=now_ms()-started;return source_.stats;};
        if(!source_.stats.demanded||!epoch||source_.binding_epoch()!=epoch||work.empty())return finish();if(version_rejected_){source_.stats.first_failure=Failure::WrongVersion;return finish();}
        if(!verified_){if(now_ms()<verify_retry_){source_.stats.backoff_skipped=source_.stats.demanded;return finish();}if(!verifier_.bind(module)){source_.stats.first_failure=verifier_.last_failure();version_rejected_=verifier_.last_failure()==Failure::WrongVersion;verify_retry_=now_ms()+250;return finish();}verified_=true;}
        std::vector<Actor> actors;actors.reserve(128);std::unordered_set<u32> admitted;const auto count=work.size(),begin=cursor_%count;
        for(size_t n=0;n<count;++n){auto& w=work[(begin+n)%count];if(!w.entity||!w.demand)continue;if(w.demand!=native_joints::head&&w.demand!=native_joints::neck)continue;
            const u64 key=(u64(w.target.expected_handle)<<2)|w.demand;
            if(actors.size()>=128||(admitted.size()>=64&&!admitted.count(w.target.expected_handle))){++source_.stats.budget_skipped;continue;}
            if(entries_.size()>=128&&entries_.find(key)==entries_.end()){
                // Do not permanently pin the first actors when more current
                // actors demand points. Never erase an Entry referenced by an
                // already admitted row; its proof/pose lifetime spans the poll.
                auto victim=entries_.end();for(auto i=entries_.begin();i!=entries_.end();++i)if(!admitted.count(i->second.handle)&&(victim==entries_.end()||i->second.last_selected<victim->second.last_selected))victim=i;
                if(victim==entries_.end()){++source_.stats.budget_skipped;continue;}entries_.erase(victim);
            }
            auto& e=entries_[key];if(e.entity!=w.target.entity||e.identity!=w.target.expected_identity||e.handle!=w.target.expected_handle){e={};e.entity=w.target.entity;e.identity=w.target.expected_identity;e.handle=w.target.expected_handle;}e.last_selected=selection_turn_;if(now_ms()<e.next_retry){++source_.stats.backoff_skipped;continue;}
            Actor a;a.work=&w;a.entry=&e;a.started_ms=now_ms();a.warm=e.metadata&&e.plan.has_value();actors.push_back(std::move(a));++source_.stats.attempted;
            if(actors.back().warm)++source_.stats.warm_rows;else ++source_.stats.cold_rows;
            admitted.insert(w.target.expected_handle);
        }
        warm(actors);capture(actors,false,module);metadata(actors);selected(actors,false);selected(actors,true);capture(actors,true,module);
        const bool same_epoch=source_.binding_epoch()==epoch;const auto completed=now_ms();
        for(auto& a:actors){auto& e=*a.entry;if(!same_epoch)fail(a,Failure::BindingChanged);if(live(a)&&!wire::same_snapshot(a.a,a.b))fail(a,wire::key(a.a)==wire::key(a.b)?Failure::Inconsistent:Failure::MetadataChanged);
            if(live(a))for(unsigned j=0;j<2;++j)if(a.work->demand&(1u<<j)){const auto& x=a.first[j];const auto& y=a.second[j];if(x.name!=y.name||x.flags!=y.flags||x.name_string!=y.name_string){fail(a,Failure::MetadataChanged);break;}if(x.bitmap_word!=y.bitmap_word||std::memcmp(&x.pose,&y.pose,sizeof(x.pose))){fail(a,Failure::Inconsistent);break;}}
            if(!live(a)){if(source_.stats.first_failure==Failure::None)source_.stats.first_failure=a.failure;if(wire::invalidates_metadata(a.failure)){e.metadata=false;e.plan.reset();}if(negative_metadata(a.failure)){e.failures=std::min(e.failures+1,5u);e.next_retry=completed+std::min<u64>(5000,250ULL<<(e.failures-1));}continue;}
            const unsigned selected_index=a.work->demand==native_joints::head?0:1;
            if(!a.warm){native_joint_quarantine::Plan plan;plan.target=a.work->target;plan.module=module;plan.epoch=epoch;plan.expected=native_joint_quarantine::dependencies(a.a);plan.selected=e.descriptors[selected_index];e.plan=std::move(plan);a.completed_ms=completed;}
            e.failures=0;e.next_retry=0;auto& out=a.work->entity->native_joints;out.binding_epoch=epoch;out.started_ms=out.valid_mask?std::min(out.started_ms,a.started_ms):a.started_ms;out.completed_ms=std::max(out.completed_ms,a.completed_ms);
            for(unsigned j=0;j<2;++j)if(a.work->demand&(1u<<j)){const auto& p=a.second[j].pose;out.valid_mask|=1u<<j;out.model_index[j]=e.descriptors[j].index;out.world[j]={p.x,p.y,p.z};}++source_.stats.accepted;
        }
        cursor_=(begin+1)%count;if(!same_epoch){for(auto& w:work)if(w.entity)w.entity->native_joints={};reset();}return finish();
    }
};
} // namespace native_joint_backend
:::ENDFILE

:::FILE native_joint_demand.h
#pragma once
#include "native_joint_reader.h"
#include "entities.h"
#include "config.h"
#include "world_units.h"
#include <atomic>

// Short host leases from real activated consumers. No activation state is
// reconstructed in the backend, and no lease authorizes input or eligibility.
namespace native_joint_demand {
enum class Consumer { Aim, Trigger, Magnet };
struct Request{unsigned mask=0;float maximum_distance_units=0;};
// Zero is explicit legacy inheritance. Existing profiles preserve their former
// Aim-range cap; a positive component override is independently meaningful.
inline constexpr float effective_distance(float configured,float inherited){
    const auto value=configured==0?inherited:configured;
    return native_joints::detail::finite(value)&&value>0?value:0;
}
inline float trigger_range(){return world_units::units(effective_distance(cfg.F("trigger.max_dist"),cfg.F("aim.max_dist")));}
inline float magnet_range(){return world_units::units(effective_distance(cfg.F("trigger.magnet_max_dist"),cfg.F("aim.max_dist")));}
template<std::size_t N>inline constexpr unsigned at_distance(const std::array<Request,N>& requests,float distance){
    if(!native_joints::detail::finite(distance)||distance<0)return 0;
    unsigned mask=0;for(const auto& r:requests)if(native_joints::detail::finite(r.maximum_distance_units)&&r.maximum_distance_units>0&&distance<=r.maximum_distance_units)mask|=r.mask;
    return mask&native_joints::supported_demand;
}
inline constexpr unsigned visual_head(bool wanted,bool player,bool valid,float maximum_distance,float distance){
    return wanted&&player&&valid&&native_joints::detail::finite(distance)&&distance>=0&&native_joints::detail::finite(maximum_distance)&&maximum_distance>0&&distance<=maximum_distance?native_joints::head:0;
}
struct Lease {
    std::atomic<u64> sequence{0},epoch{0},until_ms{0};
    std::atomic<unsigned> mask{0};
    std::atomic<float> maximum_distance_units{0};
    void publish(unsigned requested,u64 binding,u64 now,float maximum_distance=std::numeric_limits<float>::max()) {
        if(!std::isfinite(maximum_distance)||maximum_distance<=0)requested=0;
        sequence.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        // A payload value read from a concurrent publication must order the
        // writer's preceding odd sequence before the final sequence load.
        // Relaxed payload access alone does not establish that portable proof.
        epoch.store(binding,std::memory_order_release);
        mask.store(requested&native_joints::supported_demand,std::memory_order_release);
        maximum_distance_units.store(requested?maximum_distance:0,std::memory_order_release);
        until_ms.store(requested&&binding?now+100:0,std::memory_order_release);
        sequence.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_release);
    }
    Request request(u64 binding,u64 now) const {
        const auto before=sequence.load(std::memory_order_acquire);if(before&1)return {};
        const auto at=epoch.load(std::memory_order_acquire),until=until_ms.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        const auto requested=mask.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        const auto range=maximum_distance_units.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        const auto after=sequence.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        return before==after&&!(after&1)&&binding&&at==binding&&until>=now&&until-now<=100?Request{requested,range}:Request{};
    }
    unsigned read(u64 binding,u64 now)const{return request(binding,now).mask;}
};
inline Lease aim,trigger,magnet;
inline Lease& lease(Consumer consumer){return consumer==Consumer::Aim?aim:consumer==Consumer::Trigger?trigger:magnet;}
class Tick {
    Consumer consumer_;u64 epoch_;unsigned requested_=0;float maximum_distance_=0;
public:
    explicit Tick(Consumer consumer):consumer_(consumer),epoch_(snap.native_binding_epoch.load()){}
    ~Tick(){lease(consumer_).publish(requested_,epoch_,now_ms(),maximum_distance_);}
    void request(unsigned mask,float maximum_distance){requested_|=mask&native_joints::supported_demand;maximum_distance_=std::max(maximum_distance_,maximum_distance);}
};
inline std::array<Request,3> action_requests(u64 epoch,u64 now){return {aim.request(epoch,now),trigger.request(epoch,now),magnet.request(epoch,now)};}
inline unsigned selected_regions(){
    unsigned mask=0;
    if(cfg.I("aim.bone_head")>=0)mask|=native_joints::head;
    if(cfg.I("aim.bone_neck")>=0)mask|=native_joints::neck;
    return mask;
}
} // namespace native_joint_demand
:::ENDFILE

:::FILE native_target.h
#pragma once
#include "entities.h"
namespace native_target {
// Published live acquisition capabilities, not a proposed anatomical mapping.
inline constexpr bool supports_region(int region) noexcept {return region==0||region==1;}
inline constexpr bool supports_entity(EClass kind) noexcept {return kind==EClass::Player;}
// Only verified cached joint translations. No collision-height fallback or
// transform is applied; the native cache already contains WORLD coordinates.
inline bool point(const Entity& e,int region,Vec3& world,u64 binding_epoch,u64 active_epoch,u64 now){
    if(!supports_entity(e.cls)||!supports_region(region)||!binding_epoch||binding_epoch!=active_epoch)return false;
    const auto& p=e.native_joints;
    if(!e.host_sample_ms||now<e.host_sample_ms||now-e.host_sample_ms>250||p.started_ms<e.host_sample_ms)return false;
    if(p.binding_epoch!=binding_epoch||!(p.valid_mask&(1u<<region))||
       !p.started_ms||p.completed_ms<p.started_ms||now<p.completed_ms||
       now<p.started_ms||now-p.started_ms>250)return false;
    const auto value=p.world[region];
    if(!std::isfinite(value.x)||!std::isfinite(value.y)||!std::isfinite(value.z))return false;
    world=value;return true;
}
} // namespace native_target
:::ENDFILE

:::FILE native_joint_quarantine.h
#pragma once
#include "native_joint_reader.h"
#include <optional>

namespace native_joint_quarantine {
namespace wire=native_joints::detail;
using Failure=native_joints::Failure;
using Address=native_joints::Address;
// Address dependencies only. No computed mask, lock, bitmap or pose values are
// retained here as evidence of present readiness or present transform content.
struct Dependencies {
    Address identity=0,scene=0,record=0,model=0,poses=0,bitmap=0,names=0,flags=0,condition_pointer=0,condition_object=0;
    std::int32_t pose_count=0,model_count=0;std::uint32_t condition_mask=0;
    bool operator==(const Dependencies&)const=default;
};
inline Dependencies dependencies(const wire::Snapshot& s){return {s.identity,s.scene,s.model_record,s.model,s.poses,s.bitmap,s.names,s.flags,s.condition_pointer,s.condition_object,s.pose_count,s.model_count,s.condition_mask};}
struct Plan {
    native_joints::Target target{};Address module=0;std::uint64_t epoch=0;
    Dependencies expected{};wire::Descriptor selected{};
};
struct Observation {
    wire::Snapshot state{};wire::SelectedRead leaf{};
    bool base=true,name_entry=true,leaves=true,object_byte=true,dword=true,condition_byte=true;
};
struct Row {
    const Plan* plan=nullptr;Observation first{},second{};
    Failure failure=Failure::None;bool needs_cold=false;
    native_joints::HostClock::time_point started_at{},completed_at{};
};
inline bool same_dependencies(const wire::Snapshot& s,const Dependencies& p){
    return s.identity==p.identity&&s.scene==p.scene&&s.model_record==p.record&&s.model==p.model&&
        s.poses==p.poses&&s.bitmap==p.bitmap&&s.pose_count==p.pose_count&&s.model_count==p.model_count&&
        s.names==p.names&&s.flags==p.flags&&s.condition_pointer==p.condition_pointer&&s.condition_mask==p.condition_mask&&
        s.condition_object==p.condition_object;
}
inline void fail(Row& r,Failure f,bool cold=false){if(r.failure==Failure::None){r.failure=f;r.needs_cold=cold;}}
inline void validate_leaves(Row& row,Observation& o,const wire::Snapshot& proof){
    if(!o.name_entry||!o.leaves){fail(row,Failure::ReadFailed);return;}
    const auto& d=row.plan->selected;auto& x=o.leaf;
    if(d.matches!=1||d.index<0||d.index>=proof.model_count||d.index>=proof.pose_count||!(d.flags&0x100)){fail(row,Failure::InvalidName,true);return;}
    if(x.name!=d.name||x.flags!=d.flags){fail(row,Failure::MetadataChanged,true);return;}
    if(!(x.bitmap_word&(1U<<(std::uint32_t(d.index)&31)))){fail(row,Failure::CacheNotReady);return;}
    if(!wire::finite_pose(x.pose)){fail(row,Failure::NonFiniteTransform);return;}
    if(!wire::parse_name(x.name_bytes,x.name_string)){fail(row,Failure::InvalidName,true);return;}
    if(x.name_string!=d.exact_name){fail(row,Failure::MetadataChanged,true);return;}
}
inline void validate_parents(Row& row,Observation& o){
    const auto& p=*row.plan;auto& s=o.state;
    if(!o.base){fail(row,Failure::ReadFailed,true);return;}
    if(s.identity!=p.target.expected_identity||s.handle!=p.target.expected_handle||(s.identity_flags&wire::rejected_identity_flags)){fail(row,Failure::IdentityMismatch,true);return;}
    if(s.vtable!=p.module+wire::scene_vtable_rva||s.owner!=p.target.entity){fail(row,Failure::InvalidScene,true);return;}
    // Parent hierarchy fields use QUARANTINED expected addresses. All current
    // dependencies must match before leaf work and again after it completes.
    // Changed parents reject old leaves even when those old leaves look valid.
    if(!same_dependencies(s,p.expected)){fail(row,wire::key(s)==wire::MetadataKey{p.expected.identity,p.expected.scene,p.expected.record,p.expected.model,p.expected.names,p.expected.flags,p.target.expected_handle,p.expected.model_count}?Failure::Inconsistent:Failure::MetadataChanged,true);return;}
    if(!wire::valid_count(s.pose_count,1024)||!wire::valid_count(s.model_count,1024)||
       !wire::valid_span(s.scene,wire::computed_mask_offset+4)||!wire::valid_span(s.model_record,8)||!wire::valid_span(s.model,wire::flags_pointer_offset+8)||
       !wire::valid_span(s.poses,std::uint64_t(s.pose_count)*32)||(s.poses&15)||!wire::valid_span(s.bitmap,((std::uint64_t(s.pose_count)+31)/32)*4)||
       !wire::valid_span(s.names,std::uint64_t(s.model_count)*8)||!wire::valid_span(s.flags,std::uint64_t(s.model_count)*4)){fail(row,Failure::InvalidModel,true);return;}
    s.actor_context_captured=s.metadata_captured=true;
    const bool branch=s.condition_pointer&&(s.condition_mask&0x100);
    if(branch){
        if(!o.object_byte){fail(row,Failure::ReadFailed);return;}
        if(s.condition_object_byte){if(!o.dword){fail(row,Failure::ReadFailed);return;}if(s.condition_dword==-1){if(!o.condition_byte){fail(row,Failure::ReadFailed);return;}}else s.condition_byte=0;}
        else{s.condition_dword=0;s.condition_byte=0;}
    }else{s.condition_object=0;s.condition_object_byte=0;s.condition_dword=0;s.condition_byte=0;}
    if(!s.lock.quiet()){fail(row,Failure::Locked);return;}
    if(!wire::mask_ready(s.computed_mask,s.request())){fail(row,Failure::CacheNotReady);return;}
}

// The owning Bank must first verify the supported loaded module and build each
// plan from its fully accepted cold path in the same host attachment epoch.
class Runner {
    enum class Kind{Base,NameEntry,Leaves,ObjectByte,Dword,ConditionByte};
    struct Tagged{std::size_t owner;Kind kind;native_joints::ReadRequest read;};
    static void incomplete(Observation& o,Kind k){switch(k){case Kind::Base:o.base=false;break;case Kind::NameEntry:o.name_entry=false;break;case Kind::Leaves:o.leaves=false;break;case Kind::ObjectByte:o.object_byte=false;break;case Kind::Dword:o.dword=false;break;case Kind::ConditionByte:o.condition_byte=false;break;}}
    static void acquire(native_joints::FreshSource& source,std::span<Row> rows,bool second,bool parents){
        std::vector<Tagged> queued;
        std::vector<std::size_t> leader(rows.size());for(std::size_t i=0;i<rows.size();++i)leader[i]=i;
        auto same_actor=[](const Plan& a,const Plan& b){return a.module==b.module&&a.epoch==b.epoch&&a.target.entity==b.target.entity&&a.target.expected_identity==b.target.expected_identity&&a.target.expected_handle==b.target.expected_handle;};
        auto push=[&](std::size_t i,Kind k,native_joints::ReadRequest r){if(!r.destination||!wire::valid_span(r.address,r.size)){fail(rows[i],Failure::InvalidAddress,true);return;}queued.push_back({i,k,r});};
        auto add=[&]<class T>(std::size_t i,Kind k,Address address,T& value){push(i,k,wire::request(address,value));};
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<rows.size();++i){auto& row=rows[i];if(row.failure!=Failure::None)continue;const auto& p=*row.plan;const auto& e=p.expected;auto& o=second?row.second:row.first;auto& s=o.state;auto& x=o.leaf;const auto index=std::uint32_t(p.selected.index);
            if(parents){
            bool follower=false;
            for(std::size_t j=0;j<i;++j)if(rows[j].failure==Failure::None&&same_actor(p,*rows[j].plan)){
                if(!(e==rows[j].plan->expected)){
                    // Conflicting quarantined plans for one actor cannot borrow
                    // a convenient proof. Retire all and rediscover cold.
                    for(auto& other:rows)if(other.plan&&same_actor(p,*other.plan))fail(other,Failure::Inconsistent,true);
                }else{leader[i]=leader[j];follower=true;}break;
            }
            if(row.failure!=Failure::None||follower)continue;
            add(i,Kind::Base,p.target.entity+wire::entity_identity_offset,s.identity);add(i,Kind::Base,p.target.entity+wire::entity_scene_offset,s.scene);
            add(i,Kind::Base,e.identity+wire::identity_handle_offset,s.handle);add(i,Kind::Base,e.identity+wire::identity_flags_offset,s.identity_flags);
            add(i,Kind::Base,e.scene,s.vtable);add(i,Kind::Base,e.scene+wire::scene_owner_offset,s.owner);add(i,Kind::Base,e.scene+wire::scene_lock_offset,s.lock);
            add(i,Kind::Base,e.scene+wire::model_record_offset,s.model_record);add(i,Kind::Base,e.scene+wire::pose_pointer_offset,s.poses);add(i,Kind::Base,e.scene+wire::bitmap_pointer_offset,s.bitmap);
            add(i,Kind::Base,e.scene+wire::pose_count_offset,s.pose_count);add(i,Kind::Base,e.scene+wire::computed_mask_offset,s.computed_mask);add(i,Kind::Base,e.scene+wire::condition_pointer_offset,s.condition_pointer);add(i,Kind::Base,e.scene+wire::condition_mask_offset,s.condition_mask);
            add(i,Kind::Base,e.record,s.model);add(i,Kind::Base,e.model+wire::model_count_offset,s.model_count);add(i,Kind::Base,e.model+wire::names_pointer_offset,s.names);add(i,Kind::Base,e.model+wire::flags_pointer_offset,s.flags);
            if(e.condition_pointer&&(e.condition_mask&0x100)){
                add(i,Kind::Base,p.module+wire::condition_object_pointer_rva,s.condition_object);add(i,Kind::ObjectByte,e.condition_object+0x58,s.condition_object_byte);
                // Fixed module-address scalar leaves are fetched speculatively.
                // Validation requires only the current native branch's leaves;
                // unused failed reads are ignored and normalized before A/B.
                add(i,Kind::Dword,p.module+wire::condition_dword_rva,s.condition_dword);add(i,Kind::ConditionByte,p.module+wire::condition_byte_rva,s.condition_byte);
            }
            }
            if(!parents){
            add(i,Kind::NameEntry,e.names+std::uint64_t(index)*8,x.name);add(i,Kind::Leaves,e.flags+std::uint64_t(index)*4,x.flags);add(i,Kind::Leaves,e.bitmap+std::uint64_t(index>>5)*4,x.bitmap_word);add(i,Kind::Leaves,e.poses+std::uint64_t(index)*32,x.pose);
            // Fetch every expected semantic byte AND its terminating NUL. Tail
            // allocation bytes are not part of the name association proof.
            push(i,Kind::Leaves,wire::bytes(p.selected.name,x.name_bytes.data(),p.selected.exact_name.size()+1));
            }
        }
        std::vector<native_joints::ReadRequest> requests;std::vector<std::size_t> tags;
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<queued.size();++i)if(rows[queued[i].owner].failure==Failure::None){requests.push_back(queued[i].read);tags.push_back(i);}
        // Parent proof is shared per physical actor; leaf failures remain per
        // joint. Bursts above512 are real separately counted fresh operations.
        for(std::size_t begin=0;begin<requests.size();begin+=512){const auto n=std::min<std::size_t>(512,requests.size()-begin);auto part=std::span<native_joints::ReadRequest>(requests).subspan(begin,n);const auto epoch=source.binding_epoch();const bool capable=source.supports_independent_uncached_reads();
            if(!capable||!epoch){for(auto& r:rows)fail(r,Failure::BindingChanged,true);break;}
            const bool executed=source.read_fresh(part),same=source.binding_epoch()==epoch;
            for(std::size_t j=0;j<n;++j){const auto& tag=queued[tags[begin+j]];auto& row=rows[tag.owner];if(!same||row.plan->epoch!=epoch){fail(row,Failure::BindingChanged,true);continue;}if(!executed||!part[j].valid||part[j].transferred!=part[j].size)incomplete(second?row.second:row.first,tag.kind);}
        }
        if(parents)for(std::size_t i=0;i<rows.size();++i)if(rows[i].failure==Failure::None&&leader[i]!=i){auto& own=second?rows[i].second:rows[i].first;const auto& origin=second?rows[leader[i]].second:rows[leader[i]].first;
            if(rows[leader[i]].failure!=Failure::None){fail(rows[i],rows[leader[i]].failure,rows[leader[i]].needs_cold);continue;}
            // Fresh bytes from this same operation, not a prior frame cache.
            own.state=origin.state;own.base=origin.base;own.object_byte=origin.object_byte;own.dword=origin.dword;own.condition_byte=origin.condition_byte;
        }
        for(auto& row:rows)if(row.failure==Failure::None){if(parents)validate_parents(row,second?row.second:row.first);else validate_leaves(row,second?row.second:row.first,row.first.state);}
    }
public:
    static void sample(native_joints::FreshSource& source,std::span<Row> rows){
        if(rows.size()>128){for(auto& r:rows)fail(r,Failure::BudgetExceeded);return;}
        const auto started=native_joints::HostClock::now();
        for(auto& r:rows){r.first={};r.second={};r.failure=Failure::None;r.needs_cold=false;r.started_at=started;r.completed_at={};if(!r.plan||!r.plan->epoch||r.plan->selected.matches!=1||r.plan->selected.exact_name.empty()||r.plan->selected.exact_name.size()>=wire::name_capacity||r.plan->selected.index<0||!wire::valid_count(r.plan->expected.pose_count,1024)||!wire::valid_count(r.plan->expected.model_count,1024)||r.plan->selected.index>=r.plan->expected.pose_count||r.plan->selected.index>=r.plan->expected.model_count)fail(r,Failure::InvalidName,true);}
        // Strict host operation chronology, not assumed request ordering inside
        // an unordered scatter: A fully completes before either pose read, and
        // B starts after both independently fresh pose/leaf acquisitions finish.
        acquire(source,rows,false,true);
        acquire(source,rows,false,false);
        acquire(source,rows,true,false);
        acquire(source,rows,true,true);
        const auto completed=native_joints::HostClock::now();
        for(auto& r:rows)if(r.failure==Failure::None){const auto& x=r.first.leaf;const auto& y=r.second.leaf;
            if(!wire::same_snapshot(r.first.state,r.second.state)){const bool metadata_changed=!(wire::key(r.first.state)==wire::key(r.second.state));fail(r,metadata_changed?Failure::MetadataChanged:Failure::Inconsistent,metadata_changed);}
            else if(x.name!=y.name||x.flags!=y.flags||x.name_string!=y.name_string)fail(r,Failure::MetadataChanged,true);
            else if(x.bitmap_word!=y.bitmap_word||std::memcmp(&x.pose,&y.pose,sizeof(x.pose)))fail(r,Failure::Inconsistent);
            if(r.failure==Failure::None&&source.binding_epoch()!=r.plan->epoch)fail(r,Failure::BindingChanged,true);
            if(r.failure==Failure::None)r.completed_at=completed;
        }
    }
};
} // namespace native_joint_quarantine
:::ENDFILE

#pragma once
#include "world_labels.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <string_view>

// Semantic groups use ONLY identical labels already verified in world_labels.
// Generic breakable variants are deliberately not guessed from model names.
namespace world_style_catalog {
struct Category { const char* key; const char* label; const char* help; };
inline constexpr std::array<Category,16> categories={{
    {"ability_pickup","Ability pickup","Ability pickups."},
    {"breakable","Breakable","Generic breakable props. Statue, cauldron and heavy-box variants are not identified separately."},
    {"crate","Crate","Item crates. Heavy-box variants are not identified separately."},
    {"currency_bundle","Currency bundle","Grouped currency pickups."},
    {"currency_pickup","Currency pickup","Currency pickups."},
    {"death_pickup","Death pickup","Death pickups; no further subtype is identified."},
    {"drawing","Drawing","Drawing pickups."},
    {"gold_pickup","Gold pickup","Gold pickups. Generic golden-statue props are not identified separately."},
    {"candy","Halloween candy","Halloween-candy pickups."},
    {"health_pickup","Health pickup","Health pickups. Snack variants are not identified separately."},
    {"idol","Idol","Idol pickups."},
    {"item_pickup","Item pickup","Item pickups."},
    {"pickup","Pickup","Generic pickup class; no more specific subtype is inferred."},
    {"powerup_pickup","Power-up pickup","Power-up pickups."},
    {"punchable_troll","Punchable troll","Punchable troll props."},
    {"rejuvenator","Rejuvenator","Rejuvenator pickups, including hero testing."}
}};
inline constexpr std::size_t count=categories.size(), missing=count;
constexpr std::size_t index(const world_labels::Definition& definition) {
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i)if(std::string_view(categories[i].label)==definition.label)return i;
    return missing;
}
constexpr std::size_t index(std::string_view exact_class) {
    const auto* definition=world_labels::find(exact_class);return definition?index(*definition):missing;
}
constexpr std::size_t class_count(std::size_t category) {
    std::size_t total=0;for(const auto& definition:world_labels::definitions)if(index(definition)==category)++total;return total;
}
constexpr bool complete() {
    for(const auto& definition:world_labels::definitions)if(index(definition)==missing)return false;
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i){
        if(!class_count(i))return false;
        for(std::size_t j=0;j<i;++j)if(std::string_view(categories[i].key)==categories[j].key||std::string_view(categories[i].label)==categories[j].label)return false;
    }
    return true;
}
static_assert(complete(),"Revalidate semantic world categories when verified labels change");
}

:::FILE world_style_config.h
#pragma once
#include "world_style_catalog.h"
#include "config.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <string>

namespace world_style_config {
struct Keys {
    std::string enabled,custom,initialized,label,icon,distance,color,icon_size,text_size,draw_distance;
};
inline const Keys& keys(std::size_t category) {
    static const auto values=[] {
        std::array<Keys,world_style_catalog::count> result{};
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<result.size();++i){
            const std::string p=std::string("world.style.")+world_style_catalog::categories[i].key+".";
            result[i]={p+"enabled",p+"custom",p+"initialized",p+"label",p+"icon",p+"distance",p+"color",p+"icon_size",p+"text_size",p+"draw_distance"};
        }
        return result;
    }();
    return values[category];
}
inline std::size_t category_from_path(std::string_view path) {
    if(!path.starts_with("world.style."))return world_style_catalog::missing;
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<world_style_catalog::count;++i){
        const std::string prefix=std::string("world.style.")+world_style_catalog::categories[i].key+".";
        if(path.starts_with(prefix))return i;
    }
    return world_style_catalog::missing;
}
struct Style {
    bool enabled=true,label=true,icon=true,distance=true,outline=true;
    Color color{.6f,.6f,.6f,1};float icon_size=8,text_size=14;int draw_distance=120;
};
using Styles=std::array<Style,world_style_catalog::count>;
inline float finite_size(float value,float fallback,float lo,float hi){return std::isfinite(value)?std::clamp(value,lo,hi):fallback;}
inline Style shared(Settings& settings) {
    Settings::VisualScope global(false);Style result;
    result.distance=settings.B("esp.distance");result.color=settings.C("esp.color_world");
    result.text_size=finite_size(settings.F(settings.B("esp.name_global_font")?"esp.font_size":"esp.name_font"),14,8,32);
    result.draw_distance=std::clamp(settings.I("esp.draw_distance"),1,400);result.outline=settings.B("esp.name_outline");
    return result;
}
inline Styles resolve(Settings& settings) {
    Settings::VisualScope global(false);Styles result;const Style inherited=shared(settings);
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<result.size();++i){
        const auto& p=keys(i);auto& value=result[i];value=inherited;value.enabled=settings.B(p.enabled.c_str());
        if(!settings.B(p.custom.c_str()))continue;
        value.label=settings.B(p.label.c_str());value.icon=settings.B(p.icon.c_str());value.distance=settings.B(p.distance.c_str());
        value.color=settings.C(p.color.c_str());value.icon_size=finite_size(settings.F(p.icon_size.c_str()),8,2,40);
        value.text_size=finite_size(settings.F(p.text_size.c_str()),inherited.text_size,8,32);
        value.draw_distance=std::clamp(settings.I(p.draw_distance.c_str()),1,400);
    }
    return result;
}
constexpr bool visible(const Style& style){return style.enabled&&(style.label||style.icon||style.distance);}
constexpr bool any_visible(const Styles& styles){for(const auto& style:styles)if(visible(style))return true;return false;}
// Preserve an imported active custom style before its checkbox can be switched
// off on the first displayed frame. Appearance is never reseeded here.
inline void prepare_edit(Settings& settings,std::size_t category) {
    Settings::WriteScope settings_edit(settings);
    const auto& p=keys(category);
    if(settings.B(p.custom.c_str())&&!settings.B(p.initialized.c_str())){
        settings.find(p.initialized.c_str())->b=true;settings.mark_dirty();
    }
}
inline void register_all(Settings& settings) {
    Settings::WriteScope settings_edit(settings);
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<world_style_catalog::count;++i){const auto& p=keys(i);
        settings.defb(p.enabled.c_str(),"Show this category",true);settings.defb(p.custom.c_str(),"Custom style",true);
        settings.defb(p.initialized.c_str(),"World style initialized",false); // Internal first-edit state; never exposed/searchable.
        settings.defb(p.label.c_str(),"Show name",true);settings.defb(p.icon.c_str(),"Show icon",true);settings.defb(p.distance.c_str(),"Show distance",true);
        settings.defc(p.color.c_str(),"Marker and text color",.6f,.6f,.6f,1);
        settings.deff(p.icon_size.c_str(),"Icon size (px)",8,2,40,.5f);settings.deff(p.text_size.c_str(),"Text size (px)",14,8,32,.5f);
        settings.defi(p.draw_distance.c_str(),"Draw distance (m)",120,1,400);
    }
}
// Copy only appearance. The category master is never changed by style reset.
inline void copy_shared(Settings& settings,std::size_t category) {
    Settings::WriteScope settings_edit(settings);
    const auto value=shared(settings);const auto& p=keys(category);
    settings.find(p.label.c_str())->b=value.label;settings.find(p.icon.c_str())->b=value.icon;
    settings.find(p.distance.c_str())->b=value.distance;settings.find(p.color.c_str())->c=value.color;
    settings.find(p.icon_size.c_str())->f=value.icon_size;settings.find(p.text_size.c_str())->f=value.text_size;
    settings.find(p.draw_distance.c_str())->i=value.draw_distance;settings.find(p.initialized.c_str())->b=true;settings.mark_dirty();
}
}

:::FILE dma_scatter_session.h
#pragma once
#include "memory_batch.h"
#include "vmm_api.h"
#include <windows.h>
#include <mutex>
#include <span>
#include <memory>

// Only the VMM handle and host allocations persist. Every operation still
// performs a new uncached ExecuteRead and validates every page transfer count.
namespace dma_scatter {
inline constexpr DWORD flags=0x0001|0x1000; // NOCACHE | PREPAREEX_NOMEMZERO
inline constexpr std::size_t max_bytes=32u*1024*1024,max_requests=8192;
// A legal request can have a partial first AND last page. For each request,
// pieces <= size/4096 + 2, so this covers every existing accepted workload.
inline constexpr std::size_t max_pieces=max_bytes/4096+2*max_requests;
using Start=void*(*)(vmm_api::Handle,DWORD,DWORD);
using Prepare=BOOL(*)(void*,ULONG64,DWORD,PBYTE,PDWORD);
using Execute=BOOL(*)(void*);
using Clear=BOOL(*)(void*,DWORD,DWORD);
using Close=void(*)(void*);
struct Api {
    Start start=nullptr;Prepare prepare=nullptr;Execute execute=nullptr;
    Clear clear=nullptr;Close close=nullptr;
    bool available()const noexcept{return start&&prepare&&execute&&close;}
    bool operator==(const Api&)const=default;
};
constexpr u32 page_part(u64 address,u32 remaining)noexcept{return std::min<u32>(remaining,4096-u32(address&4095));}
constexpr std::size_t page_pieces(u64 address,u32 size)noexcept{return size?(std::size_t(address&4095)+size+4095)/4096:0;}
constexpr bool complete(bool executed,bool prepared,u32 got,u32 wanted)noexcept{return executed&&prepared&&got==wanted;}
constexpr bool same_context(bool ready,DWORD before_pid,DWORD after_pid,u64 before_epoch,u64 after_epoch)noexcept{return ready&&before_pid==after_pid&&before_epoch==after_epoch;}
constexpr bool close_before_prepare(bool api_changed,bool vmm_changed,bool pid_changed,bool epoch_changed,std::size_t wanted_bytes,std::size_t owned_bytes,std::size_t wanted_pieces,std::size_t owned_pieces)noexcept{return api_changed||vmm_changed||pid_changed||epoch_changed||wanted_bytes>owned_bytes||wanted_pieces>owned_pieces;}
constexpr bool reopen_after_clear(bool clear_available,bool clear_succeeded)noexcept{return !clear_available||!clear_succeeded;}

class Session {
    struct Piece{u64 address=0;std::size_t offset=0,parent=0;DWORD size=0,got=0;bool prepared=false;};
    std::mutex mutex_;
    Api api_{};void* handle_=nullptr;vmm_api::Handle vmm_=nullptr;DWORD pid_=0;u64 epoch_=0;
    // Never replace either array while a handle exists. PrepareEx's pb and
    // pcbRead point exclusively here, never into caller or per-call storage.
    std::unique_ptr<unsigned char[]> bytes_;
    std::unique_ptr<Piece[]> pieces_;
    std::size_t owned_bytes_=0,owned_pieces_=0;
    void close_unlocked()noexcept{if(handle_&&api_.close)api_.close(handle_);handle_=nullptr;vmm_=nullptr;pid_=0;epoch_=0;}
    bool begin(const Api& api,vmm_api::Handle vmm,DWORD pid,u64 epoch,std::size_t bytes,std::size_t pieces){
        if(!api.available()||!vmm||!pid||bytes>max_bytes||pieces>max_pieces)return false;
        // SDK requires PrepareEx buffers to stay allocated until Close, even
        // though Clear resets the request list. Close BEFORE any reallocation.
        if(handle_&&close_before_prepare(api_!=api,vmm_!=vmm,pid_!=pid,epoch_!=epoch,bytes,owned_bytes_,pieces,owned_pieces_))close_unlocked();
        if(bytes>owned_bytes_){bytes_=std::make_unique<unsigned char[]>(bytes);owned_bytes_=bytes;}
        if(pieces>owned_pieces_){pieces_=std::make_unique<Piece[]>(pieces);owned_pieces_=pieces;}
        if(handle_&&reopen_after_clear(api.clear!=nullptr,api.clear&&api.clear(handle_,pid,flags)!=FALSE))close_unlocked();
        api_=api;
        if(!handle_){handle_=api.start(vmm,pid,flags);if(!handle_)return false;vmm_=vmm;pid_=pid;epoch_=epoch;}
        return true;
    }
public:
    static constexpr std::size_t max_piece_storage_bytes=sizeof(Piece)*max_pieces;
    Session()=default;Session(const Session&)=delete;Session& operator=(const Session&)=delete;
    ~Session(){close_unlocked();}
    void close(){std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);close_unlocked();}
    bool read(const Api& api,vmm_api::Handle vmm,DWORD pid,u64 epoch,std::span<DmaRead> requests){
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        std::size_t byte_count=0,piece_count=0;
        for(const auto& r:requests){byte_count+=r.size;piece_count+=page_pieces(r.address,r.size);}
        if(!begin(api,vmm,pid,epoch,byte_count,piece_count))return false;
        std::size_t index=0,offset=0;
        for(std::size_t parent=0;parent<requests.size();++parent){const auto& r=requests[parent];u32 done=0;
            while(done<r.size){const auto count=page_part(r.address+done,r.size-done);auto& p=pieces_[index++];
                p={r.address+done,offset,parent,count,0,false};
                p.prepared=api.prepare(handle_,p.address,p.size,bytes_.get()+offset,&p.got)!=FALSE;
                done+=count;offset+=count;
            }
        }
        const bool executed=api.execute(handle_)!=FALSE;
        for(auto& r:requests){r.valid=executed;r.transferred=0;}
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<piece_count;++i){const auto& p=pieces_[i];auto& r=requests[p.parent];
            if(!complete(executed,p.prepared,p.got,p.size))r.valid=false;else r.transferred+=p.got;
        }
        offset=0;for(auto& r:requests){r.valid=r.valid&&r.transferred==r.size;
            if(r.valid)std::memcpy(r.data,bytes_.get()+offset,r.size);else r.transferred=0;
            offset+=r.size;
        }
        // Older runtimes without Clear retain the existing close-per-call path.
        if(!api.clear)close_unlocked();
        return executed;
    }
};
} // namespace dma_scatter
:::ENDFILE
:::FILE projectile_presentation.h
#pragma once
#include "utils.h"

// Display-only values. No entity, reader, action or player-ESP configuration.
namespace projectile_presentation {
struct Style {
    bool marker=true,name=true,distance=true;
    float marker_size=6,font_size=14;
    int max_dist=120;
    Color color{.9f,.5f,1,1};
};
constexpr bool visible(const Style& style){return style.marker||style.name||style.distance;}
constexpr float bounded(float value,float fallback,float lower,float upper){
    return value>=lower&&value<=upper?value:value<lower?lower:value>upper?upper:fallback;
}
constexpr Style normalized(Style style){
    style.marker_size=bounded(style.marker_size,6,2,24);
    style.font_size=bounded(style.font_size,14,8,32);
    style.max_dist=style.max_dist<1?1:style.max_dist>400?400:style.max_dist;
    style.color={bounded(style.color.r,.9f,0,1),bounded(style.color.g,.5f,0,1),bounded(style.color.b,1,0,1),bounded(style.color.a,1,0,1)};
    return style;
}
// Comparisons also reject NaN and infinity without consuming another sample.
constexpr bool in_range(float distance,int maximum){return distance>=0&&distance<=maximum;}
}

constexpr bool same_name(std::string_view left,std::string_view right){
    if(left.size()!=right.size())return false;
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<left.size();++i)if(fold_ascii(left[i])!=fold_ascii(right[i]))return false;
    return true;
}

// Menu-only geometry. This never changes the host viewport or global font/style.
namespace menu_layout {
struct Size {float width=0,height=0,pad_x=0,pad_y=0;};
struct Point {float x=0,y=0;};
constexpr float maximum(float a,float b){return a>b?a:b;}
constexpr float minimum(float a,float b){return a<b?a:b;}
constexpr float clamp(float value,float lower,float upper){return value<lower?lower:value>upper?upper:value;}
constexpr Size size(float host_width,float host_height,float percent,bool preview){
    percent=percent>=50&&percent<=150?percent:percent<50?50:percent>150?150:100;
    const float pad_x=preview?0:minimum(20,maximum(0,(host_width-1)*.5f));
    const float pad_y=preview?0:minimum(24,maximum(0,(host_height-1)*.5f));
    const float available_width=maximum(1,host_width-pad_x*2),available_height=maximum(1,host_height-pad_y*2);
    return {minimum(available_width,maximum(600,1180*percent*.01f)),minimum(available_height,maximum(420,780*percent*.01f)),pad_x,pad_y};
}
constexpr Point origin(float x,float y,const Size& menu,float host_width,float host_height){
    return {clamp(x,menu.pad_x,maximum(menu.pad_x,host_width-menu.pad_x-menu.width)),clamp(y,menu.pad_y,maximum(menu.pad_y,host_height-menu.pad_y-menu.height))};
}
struct Cell {float x=0,y=0,width=0;};
struct Tabs {std::vector<Cell> cells;float height=0,row_height=32;};
inline constexpr float tab_height=32,tab_gap=4;
constexpr Tabs tabs(const std::vector<float>& minimum_widths,float available,float minimum_height=tab_height){
    Tabs result;result.row_height=maximum(tab_height,minimum_height);if(minimum_widths.empty())return result;available=maximum(1,available);
    std::size_t start=0;float y=0;
    while(start<minimum_widths.size()){
        std::size_t end=start;float used=0;
        while(end<minimum_widths.size()){
            const float width=minimum(available,maximum(1,minimum_widths[end]));
            if(end>start&&used+width>available)break;
            used+=width;++end;
        }
        const float extra=maximum(0,(available-used)/static_cast<float>(end-start));float x=0;
        for(auto i=start;i<end;++i){const float width=minimum(available,maximum(1,minimum_widths[i]))+extra;result.cells.push_back({x,y,width});x+=width;}
        start=end;y+=result.row_height+tab_gap;
    }
    result.height=y-tab_gap;return result;
}
}

:::FILE profile_selection_index.h
#pragma once
#include "json.hpp"
#include <windows.h>
#include <atomic>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace profile_selection_index {
inline constexpr const char* file_path="configs/_active_profiles.json";
inline constexpr std::size_t maximum_bytes=16384;
constexpr bool valid_prefix(std::string_view prefix){return prefix=="deadlock"||prefix=="cod"||prefix=="marathon"||prefix=="cs2"||prefix=="overwatch";}
constexpr bool valid_name(std::string_view name){
    if(name.empty()||name.size()>40)return false;
    for(char c:name)if(!((c>='a'&&c<='z')||(c>='A'&&c<='Z')||(c>='0'&&c<='9')||c=='_'||c=='-'))return false;
    return true;
}
constexpr bool may_remember(bool preview,bool profile_loaded){return !preview&&profile_loaded;}
// The bundled JSON lexer treats a raw NUL as end-of-input. Reject it before
// parsing so a valid prefix cannot hide trailing invalid bytes.
constexpr bool valid_document_bytes(std::string_view bytes){
    if(bytes.empty()||bytes.size()>maximum_bytes)return false;
    for(char c:bytes)if(c=='\0')return false;
    return true;
}
enum class ReadStatus {missing,ready,protected_failure};
struct ReadResult {
    ReadStatus status=ReadStatus::missing;
    std::map<std::string,std::string> entries;
    std::string error;
    std::string selected(const std::string& prefix)const{const auto found=entries.find(prefix);return found==entries.end()?std::string{}:found->second;}
};
inline ReadResult read(const std::string& path=file_path){
    auto fail=[](const char* message){ReadResult result;result.status=ReadStatus::protected_failure;result.error=message;return result;};
    std::error_code ec;const bool exists=std::filesystem::exists(path,ec);
    if(ec)return fail("Could not inspect the startup profile index.");
    if(!exists)return {};
    std::ifstream input(path,std::ios::binary);if(!input)return fail("Could not read the startup profile index; it was left unchanged.");
    std::string bytes(maximum_bytes+1,'\0');input.read(bytes.data(),static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes.size()));const auto count=input.gcount();
    if(input.bad())return fail("Could not read the startup profile index; it was left unchanged.");
    if(count>static_cast<std::streamsize>(maximum_bytes))return fail("Startup profile index is too large; it was left unchanged.");
    bytes.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(count));
    if(!valid_document_bytes(bytes))return fail("Startup profile index has invalid bytes; it was left unchanged.");
    try{
        // Ambiguous duplicate members are preserved as a protected failure,
        // rather than silently choosing the parser's last value.
        bool duplicate_member=false;
        std::vector<std::set<std::string>> object_keys;
        const auto unique_members=[&](int,nlohmann::json::parse_event_t event,nlohmann::json& value){
            if(event==nlohmann::json::parse_event_t::object_start)object_keys.emplace_back();
            else if(event==nlohmann::json::parse_event_t::key){
                if(object_keys.empty()||!object_keys.back().insert(value.get<std::string>()).second)duplicate_member=true;
            }else if(event==nlohmann::json::parse_event_t::object_end){
                if(!object_keys.empty())object_keys.pop_back();
            }
            return true;
        };
        const auto document=nlohmann::json::parse(bytes,unique_members);
        if(duplicate_member)return fail("Startup profile index has duplicate fields; it was left unchanged.");
        if(!document.is_object()||document.size()!=2||!document.contains("version")||!document["version"].is_number_integer()||document["version"]!=1||!document.contains("active_profiles")||!document["active_profiles"].is_object()||document["active_profiles"].size()>5)return fail("Startup profile index has an unsupported format; it was left unchanged.");
        ReadResult result;result.status=ReadStatus::ready;
        for(const auto& entry:document["active_profiles"].items()){
            if(!valid_prefix(entry.key())||!entry.value().is_string())return fail("Startup profile index contains an invalid selection; it was left unchanged.");
            const auto name=entry.value().get<std::string>();if(!valid_name(name))return fail("Startup profile index contains an invalid profile name; it was left unchanged.");
            result.entries.emplace(entry.key(),name);
        }
        return result;
    }catch(...){return fail("Startup profile index is invalid; it was left unchanged.");}
}
inline bool remember(const std::string& prefix,const std::string& name,std::string& error,const std::string& path=file_path){
    error.clear();if(!valid_prefix(prefix)||!valid_name(name)){error="Invalid startup profile selection.";return false;}
    // Re-read to retain the latest other-game entries. Atomic replacement is not
    // a multi-process transaction; no synchronization claim is made here.
    auto current=read(path);if(current.status==ReadStatus::protected_failure){error=current.error;return false;}
    current.entries[prefix]=name;
    std::error_code ec;const auto parent=std::filesystem::path(path).parent_path();if(!parent.empty())std::filesystem::create_directories(parent,ec);
    if(ec){error="Could not access the startup profile index folder.";return false;}
    static std::atomic<unsigned long long> sequence{0};
    const std::string temporary=path+".tmp."+std::to_string(GetCurrentProcessId())+"."+std::to_string(sequence.fetch_add(1));
    auto fail=[&](const char* message){DeleteFileA(temporary.c_str());error=message;return false;};
    try{
        const nlohmann::json document={{"version",1},{"active_profiles",current.entries}};
        std::ofstream output(temporary,std::ios::binary|std::ios::trunc);if(!output){error="Could not write the startup profile index.";return false;}
        output<<document.dump(2);output.flush();if(!output){output.close();return fail("Could not write the startup profile index.");}
        output.close();if(output.fail())return fail("Could not close the startup profile index.");
        if(!MoveFileExA(temporary.c_str(),path.c_str(),MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING|MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH))return fail("Could not replace the startup profile index.");
        return true;
    }catch(...){return fail("Could not write the startup profile index.");}
}
}

:::FILE engine_map_reader.h
#pragma once
#include "engine_map_layout.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <utility>

// Read-only, build-verified engine map identity. The caller supplies byte reads;
// no process/device APIs, target calls, asset loading or collision queries live
// here. A Ready result identifies a current map, not an available geometry file.
namespace engine_map {
using u64=std::uint64_t;using u32=std::uint32_t;
inline constexpr u64 highest_address=0x00007fffffffffffULL;
inline constexpr u64 retry_ms=250,refresh_ms=1000;
inline constexpr std::int32_t full_state=6;
constexpr bool full(std::int32_t state)noexcept{return state==full_state;}
constexpr bool span(u64 address,u64 bytes)noexcept{return address>=0x10000&&bytes&&address<=highest_address&&bytes-1<=highest_address-address;}
constexpr bool module(u64 base)noexcept{return span(base,engine_map_layout::image_size);}

enum class Stage {
    ServiceReadFailed,ServiceTypeMismatch,ClientPointerReadFailed,NoClient,
    ClientPointerInvalid,ClientTypeReadFailed,ClientTypeMismatch,ClientDataReadFailed,
    NotFull,NamePointerInvalid,HeaderReady,NameReadFailed,NameNotAscii,
    NameUnterminated,NameInvalid,NameMismatch,ChangedDuringRead,Ready
};
inline const char* stage_text(Stage stage)noexcept{
    switch(stage){
    case Stage::ServiceReadFailed:return "engine service unreadable";
    case Stage::ServiceTypeMismatch:return "engine service type mismatch";
    case Stage::ClientPointerReadFailed:return "active client pointer unreadable";
    case Stage::NoClient:return "no active game client";
    case Stage::ClientPointerInvalid:return "active client pointer invalid";
    case Stage::ClientTypeReadFailed:return "active client type unreadable";
    case Stage::ClientTypeMismatch:return "active client type mismatch";
    case Stage::ClientDataReadFailed:return "active client map fields unreadable";
    case Stage::NotFull:return "game client is not in FULL sign-on state";
    case Stage::NamePointerInvalid:return "engine map string pointer unavailable";
    case Stage::HeaderReady:return "typed FULL-state map header acquired";
    case Stage::NameReadFailed:return "engine map string unreadable";
    case Stage::NameNotAscii:return "engine map string contains non-ASCII bytes";
    case Stage::NameUnterminated:return "engine map string exceeds its bounded length";
    case Stage::NameInvalid:return "engine map identifier is unsupported or invalid";
    case Stage::NameMismatch:return "engine full and short map names disagree";
    case Stage::ChangedDuringRead:return "engine map changed during acquisition";
    default:return "engine map identified";
    }
}

struct Header {
    Stage stage=Stage::ServiceReadFailed;
    u64 service_vtable=0,client=0,client_vtable=0,full_pointer=0,short_pointer=0;
    std::int32_t state=0;u32 spawn=0;
    bool ready()const noexcept{return stage==Stage::HeaderReady;}
};
inline bool same(const Header& a,const Header& b)noexcept{
    return a.stage==b.stage&&a.service_vtable==b.service_vtable&&a.client==b.client&&
        a.client_vtable==b.client_vtable&&a.full_pointer==b.full_pointer&&
        a.short_pointer==b.short_pointer&&a.state==b.state&&a.spawn==b.spawn;
}

// Root prefetch contract: service vtable (8), active-client pointer (8),
// client vtable (8), and client+0x210..0x248 (0x38 bytes). Independent validity
// of these groups is preserved by checking every supplied read result.
template<class Read>Header read_header(Read read,u64 base){
    Header header;if(!module(base))return header;
    if(!read(base+engine_map_layout::service_instance_rva,&header.service_vtable,8))return header;
    if(header.service_vtable!=base+engine_map_layout::service_expected_vtable_rva){header.stage=Stage::ServiceTypeMismatch;return header;}
    header.stage=Stage::ClientPointerReadFailed;
    if(!read(base+engine_map_layout::active_client_global_rva,&header.client,8))return header;
    if(!header.client){header.stage=Stage::NoClient;return header;}
    if(!span(header.client,0x248)){header.stage=Stage::ClientPointerInvalid;return header;}
    header.stage=Stage::ClientTypeReadFailed;
    if(!read(header.client,&header.client_vtable,8))return header;
    if(header.client_vtable!=base+engine_map_layout::client_expected_vtable_rva){header.stage=Stage::ClientTypeMismatch;return header;}
    std::array<unsigned char,0x38> bytes{};header.stage=Stage::ClientDataReadFailed;
    if(!read(header.client+0x210,bytes.data(),static_cast<u32>(bytes.size())))return header;
    std::memcpy(&header.full_pointer,bytes.data(),8);std::memcpy(&header.short_pointer,bytes.data()+8,8);
    std::memcpy(&header.state,bytes.data()+0x20,4);std::memcpy(&header.spawn,bytes.data()+0x34,4);
    if(!full(header.state)){header.stage=Stage::NotFull;return header;}
    if(!span(header.full_pointer,1)||!span(header.short_pointer,1)){header.stage=Stage::NamePointerInvalid;return header;}
    header.stage=Stage::HeaderReady;return header;
}

struct NormalizedName {
    std::array<char,65> bytes{};std::size_t length=0;bool valid=false;
    constexpr std::string_view view()const noexcept{return {bytes.data(),length};}
};
constexpr NormalizedName normalize(std::string_view value)noexcept{
    NormalizedName result;if(value.empty()||value.size()>64)return result;
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<value.size();++i){char c=value[i];if(c>='A'&&c<='Z')c=char(c-'A'+'a');
        if(!((c>='a'&&c<='z')||(c>='0'&&c<='9')||c=='_'))return {};
        result.bytes[i]=c;
    }
    result.length=value.size();result.valid=true;return result;
}

template<class Read>Stage read_name(Read read,u64 address,std::string& out,std::size_t maximum){
    out.clear();if(!span(address,1))return Stage::NamePointerInvalid;
    while(out.size()<=maximum){
        std::array<char,64> bytes{};
        const auto count=std::min<std::size_t>({bytes.size(),maximum+1-out.size(),4096-std::size_t(address&4095),std::size_t(highest_address-address+1)});
        if(!count||!read(address,bytes.data(),static_cast<u32>(count)))return Stage::NameReadFailed;
        const auto* end=static_cast<const char*>(std::memchr(bytes.data(),0,count));const auto length=end?std::size_t(end-bytes.data()):count;
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<length;++i)if(static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[i])<32||static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[i])>126)return Stage::NameNotAscii;
        out.append(bytes.data(),length);if(end)return out.empty()?Stage::NameInvalid:Stage::Ready;
        address+=count;if(address>highest_address)return Stage::NameReadFailed;
    }
    return Stage::NameUnterminated;
}

struct Result {
    Stage stage=Stage::ServiceReadFailed;Header header;
    std::string map,raw_full,raw_short,detail;
    u64 name_sampled_ms=0;
    bool ready()const noexcept{return stage==Stage::Ready&&!map.empty();}
};

class Monitor {
    Header observed_{};bool have_observation_=false,have_clock_=false;
    u64 retry_at_=0,last_now_=0;
    Result result_;
    static u64 later(u64 now,u64 amount)noexcept{return amount>std::numeric_limits<u64>::max()-now?std::numeric_limits<u64>::max():now+amount;}
    Result fail(const Header& header,Stage stage,u64 now,std::string raw_full={},std::string raw_short={}){
        result_={stage,header,{},std::move(raw_full),std::move(raw_short),stage_text(stage),0};retry_at_=later(now,retry_ms);return result_;
    }
public:
    void reset(){observed_={};have_observation_=have_clock_=false;retry_at_=last_now_=0;result_={};}
    template<class CachedRead,class FreshRead>Result update(CachedRead cached,FreshRead fresh,u64 base,u64 now){
        const auto header=read_header(cached,base);
        const bool clock_changed=have_clock_&&now<last_now_;last_now_=now;have_clock_=true;
        if(!header.ready()){
            // The public identity disappears immediately on a bad header or
            // non-FULL state, even while name retry backoff is in progress.
            have_observation_=false;observed_=header;return fail(header,header.stage,now);
        }
        if(clock_changed||!have_observation_||!same(header,observed_)){
            result_={};retry_at_=0;observed_=header;have_observation_=true;
        }
        if(result_.ready()&&now>=result_.name_sampled_ms&&now-result_.name_sampled_ms<refresh_ms){result_.header=header;return result_;}
        if(now<retry_at_){result_.header=header;return result_;}
        const auto before=read_header(fresh,base);
        if(!before.ready()||!same(before,header))return fail(before,Stage::ChangedDuringRead,now);
        std::string first_full,first_short,second_full,second_short;
        auto stage=read_name(fresh,before.full_pointer,first_full,128);
        if(stage!=Stage::Ready)return fail(before,stage,now,std::move(first_full));
        stage=read_name(fresh,before.short_pointer,first_short,64);
        if(stage!=Stage::Ready)return fail(before,stage,now,std::move(first_full),std::move(first_short));
        const auto normalized=normalize(first_short);
        if(!normalized.valid)return fail(before,Stage::NameInvalid,now,std::move(first_full),std::move(first_short));
        if(first_full!="maps/"+first_short+".vpk")return fail(before,Stage::NameMismatch,now,std::move(first_full),std::move(first_short));
        stage=read_name(fresh,before.full_pointer,second_full,128);
        if(stage!=Stage::Ready)return fail(before,stage,now,std::move(first_full),std::move(first_short));
        stage=read_name(fresh,before.short_pointer,second_short,64);
        if(stage!=Stage::Ready)return fail(before,stage,now,std::move(first_full),std::move(first_short));
        const auto after=read_header(fresh,base);
        if(!after.ready()||!same(before,after)||first_full!=second_full||first_short!=second_short)return fail(after,Stage::ChangedDuringRead,now,std::move(first_full),std::move(first_short));
        result_={Stage::Ready,after,std::string(normalized.view()),std::move(first_full),std::move(first_short),stage_text(Stage::Ready),now};retry_at_=0;return result_;
    }
};

// Caller already validates the pinned module PE identity during attachment.
// These immutable instructions and static vtable entries are checked once per
// attachment, never as part of each ordinary update.
template<class Read>bool verify_layout(Read read,u64 base,std::string& error){
    if(!module(base)){error="Engine map module range invalid";return false;}
    for(const auto& check:engine_map_layout::code_checks){
        std::array<unsigned char,128> bytes{};
        if(check.bytes.empty()||check.bytes.size()>bytes.size()||check.rva>engine_map_layout::image_size-check.bytes.size()){
            error="Invalid engine map code guard";return false;
        }
        if(!read(base+check.rva,bytes.data(),static_cast<u32>(check.bytes.size()))){error="Engine map code unreadable: "+std::string(check.name);return false;}
        if(!std::equal(check.bytes.begin(),check.bytes.end(),bytes.begin())){error="Engine map code mismatch: "+std::string(check.name);return false;}
    }
    struct Entry{u32 table,index,function;};
    constexpr Entry entries[]={{0x51fa10,23,0x1d12b0},{0x4e2790,64,0x731c0},{0x4e2790,65,0x73220},{0x4e47c0,109,0x83910},{0x4dd548,109,0x5f160}};
    for(const auto& entry:entries){u64 pointer=0;if(!read(base+entry.table+u64(entry.index)*8,&pointer,8)||pointer!=base+entry.function){error="Engine map static vtable mismatch";return false;}}
    error.clear();return true;
}
}

#pragma once
#include "profile_subject.h"
#include "config.h"
#include "entities.h"
#include "game.h"
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace profile_scope {
struct Context {
    std::string key;std::vector<std::string> parents;
    bool operator==(const Context&)const=default;
};
inline constexpr bool segment(std::string_view value){
    if(value.empty()||value.size()>128||value=="."||value=="..")return false;
    for(unsigned char c:value)if(c<32||c==127||c=='/'||c=='\\')return false;
    return true;
}
inline Context for_subject(const profile_subject::Subject& subject,const GameModule* game=games::selected){
    if(!game||!game->name||!*game->name)return {};
    const std::string root=game->name;Context result{root+"/Global",{}};
    if(!subject.verified||!game->cfg_prefix||subject.game_id!=game->cfg_prefix)return result;
    if(subject.kind==profile_subject::Kind::Hero&&segment(subject.name))result.key=root+"/hero/"+subject.name;
    else if(subject.kind==profile_subject::Kind::Weapon){
        const auto category=segment(subject.category)?root+"/weapon/"+subject.category:std::string{};
        if(segment(subject.name)){
            result.key=root+"/weapon-item/"+subject.name;
            if(!category.empty())result.parents.push_back(category);
        }else if(!category.empty())result.key=category;
    }
    return result;
}
inline Context for_entity(const Entity& entity,const GameModule* game=games::selected){return for_subject(entity.settings_subject,game);}
class ActiveScope {
    Context context_;Settings::Scope scope_;
public:
    explicit ActiveScope(const Entity& entity,const GameModule* game=games::selected):context_(for_entity(entity,game)),scope_(context_.key,context_.parents){}
    explicit ActiveScope(const profile_subject::Subject& subject,const GameModule* game=games::selected):context_(for_subject(subject,game)),scope_(context_.key,context_.parents){}
    const Context& context()const noexcept{return context_;}
};
}
