:::FILE map_asset_registry.h
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
namespace collision {
// A map name alone is never enough to select geometry for another game/build.
struct GameMapKey {
    std::string game_id,map_id;
    std::uint32_t build_revision=0;
    bool operator==(const GameMapKey&)const=default;
};
struct MapAsset {const char* path;std::uint32_t asset_revision;};
inline const MapAsset* find_map_asset(const GameMapKey& key){
    struct Registered {const char* game;const char* map;std::uint32_t build;MapAsset asset;};
    // These are the only actual native collision assets currently distributed.
    // Add another game only with real geometry and independently verified metadata.
    static constexpr Registered assets[]={
        {"deadlock","dl_midtown",11193905,{"assets/collision/dl_midtown.acecol",11193905}},
        {"deadlock","hero_testing",11193905,{"assets/collision/hero_testing.acecol",11193905}}
    };
    for(const auto& asset:assets)if(key.game_id==asset.game&&key.map_id==asset.map&&key.build_revision==asset.build)return &asset.asset;
    return nullptr;
}
}

:::FILE asset_loader_retry.h
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

// Generic request deduplication and failure retry policy. The owner serializes
// access, supplies monotonic milliseconds, and rejects obsolete completions.
namespace asset_loader_retry {
enum class Phase : unsigned char { idle, loading, ready, failed, unavailable, stopped };
class State {
    Phase phase_=Phase::idle;
    std::uint64_t failed_at_ms_=0;
public:
    // Same-key failures may start at most once per two seconds after completion.
    // Ready/loading/unregistered requests are independently deduplicated.
    static constexpr std::uint64_t backoff_ms=2000;
    constexpr Phase phase()const noexcept{return phase_;}
    constexpr bool accepts(bool same_key,std::uint64_t now_ms)const noexcept{
        if(phase_==Phase::stopped)return false;
        if(!same_key)return true;
        return phase_==Phase::failed&&now_ms>=failed_at_ms_&&now_ms-failed_at_ms_>=backoff_ms;
    }
    constexpr void begin(bool registered)noexcept{
        if(phase_==Phase::stopped)return;
        phase_=registered?Phase::loading:Phase::unavailable;failed_at_ms_=0;
    }
    constexpr void finish(bool success,std::uint64_t now_ms)noexcept{
        if(phase_!=Phase::loading)return;
        phase_=success?Phase::ready:Phase::failed;failed_at_ms_=success?0:now_ms;
    }
    constexpr void stop()noexcept{phase_=Phase::stopped;failed_at_ms_=0;}
};
}

:::FILE decision_frame.h
#pragma once
#include "entities.h"
#include "collision.h"
#include <utility>

// One owned publication per automatic decision. Camera, actors, calibration,
// clock/key observations and attachment identity cannot drift between helpers.
namespace decision_frame {
struct Snapshot {
    Entity local;std::vector<Entity> targets;std::array<float,16> view{};
    std::array<bool,256> game_keys{};Vec3 camera{};
    float sensitivity=0,fov_sensitivity=1,units_per_metre=0;
    u64 binding_epoch=0,entity_sample_ms=0,matrix_sample_ms=0;
    bool managed=false,frame_valid=false,action_valid=false,camera_valid=false;
    bool input_valid=false,in_match=false,life_known=false,dead=false;
    bool scoreboard=false,spectating=false,raw_ui_valid=false,ace_menu_open=false;
    unsigned raw_ui_flags=0;
    collision::Revision geometry{};
    bool fresh(u64 now)const noexcept {
        return !managed||(frame_valid&&entity_sample_ms&&matrix_sample_ms&&now>=entity_sample_ms&&now>=matrix_sample_ms&&now-entity_sample_ms<=250&&now-matrix_sample_ms<=250);
    }
    Vec2 project(Vec3 point,u64 width,u64 height)const {
        const auto& m=view;const float w=point.x*m[12]+point.y*m[13]+point.z*m[14]+m[15];
        if(!std::isfinite(w)||w<.01f)return {-99999,-99999};
        const float x=point.x*m[0]+point.y*m[1]+point.z*m[2]+m[3],y=point.x*m[4]+point.y*m[5]+point.z*m[6]+m[7];
        if(!std::isfinite(x)||!std::isfinite(y))return {-99999,-99999};
        return {float(width)*.5f*(1+x/w),float(height)*.5f*(1-y/w)};
    }
    float projection_x()const{return std::sqrt(view[0]*view[0]+view[1]*view[1]+view[2]*view[2]);}
};
inline Snapshot capture(bool allies,bool npcs){
    Snapshot out;{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(snap_mtx);
    out.managed=snap.backend_managed.load();out.frame_valid=snap.frame_valid.load();out.action_valid=snap.action_valid.load();
    out.local=snap.local;out.targets=snap.enemies;
    if(allies)out.targets.insert(out.targets.end(),snap.friendlies.begin(),snap.friendlies.end());
    if(npcs)out.targets.insert(out.targets.end(),snap.npcs.begin(),snap.npcs.end());
    std::copy(std::begin(snap.view),std::end(snap.view),out.view.begin());out.game_keys=snap.game_keys;
    out.camera=snap.camera;out.camera_valid=snap.camera_valid;out.sensitivity=snap.sensitivity;out.fov_sensitivity=snap.fov_sensitivity;out.units_per_metre=snap.units_per_metre.load();
    out.binding_epoch=snap.native_binding_epoch.load();out.entity_sample_ms=snap.last_read_ms.load();out.matrix_sample_ms=snap.matrix_sample_ms.load();
    out.input_valid=snap.input_valid.load();out.in_match=snap.in_match.load();out.life_known=snap.local_alive_valid.load();out.dead=snap.dead.load();
    out.scoreboard=snap.in_scoreboard.load();out.spectating=snap.spectating.load();out.raw_ui_valid=snap.raw_ui_valid.load();out.raw_ui_flags=snap.raw_ui_flags.load();out.ace_menu_open=snap.overlay_menu.load();
    }out.geometry=collision::revision();return out;
}
inline thread_local const Snapshot* current_snapshot=nullptr;
inline const Snapshot* active()noexcept{return current_snapshot;}
inline bool managed()noexcept{return active()?active()->managed:snap.backend_managed.load();}
inline u64 binding_epoch()noexcept{return active()?active()->binding_epoch:snap.native_binding_epoch.load();}
class Scope {
    Snapshot value_;const Snapshot* previous_;
public:
    explicit Scope(bool allies,bool npcs=false):value_(capture(allies,npcs)),previous_(current_snapshot){current_snapshot=&value_;}
    explicit Scope(Snapshot sample):value_(std::move(sample)),previous_(current_snapshot){current_snapshot=&value_;}
    ~Scope(){current_snapshot=previous_;}
    Scope(const Scope&)=delete;Scope& operator=(const Scope&)=delete;
    Snapshot& get()noexcept{return value_;}
};
}

:::FILE output_queue_policy.h
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
namespace output_queue {
enum class Origin : unsigned char { General, Aim, Trigger };
enum class Kind : unsigned char { Move, Down, Tap, Chord };
enum class Push : unsigned char { Rejected, Queued, Coalesced };
inline constexpr std::uint64_t lease_ms=250,command_ttl_ms=250;
inline constexpr std::size_t capacity=32,resource_count=261,max_held=8;
constexpr std::size_t owner(Origin value){return static_cast<std::size_t>(value);}
constexpr bool valid_owner(Origin value){return owner(value)<3;}
struct Context {std::uint64_t now=0,attachment=0;bool connected=false,permitted=false;};
struct Request {
    Kind kind=Kind::Move;Origin origin=Origin::General;
    int first=0,second=0,hold_ms=0;unsigned spacing_ms=0;
    std::uint64_t generation=0,attachment=0,submitted_ms=0,ready_ms=0,source_sample_ms=0;
    std::uint64_t first_release_generation=0,second_release_generation=0;
};
struct Held {
    bool active=false;Origin origin=Origin::General;
    std::uint64_t generation=0,attachment=0,release_ms=0,order=0;unsigned release_failures=0;
};
// Pure bounded policy. Its owner serializes access. Release state is separate
// from pending capacity, so a full queue can never reject an owed release.
class Queue {
    std::array<Request,capacity> pending_{};std::size_t size_=0;
    std::array<std::uint64_t,3> generation_{1,1,1},lease_until_{};
    std::array<std::array<std::uint64_t,5>,3> release_generation_{};
    constexpr void erase(std::size_t at){for(std::size_t i=at+1;i<size_;++i)pending_[i-1]=pending_[i];--size_;}
public:
    constexpr std::size_t size()const{return size_;}
    constexpr std::uint64_t generation(Origin origin)const{return generation_[owner(origin)];}
    constexpr bool active(Origin origin,std::uint64_t now)const{
        return valid_owner(origin)&&(origin==Origin::General||(lease_until_[owner(origin)]&&now<=lease_until_[owner(origin)]));
    }
    constexpr void cancel(Origin origin){
        if(!valid_owner(origin))return;auto index=owner(origin);
        if(++generation_[index]==0)++generation_[index];lease_until_[index]=0;
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<size_;)if(pending_[i].origin==origin)erase(i);else ++i;
    }
    constexpr void cancel_all(){cancel(Origin::General);cancel(Origin::Aim);cancel(Origin::Trigger);}
    constexpr void set_activity(Origin origin,bool enabled,std::uint64_t now){
        if(!valid_owner(origin))return;
        if(!enabled){cancel(origin);return;}
        if(origin==Origin::General)return;
        auto index=owner(origin);if(lease_until_[index]&&now>lease_until_[index])cancel(origin);
        lease_until_[index]=now+lease_ms;
    }
    constexpr void expire(std::uint64_t now){
        for(unsigned index=1;index<3;++index)if(lease_until_[index]&&now>lease_until_[index])cancel(static_cast<Origin>(index));
    }
    constexpr bool token_valid(Origin origin,std::uint64_t generation,std::uint64_t attachment,const Context& context)const{
        return context.connected&&context.permitted&&valid_owner(origin)&&active(origin,context.now)&&generation==generation_[owner(origin)]&&attachment==context.attachment;
    }
    constexpr bool valid(const Request& request,const Context& context)const{
        if(!token_valid(request.origin,request.generation,request.attachment,context)||context.now<request.submitted_ms||context.now-request.submitted_ms>command_ttl_ms)return false;
        if(request.source_sample_ms&&(context.now<request.source_sample_ms||context.now-request.source_sample_ms>command_ttl_ms))return false;
        if(request.kind!=Kind::Move){
            const auto& generations=release_generation_[owner(request.origin)];
            if(request.first>=0&&request.first<5&&request.first_release_generation!=generations[(std::size_t)request.first])return false;
            if(request.kind==Kind::Chord&&request.second>=0&&request.second<5&&request.second_release_generation!=generations[(std::size_t)request.second])return false;
        }return true;
    }
    constexpr bool release_due(const Held& held,const Context& context)const{
        return held.active&&((held.release_ms&&context.now>=held.release_ms)||!token_valid(held.origin,held.generation,held.attachment,context));
    }
    constexpr Push push(Request request,const Context& context,unsigned latency_ms,unsigned spacing_ms){
        if(!valid_owner(request.origin)||!context.connected||!context.permitted||!active(request.origin,context.now))return Push::Rejected;
        request.generation=generation(request.origin);request.attachment=context.attachment;request.submitted_ms=context.now;
        request.ready_ms=context.now+latency_ms;request.spacing_ms=spacing_ms;
        if(request.kind!=Kind::Move){
            const auto& generations=release_generation_[owner(request.origin)];
            if(request.first>=0&&request.first<5)request.first_release_generation=generations[(std::size_t)request.first];
            if(request.kind==Kind::Chord&&request.second>=0&&request.second<5)request.second_release_generation=generations[(std::size_t)request.second];
        }
        if(!valid(request,context))return Push::Rejected;
        if(size_&&request.kind==Kind::Move){
            auto& tail=pending_[size_-1];
            if(tail.kind==Kind::Move&&tail.origin==request.origin&&tail.generation==request.generation&&tail.attachment==request.attachment){
                // Latest counts replace unsent counts; retaining the first due
                // time prevents a stream of replacements postponing forever.
                request.ready_ms=tail.ready_ms;tail=request;return Push::Coalesced;
            }
        }
        if(size_==capacity)return Push::Rejected;pending_[size_++]=request;return Push::Queued;
    }
    constexpr bool take(const Context& context,std::uint64_t last_sent,Request& request){
        while(size_){
            const auto& head=pending_[0];if(!valid(head,context)){erase(0);continue;}
            auto spaced=last_sent?last_sent+head.spacing_ms:0;auto due=head.ready_ms>spaced?head.ready_ms:spaced;
            if(context.now<due)return false;request=head;erase(0);return true;
        }return false;
    }
    constexpr void cancel_resource(Origin origin,int resource){
        if(!valid_owner(origin)||resource<0||resource>=5)return;
        auto& generation=release_generation_[owner(origin)][(std::size_t)resource];if(++generation==0)++generation;
        for(std::size_t i=0;i<size_;){const auto& request=pending_[i];
            bool matches=request.origin==origin&&request.kind!=Kind::Move&&(request.first==resource||(request.kind==Kind::Chord&&request.second==resource));
            if(matches)erase(i);else ++i;
        }
    }
};
}
:::ENDFILE
